it: ...Bene, io vado a raccontare di Gaius Vis alla gente di Irva. Ah, giusto! E già che ci sono dirò a tutti quelli che conosci che ti batti contro il Caos!

jp: ぶぎぇっ！？何するのさ！
jp_grezzo: "ぶぎぇっ！？何するのさ" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "！"
en_grezzo: "Gurk! *cough* *cough*... What are you doing, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "?"
contesto: chatMore lang("ぶぎぇっ！？何するのさ" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "！", "Gurk! *cough* *cough*... What are you doing, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "?")

jp: 君は今！ガイアス・ヴィスへの第一歩を踏み出した！
jp_grezzo: "君は今！ガイアス・ヴィスへの第一歩を踏み出した！"
en: You have - right now! - taken your first step into Gaius Vis!
en_grezzo: "You have - right now! - taken your first step into Gaius Vis!"
it: Ecco! In questo istante hai messo piede per la prima volta a Gaius Vis!

jp: ここまで長かった…この世界ではまだ1年程度しか経っていないけれど、ボクはループ込みで10年以上対応にあたっていたんだ。ようやく君という因子を見つけて連れてくることができたよ。
jp_grezzo: "ここまで長かった…この世界ではまだ1年程度しか経っていないけれど、ボクはループ込みで10年以上対応にあたっていたんだ。ようやく君という因子を見つけて連れてくることができたよ。"
en: It's taken me so long to get to this point... In this world it has only been about a year, but because of the loops, I've been dealing with this for over 10 years by now. Finally, I've managed to find you, the Decisive Factor, and brought you here.
en_grezzo: "It's taken me so long to get to this point... In this world it has only been about a year, but because of the loops, I've been dealing with this for over 10 years by now. Finally, I've managed to find you, the Decisive Factor, and brought you here."
it: Quanta strada... In questo mondo è passato sì e no un anno, ma io, contando i cicli, ci lavoro da più di dieci. Alla fine il Fattore Decisivo l'ho trovato, e sei tu: e sono riuscito a portarti qui.

jp: うーん。でもまだ君の認識が次元を超えて追いついていないみたいだね。おそらく君の目には、多くのものがイルヴァのものに置き換わって見えるだろう。
jp_grezzo: "うーん。でもまだ君の認識が次元を超えて追いついていないみたいだね。おそらく君の目には、多くのものがイルヴァのものに置き換わって見えるだろう。"
en: Hmmm... But it seems that your perception has not caught up with you across dimensions yet. Perhaps, in your eyes, many things here will appear to be replaced by things you've seen in Irva.
en_grezzo: "Hmmm... But it seems that your perception has not caught up with you across dimensions yet. Perhaps, in your eyes, many things here will appear to be replaced by things you've seen in Irva."
it: Mmh. Però la tua percezione non ha ancora seguito il salto fra le dimensioni. Probabilmente ai tuoi occhi molte cose appariranno sostituite da cose di Irva.

jp: さて…見る限り、依然として廃忘獣がはびこっているようだね…。あのお方は大丈夫だろうか。一緒に探しに行こう！
jp_grezzo: "さて…見る限り、依然として廃忘獣がはびこっているようだね…。あのお方は大丈夫だろうか。一緒に探しに行こう！"
en: Well... as far as I can see, it seems this place is still crawling with oblivion beasts... I wonder if that girl is okay. Let's go look for her together!
en_grezzo: "Well... as far as I can see, it seems this place is still crawling with oblivion beasts... I wonder if that girl is okay. Let's go look for her together!"
it: Dunque... a quanto vedo, le bestie dell'oblio dilagano ancora... Chissà se quella persona sta bene. Andiamo a cercarla insieme!

jp: えっ。あのお方が誰かって？ああ、まだ説明してなかったっけ。
jp_grezzo: "えっ。あのお方が誰かって？ああ、まだ説明してなかったっけ。"
en: Eh? Who's \"that girl\", you say? Oh, right. I haven't explained that part yet.
en_grezzo: "Eh? Who's \"that girl\", you say? Oh, right. I haven't explained that part yet."
it: Eh? Chi sarebbe \"quella persona\", dici? Ah, giusto: non te l'ho ancora spiegato.

jp: 叡智を司る中級神であるソピアーは知っているよね。あのお方はソピアーの兄姉たち28柱が合神した、超越神だよ。幾多の神々を吸収した混沌の神に対抗するための措置だったらしいね。ちなみにソピアーは一回堕天している影響でうまく合神できなかったんだって。
jp_grezzo: "叡智を司る中級神であるソピアーは知っているよね。あのお方はソピアーの兄姉たち28柱が合神した、超越神だよ。幾多の神々を吸収した混沌の神に対抗するための措置だったらしいね。ちなみにソピアーは一回堕天している影響でうまく合神できなかったんだって。"
en: You know Sophia, the mid-tier god who controls wisdom, right? The girl I'm talking about is a transcendent deity who is a combination of twenty-eight of Sophia's brothers and sisters. I heard that the reason for that was to be able to stand against the God of Chaos, who'd absorbed many other gods himself. By the way, I also heard that Sophia couldn't combine all those gods properly because of her fall from the heavens.
en_grezzo: "You know Sophia, the mid-tier god who controls wisdom, right? The girl I'm talking about is a transcendent deity who is a combination of twenty-eight of Sophia's brothers and sisters. I heard that the reason for that was to be able to stand against the God of Chaos, who'd absorbed many other gods himself. By the way, I also heard that Sophia couldn't combine all those gods properly because of her fall from the heavens."
it: Sophia la conosci, no? La divinità di medio rango che ha in mano la sapienza. Ebbene, quella persona è un dio trascendente: ventotto fra i fratelli e le sorelle di Sophia, fusi in uno solo. Pare fosse una contromisura contro il dio del Caos, che di divinità ne aveva assorbite parecchie. E pare che Sophia, per via di quella volta che cadde dal cielo, nella fusione non sia riuscita a entrare bene.

jp: あのお方はガイアス・ヴィスの実情を知って、色々と便宜を図ってくれた。今は直接、忘却の女神と戦っているはずだ。こうしてボクが覚えている以上、間違いなく無事なはずなんだけど…。
jp_grezzo: "あのお方はガイアス・ヴィスの実情を知って、色々と便宜を図ってくれた。今は直接、忘却の女神と戦っているはずだ。こうしてボクが覚えている以上、間違いなく無事なはずなんだけど…。"
en: That fine lady knew the actual situation of Gaius Vis, and did a lot to help us. She must be fighting the Goddess of Oblivion herself as we speak. As long as I can remember her like I'm doing right now, she should be safe, but...
en_grezzo: "That fine lady knew the actual situation of Gaius Vis, and did a lot to help us. She must be fighting the Goddess of Oblivion herself as we speak. As long as I can remember her like I'm doing right now, she should be safe, but..."
it: Quella persona ha saputo com'è ridotta Gaius Vis, e ci ha agevolati in molti modi. Adesso dovrebbe essere in prima linea contro la dea dell'oblio. E finché io me ne ricordo così, come adesso, vuol dire per forza che sta bene. Almeno, dovrebbe...

jp: 一度引き返したい場合は、こちら側のロイターを経由してね。そこの炭鉱街…ザイールにいるはずだから。
jp_grezzo: "一度引き返したい場合は、こちら側のロイターを経由してね。そこの炭鉱街…ザイールにいるはずだから。"
en: If you want to head back, you'll have to talk to the Loyter on this side. He should be in the coal mining town of Zaile just nearby.
en_grezzo: "If you want to head back, you'll have to talk to the Loyter on this side. He should be in the coal mining town of Zaile just nearby."
it: Se a un certo punto vuoi tornare indietro, passa dal Loyter di questo lato. Dovrebbe stare nella città mineraria qui vicino... Zaile.

jp: そうそう、君に渡しておくものがあった。
jp_grezzo: "そうそう、君に渡しておくものがあった。"
en: Oh yeah, I have something to give you.
en_grezzo: "Oh yeah, I have something to give you."
it: Ah, giusto: avevo una cosa da darti.

jp: [記憶の灯]を手に入れた！
jp_grezzo: "[記憶の灯]を手に入れた！"

jp: それは生命情報を記録するアストラル光の塊。記憶をバックアップしてくれるから、記憶消去攻撃を受けてもかなり軽減できるらしいよ。
jp_grezzo: "それは生命情報を記録するアストラル光の塊。記憶をバックアップしてくれるから、記憶消去攻撃を受けてもかなり軽減できるらしいよ。"
en: That's a mass of astral light that records life information. Because it backs up your memories, even if you suffer from a memory erasure attack, its effects should be considerably reduced.
en_grezzo: "That's a mass of astral light that records life information. Because it backs up your memories, even if you suffer from a memory erasure attack, its effects should be considerably reduced."
it: È una massa di luce astrale che registra le informazioni della vita. Tiene una copia dei ricordi, quindi pare che attutisca parecchio gli attacchi che cancellano la memoria.

jp: さらに、世界を行き来するための道具でもあるんだ。ロイターに向かって使ってみて。現時点で、彼は誰よりもガイアス・ヴィスとの結びつきが強い。あちら側にも極めて近い存在がいるんだ。記憶の灯はその繋がりを照らして導いてくれるよ。
jp_grezzo: "さらに、世界を行き来するための道具でもあるんだ。ロイターに向かって使ってみて。現時点で、彼は誰よりもガイアス・ヴィスとの結びつきが強い。あちら側にも極めて近い存在がいるんだ。記憶の灯はその繋がりを照らして導いてくれるよ。"
en: Moreover, it's also a tool for traveling between worlds. Try using it while facing Loyter. At the moment, he is more tied to Gaius Vis than anyone else. There is also a very similar existence to him on the other side. The light from your memories will illuminate that connection and guide you through to the other world.
en_grezzo: "Moreover, it's also a tool for traveling between worlds. Try using it while facing Loyter. At the moment, he is more tied to Gaius Vis than anyone else. There is also a very similar existence to him on the other side. The light from your memories will illuminate that connection and guide you through to the other world."
it: E poi è anche uno strumento per andare da un mondo all'altro. Prova a usarlo rivolto verso Loyter: al momento non c'è nessuno legato a Gaius Vis più di lui. Anche dall'altra parte esiste qualcuno che gli somiglia moltissimo, e il lume della memoria illumina quel legame e ti ci porta.

jp: さぁ、時は来た！
jp_grezzo: "さぁ、時は来た！"

jp: ああ！
jp_grezzo: "ああ！"

jp: 忘れたなぁ？
jp_grezzo: "忘れたなぁ？"

jp: ボクに協力してほしい。前に話したことは憶えているよね？
jp_grezzo: "ボクに協力してほしい。前に話したことは憶えているよね？"
en: I need your help. You remember what we talked about earlier, right?
en_grezzo: "I need your help. You remember what we talked about earlier, right?"
it: Ho bisogno del tuo aiuto. Ti ricordi quello di cui abbiamo parlato, vero?

jp: 忘却の女神の力がここまで及んでいるなんて！もう、時間がないみたいだね…。
jp_grezzo: "忘却の女神の力がここまで及んでいるなんて！もう、時間がないみたいだね…。"
en: Even you've forgotten? I can't believe the power of the Goddess of Oblivion has reached this far! It looks like we don't have much time left...
en_grezzo: "Even you've forgotten? I can't believe the power of the Goddess of Oblivion has reached this far! It looks like we don't have much time left..."
it: Il potere della dea dell'oblio arriva perfino fin qui! Ormai sembra che il tempo sia finito...

jp: ヴェルニースの酒場に来てほしい。今残っている場所では、あそこが一番つながりの強いところなんだ。
jp_grezzo: "ヴェルニースの酒場に来てほしい。今残っている場所では、あそこが一番つながりの強いところなんだ。"
en: I want you to come to the bar in Vernis. It's the one place with the strongest connection to the other side.
en_grezzo: "I want you to come to the bar in Vernis. It's the one place with the strongest connection to the other side."
it: Voglio che tu venga alla taverna di Vernis. Fra i posti che restano, quello è il punto in cui il legame è più forte.

jp: その時が来たら、君にも協力してもらいたいと思っているんだ。そしてガイアス・ヴィスの話も憶えておいてほしい。人も世界も、完全に忘れられた時に本当の死を迎えるのだから。
jp_grezzo: "その時が来たら、君にも協力してもらいたいと思っているんだ。そしてガイアス・ヴィスの話も憶えておいてほしい。人も世界も、完全に忘れられた時に本当の死を迎えるのだから。"
en: When the time comes, I hope that you'll also be able to help me. And I want you to learn more of Gaius Vis. For people and different worlds, death only truly comes when you've been completely forgotten.
en_grezzo: "When the time comes, I hope that you'll also be able to help me. And I want you to learn more of Gaius Vis. For people and different worlds, death only truly comes when you've been completely forgotten."
it: Quando verrà quel momento, vorrei che dessi una mano anche tu. E vorrei che ti ricordassi di quel che ti ho detto su Gaius Vis: perché una persona, come un mondo, muore davvero solo quando nessuno se la ricorda più.

jp: いやぁ、君が宇宙人の相手をしてくれてようやく解放されたよ。それじゃあ本題について話すよ。…君には真の脅威について知っておいて欲しいんだ。
jp_grezzo: "いやぁ、君が宇宙人の相手をしてくれてようやく解放されたよ。それじゃあ本題について話すよ。…君には真の脅威について知っておいて欲しいんだ。"
en: Finally you've got the space man out of my hair. Let's talk for a minute... I want you to know about what's truly threatening this world.
en_grezzo: "Finally you've got the space man out of my hair. Let's talk for a minute... I want you to know about what's truly threatening this world."
it: Ah, finalmente libero: quell'extraterrestre te lo sei preso tu. Allora vengo al punto... Voglio che tu sappia qual è la vera minaccia.

jp: 実は、ボクはこの世界の出身じゃない。ガイアス・ヴィスという別世界から来たんだ。妖精族の中でもエルンと呼ばれる特別な種族で、あちら側では訛ってエルフとも呼ばれていたよ。
jp_grezzo: "実は、ボクはこの世界の出身じゃない。ガイアス・ヴィスという別世界から来たんだ。妖精族の中でもエルンと呼ばれる特別な種族で、あちら側では訛ってエルフとも呼ばれていたよ。"
en: I'm not actually from this world - I came from a different world known as Gaius Vis. In my world, there's a special race of fairy known as Elun, also known there by the name of Elves.
en_grezzo: "I'm not actually from this world - I came from a different world known as Gaius Vis. In my world, there's a special race of fairy known as Elun, also known there by the name of Elves."
it: In realtà io non sono nato in questo mondo: vengo da un altro mondo, che si chiama Gaius Vis. Sono di una stirpe speciale, dentro il popolo delle fate: gli Elun, che di là, storpiando il nome, chiamavano anche elfi.

jp: ガイアス・ヴィスはこのイルヴァの姉妹世界。同じようにエーテルの風が吹き、人々は異形の森を排除しようとしていた。けれどその矢先、突如として現れた忘却の化身に侵略され、世界のおよそ95％が記憶ごと存在消滅しガイアス・ヴィスは滅んだ。消滅した部分には何があったのか、どんな人々が暮らしていたのか、ボクにももう思い出せない。
jp_grezzo: "ガイアス・ヴィスはこのイルヴァの姉妹世界。同じようにエーテルの風が吹き、人々は異形の森を排除しようとしていた。けれどその矢先、突如として現れた忘却の化身に侵略され、世界のおよそ95％が記憶ごと存在消滅しガイアス・ヴィスは滅んだ。消滅した部分には何があったのか、どんな人々が暮らしていたのか、ボクにももう思い出せない。"
en: Gaius Vis is a sister world to Irva. It also has the Etherwind, and a group that wanted to destroy the Heretical Forest. But suddenly, Gaius Vis was invaded by the avatar of Oblivion, utterly obliterating the existence of 95% of the world. Gaius Vis collapsed.
en_grezzo: "Gaius Vis is a sister world to Irva. It also has the Etherwind, and a group that wanted to destroy the Heretical Forest. But suddenly, Gaius Vis was invaded by the avatar of Oblivion, utterly obliterating the existence of 95% of the world. Gaius Vis collapsed."
it: Gaius Vis è il mondo gemello di Irva. Anche lì soffia il vento d'etere, e anche lì la gente voleva estirpare la Foresta Eretica. Ma proprio in quel momento è arrivata di colpo l'incarnazione dell'oblio: il 95% del mondo è sparito dall'esistenza insieme al ricordo di sé, e Gaius Vis è finita. Che cosa ci fosse nella parte scomparsa, che gente ci vivesse, non riesco più a ricordarlo nemmeno io.

jp: そんな時、絶望するボクの前に現れたのがあのお方だったんだ！ボクはあのお方の力を借りて時間を巻き戻し、運命を変えようと努力した。イレギュラーと成り得る旅人を何人も導き、何度も共に戦った。戦いの中で、ボクの先祖である運命の女神ノルンの力も覚醒した。同じ女神の血統を持つ巨人族・小人族の末裔とも協力した。
jp_grezzo: "そんな時、絶望するボクの前に現れたのがあのお方だったんだ！ボクはあのお方の力を借りて時間を巻き戻し、運命を変えようと努力した。イレギュラーと成り得る旅人を何人も導き、何度も共に戦った。戦いの中で、ボクの先祖である運命の女神ノルンの力も覚醒した。同じ女神の血統を持つ巨人族・小人族の末裔とも協力した。"
en: It was then that \"he\" appeared before me! I borrowed his power and rewound time, attempting to change fate. I guided many adventurers with the potential to become Irregulars, and fought together with them many times. In these fights, the power of my ancestor, the Goddess of Destiny Norne, awoke within me. I worked together with the dwarves and giants, both of whom also shared my lineage.
en_grezzo: "It was then that \"he\" appeared before me! I borrowed his power and rewound time, attempting to change fate. I guided many adventurers with the potential to become Irregulars, and fought together with them many times. In these fights, the power of my ancestor, the Goddess of Destiny Norne, awoke within me. I worked together with the dwarves and giants, both of whom also shared my lineage."
it: E in quel momento, mentre disperavo, davanti a me è comparsa quella persona! Con la sua forza ho riavvolto il tempo e ho cercato di cambiare il destino. Ho guidato molti viandanti che potevano diventare Irregolari, e ho combattuto al loro fianco molte volte. In quelle battaglie si è risvegliata anche la forza di Norne, la dea del destino, che è mia antenata. E ho collaborato con i discendenti dei giganti e dei nani, che di quella dea hanno il mio stesso sangue.

jp: でも何千回繰り返してもダメだった！なんとか街ひとつとその周囲を含むごく一部の地域の存在は守れた程度で、消滅する運命にある世界の大半には干渉すらできなかった。導いた旅人たちはどこへも行けず、疲弊し、考えるのをやめ、最後はいつも忘却の海へと消えていった。君にわかるかい、この絶望が。この怒りが。
jp_grezzo: "でも何千回繰り返してもダメだった！なんとか街ひとつとその周囲を含むごく一部の地域の存在は守れた程度で、消滅する運命にある世界の大半には干渉すらできなかった。導いた旅人たちはどこへも行けず、疲弊し、考えるのをやめ、最後はいつも忘却の海へと消えていった。君にわかるかい、この絶望が。この怒りが。"
en: But no matter how many times we fought, the destiny of the world could not be changed! Somehow I was able to protect a single town and its surroundings, but the vast majority of the world couldn't be saved from extinction. The adventurers I had led could do nothing, eventually giving up and themselves fading into oblivion as everything else had done. Can you understand my despair? My anger?
en_grezzo: "But no matter how many times we fought, the destiny of the world could not be changed! Somehow I was able to protect a single town and its surroundings, but the vast majority of the world couldn't be saved from extinction. The adventurers I had led could do nothing, eventually giving up and themselves fading into oblivion as everything else had done. Can you understand my despair? My anger?"
it: Ma per quante migliaia di volte lo rifacessi, niente! Sono riuscito a salvare l'esistenza di una città sola e di poco altro intorno; sulla gran parte del mondo, che era destinata a sparire, non ho potuto nemmeno intervenire. I viandanti che avevo guidato non arrivavano da nessuna parte: si logoravano, smettevano di pensare, e alla fine sparivano sempre nel mare dell'oblio. Lo capisci, questo sconforto? Questa rabbia?

jp: そしてボクはあのお方から聞いた。イルヴァという姉妹世界も忘却の化身に狙われていると。ガイアス・ヴィスの悲劇を繰り返してはいけない。そう思ったボクらはこちら側に移り住み、迎撃準備を始めた。忘却の化身に滅ぼされたいくつもの世界から生存者をかき集め、運命変革因子として揃えた。
jp_grezzo: "そしてボクはあのお方から聞いた。イルヴァという姉妹世界も忘却の化身に狙われていると。ガイアス・ヴィスの悲劇を繰り返してはいけない。そう思ったボクらはこちら側に移り住み、迎撃準備を始めた。忘却の化身に滅ぼされたいくつもの世界から生存者をかき集め、運命変革因子として揃えた。"
en: And then \"he\" told me. The sister world of Irva was also to be targeted by the avatar of Oblivion. I cannot allow the tragedy of Gaius Vis to be repeated. With that singular purpose in my heart, I came to this world and began preparing to counter the invasion. I gathered surviving individuals from many worlds destroyed by the avatar of Oblivion, using them as a bid to alter fate.
en_grezzo: "And then \"he\" told me. The sister world of Irva was also to be targeted by the avatar of Oblivion. I cannot allow the tragedy of Gaius Vis to be repeated. With that singular purpose in my heart, I came to this world and began preparing to counter the invasion. I gathered surviving individuals from many worlds destroyed by the avatar of Oblivion, using them as a bid to alter fate."
it: E poi quella persona me l'ha detto: anche Irva, il mondo gemello, è nel mirino dell'incarnazione dell'oblio. La tragedia di Gaius Vis non deve ripetersi. Con questo in testa ci siamo trasferiti da questa parte e abbiamo cominciato a preparare la difesa. Dai molti mondi che l'incarnazione dell'oblio ha distrutto abbiamo raccolto i sopravvissuti, e li abbiamo messi insieme come fattori di mutamento del destino.

jp: そうして奴らの尖兵を撃退することには成功したんだ。一匹は完全に抹殺し、一匹はエウダーナの老魔導士が支配して制御に成功した。残り一匹、死にぞこないがサウスティリスに潜伏しているみたいだけど、あれはもう本来の力を取り戻せないから大丈夫だよ。
jp_grezzo: "そうして奴らの尖兵を撃退することには成功したんだ。一匹は完全に抹殺し、一匹はエウダーナの老魔導士が支配して制御に成功した。残り一匹、死にぞこないがサウスティリスに潜伏しているみたいだけど、あれはもう本来の力を取り戻せないから大丈夫だよ。"
en: The repelling of their vanguard was a success. One was killed entirely, and the other successfully dominated by a mage from Eulderna. One remains hidden away in South Tyris, but since he cannot regain his original power, it's not a concern.
en_grezzo: "The repelling of their vanguard was a success. One was killed entirely, and the other successfully dominated by a mage from Eulderna. One remains hidden away in South Tyris, but since he cannot regain his original power, it's not a concern."
it: E così siamo riusciti a respingere la loro avanguardia. Uno l'abbiamo cancellato del tutto; un altro se l'è sottomesso il vecchio mago di Eulderna, e lo tiene a bada. Ne resta uno, mezzo morto, che pare si nasconda a Tyris del Sud: ma quello la sua forza vera non la riprende più, quindi non è un problema.

jp: けれどまだ事態は解決していない。わずかに運命が更新されたに過ぎない。奴らは忘却という概念そのもの…いつか、必ず奴らの本隊がやってきて世界は滅びる運命にある。でもそんなことは承知の上。ボクは最後まで足掻いてみせる。そう、どんな手を使ってもね。
jp_grezzo: "けれどまだ事態は解決していない。わずかに運命が更新されたに過ぎない。奴らは忘却という概念そのもの…いつか、必ず奴らの本隊がやってきて世界は滅びる運命にある。でもそんなことは承知の上。ボクは最後まで足掻いてみせる。そう、どんな手を使ってもね。"
en: But it's not over yet. Fate has not truly been changed - only slightly altered. Oblivion... One day, when their main forces arrive, this world is destined to fall. I understand that. Still, I'll keep fighting. I'll fight them every way I can.
en_grezzo: "But it's not over yet. Fate has not truly been changed - only slightly altered. Oblivion... One day, when their main forces arrive, this world is destined to fall. I understand that. Still, I'll keep fighting. I'll fight them every way I can."
it: Ma la faccenda non è chiusa. Il destino si è aggiornato appena appena. Loro sono l'oblio stesso, come concetto... prima o poi il grosso delle loro forze arriverà, e il mondo è destinato a finire. Lo so bene. E fino all'ultimo mi ci opporrò con le unghie e coi denti. Sì: con qualunque mezzo.

jp: あー！いいところに来てくれたね。ちょっとここに潜る途中で見知らぬ宇宙人に絡まれちゃってさ。ボクがガイドだからってしつこく聞いてくるんだけど、宇宙人が探してる人間なんて知るわけないよ。誰だよ黒髪の少年で名前がクロヤンって。
jp_grezzo: "あー！いいところに来てくれたね。ちょっとここに潜る途中で見知らぬ宇宙人に絡まれちゃってさ。ボクがガイドだからってしつこく聞いてくるんだけど、宇宙人が探してる人間なんて知るわけないよ。誰だよ黒髪の少年で名前がクロヤンって。"
en: Ah! Perfect timing. I seem to have gotten tangled up with this strange space guy here. I'm a guide, but I don't know the person he's looking for. Do you by chance happen to know a black-haired boy by the name of Kuro?
en_grezzo: "Ah! Perfect timing. I seem to have gotten tangled up with this strange space guy here. I'm a guide, but I don't know the person he's looking for. Do you by chance happen to know a black-haired boy by the name of Kuro?"
it: Ah! Arrivi al momento giusto. Stavo scendendo qui e mi si è attaccato un extraterrestre che non conosco. Insiste perché sono una guida, ma io che ne so di chi cerca un extraterrestre. E chi sarebbe un ragazzo dai capelli neri di nome Kuroya?

jp: 君に話があるんだけどね…先にあのしつこい宇宙人をここから連れ出してよ。迷惑なんだよね。

it: Avrei una cosa da dirti, ma... prima portami via di qui quell'extraterrestre insistente. È una seccatura.

jp: 思えば、魔術に捧げた人生じゃった。才を活かすため師匠に背いて軍に入り、無我夢中で戦い続け…気づけば老いていた。

en: Looking back, my life was dedicated to magic. In order to make the most of my talent, I disobeyed my own master and joined the army, fighting selflessly until I found myself growing old.
en_grezzo: "Looking back, my life was dedicated to magic. In order to make the most of my talent, I disobeyed my own master and joined the army, fighting selflessly until I found myself growing old."
it: A ripensarci, è stata una vita votata alla magia. Per sfruttare il mio talento ho voltato le spalle al maestro e sono entrato nell'esercito, e ho combattuto senza pensare a niente... e quando me ne sono accorto ero vecchio.

jp: 世界が消える前兆として、忘却の女神の化身が現れる。奴らが人々から記憶を抹消することで、人も世界も完全に忘れ去られ本当の死を迎える…。その内の一匹が魔術で我が手の内にあるのじゃ。
jp_grezzo: "世界が消える前兆として、忘却の女神の化身が現れる。奴らが人々から記憶を抹消することで、人も世界も完全に忘れ去られ本当の死を迎える…。その内の一匹が魔術で我が手の内にあるのじゃ。"
en: The incarnation of the Goddess of Oblivion appears as a premonition of the world's disappearance. They erase the memories of humankind, so that the world and its people are completely forgotten. That is death in its truest form. I have knowledge of a single type of magical spell in that domain.
en_grezzo: "The incarnation of the Goddess of Oblivion appears as a premonition of the world's disappearance. They erase the memories of humankind, so that the world and its people are completely forgotten. That is death in its truest form. I have knowledge of a single type of magical spell in that domain."
it: Come segno che un mondo sta per sparire, compare l'incarnazione della dea dell'oblio. Quelle cancellano il ricordo dalla gente, e così le persone e il mondo vengono dimenticati del tutto e incontrano la morte vera... Ebbene, una di quelle bestie la tengo in pugno io, con la magia.

jp: すぐに谷の入口まで退避しろという声。動物たちが次々に逃げ出すのを見て、さすがに危険を感じたわ。動物たちを追って移動する途中、ふと振り返ると、谷の奥から黒い獣が湧いてくるのが見えたの。恐ろしかったわ…。
jp_grezzo: "すぐに谷の入口まで退避しろという声。動物たちが次々に逃げ出すのを見て、さすがに危険を感じたわ。動物たちを追って移動する途中、ふと振り返ると、谷の奥から黒い獣が湧いてくるのが見えたの。恐ろしかったわ…。"
en: It said that we must evacuate to the entrance of the valley as soon as possible. When I started to notice the local wildlife fleeing the area one after another, I knew we were in danger. As we started running after the animals, I turned my head and looked back to see a black beast emerge from the depths of the valley. It was terrifying...
en_grezzo: "It said that we must evacuate to the entrance of the valley as soon as possible. When I started to notice the local wildlife fleeing the area one after another, I knew we were in danger. As we started running after the animals, I turned my head and looked back to see a black beast emerge from the depths of the valley. It was terrifying..."
it: Diceva di ritirarci subito fino all'imbocco della valle. Quando ho visto gli animali fuggire uno dopo l'altro, ho capito che il pericolo era vero. Mentre li seguivo mi sono voltata un attimo, e dal fondo della valle ho visto scaturire una bestia nera. Che spavento...

jp: ここまで辿り着いた途端、空間が閉じて小さな裂け目だけが残ったわ。裂け目を覗くとね、谷の奥が見えるの。奥はもう、黒い獣でいっぱいよ。
jp_grezzo: "ここまで辿り着いた途端、空間が閉じて小さな裂け目だけが残ったわ。裂け目を覗くとね、谷の奥が見えるの。奥はもう、黒い獣でいっぱいよ。"
en: Right as we arrived here, the rift in space we passed through closed up, leaving only a tiny crevice. If you look through the crack, you can see that the depths of the valley are already swarming with those black beasts.
en_grezzo: "Right as we arrived here, the rift in space we passed through closed up, leaving only a tiny crevice. If you look through the crack, you can see that the depths of the valley are already swarming with those black beasts."
it: Appena siamo arrivati qui lo spazio si è richiuso, e ne è rimasta solo una fessura piccolissima. Se guardi dentro la fessura vedi il fondo della valle: ormai è pieno di bestie nere.

en_grezzo: "Our main body is holding the Goddess of Oblivion at bay.... No. We know this from fighting them: the one responsible isn't exactly the goddess who rules oblivion."
it: Il nostro corpo principale sta trattenendo la dea dell'oblio. No... combattendo l'abbiamo capito: quella, a rigore, non è la dea che governa l'oblio.

jp: あれは世界規模で忘却という現象を起こすための概念存在…神という形で忘却の一側面が具象化したものだ。この世に何らかの記憶がある限り忘却という概念も同時に存在し続けるため、女神の姿を何度滅ぼそうと根源を取り除くことはできない。
jp_grezzo: "あれは世界規模で忘却という現象を起こすための概念存在…神という形で忘却の一側面が具象化したものだ。この世に何らかの記憶がある限り忘却という概念も同時に存在し続けるため、女神の姿を何度滅ぼそうと根源を取り除くことはできない。"
en: It is a conceptual entity that is used to create the phenomenon of oblivion on a global scale... the very embodiment of oblivion, in the form of a god. As long as memories continue to exist in this world, the concept of oblivion will continue to exist alongside them, and no matter how many times we destroy its form of a goddess, its origin cannot be excised.
en_grezzo: "It is a conceptual entity that is used to create the phenomenon of oblivion on a global scale... the very embodiment of oblivion, in the form of a god. As long as memories continue to exist in this world, the concept of oblivion will continue to exist alongside them, and no matter how many times we destroy its form of a goddess, its origin cannot be excised."
it: È un essere concettuale, fatto per produrre il fenomeno dell'oblio su scala di mondo... un aspetto dell'oblio che ha preso corpo in forma di divinità. Finché in questo mondo esiste un ricordo qualsiasi, insieme a esso continua a esistere il concetto di oblio: per quante volte se ne distrugga la figura di dea, la radice non si può togliere.

Una persona che ha dimenticato perfino di aver dimenticato. Ecco, pensa alla stessa cosa su scala di mondo, anzi di universo."

jp: 今は降臨する前の本体を攻撃して食い止めているが、端末である獣どもまでは抑えきれなかった。このまま獣どもが記憶を喰らって増殖すれば本体の力も大きくなり、私達も押し切られてしまうだろうね。
jp_grezzo: "今は降臨する前の本体を攻撃して食い止めているが、端末である獣どもまでは抑えきれなかった。このまま獣どもが記憶を喰らって増殖すれば本体の力も大きくなり、私達も押し切られてしまうだろうね。"
en: At present, our main body is holding back the Goddess of Oblivion by attacking it before it descends, but we couldn't hold back the beasts that are its terminals. If the beasts continue to feed on our memories and multiply, the power of the main body will grow, and we will be overwhelmed.
en_grezzo: "At present, our main body is holding back the Goddess of Oblivion by attacking it before it descends, but we couldn't hold back the beasts that are its terminals. If the beasts continue to feed on our memories and multiply, the power of the main body will grow, and we will be overwhelmed."
it: Adesso stiamo attaccando il corpo principale prima che scenda, e lo teniamo fermo; ma le bestie, che ne sono i terminali, non siamo riusciti a contenerle. Se continuano a divorare ricordi e a moltiplicarsi, la forza del corpo principale crescerà, e alla fine ci travolgeranno.

jp: そんな…。それじゃあガイアス・ヴィスはもうじき消えてなくなる…？何か手はないんですか！
jp_grezzo: "そんな…。それじゃあガイアス・ヴィスはもうじき消えてなくなる…？何か手はないんですか！"

jp: 今のうちに別世界の観測者たちに記憶を刻み込むことができれば、相手の力を大きく抑制できる。今渡したのは、君が見てきたガイアス・ヴィスの姿を、アストラル光を介してアカシックレコード上に拡散するための干渉機構だ。ネットで公開して記憶保持者を増やし、世界の忘却を遅らせるわけだね。
jp_grezzo: "今のうちに別世界の観測者たちに記憶を刻み込むことができれば、相手の力を大きく抑制できる。今渡したのは、君が見てきたガイアス・ヴィスの姿を、アストラル光を介してアカシックレコード上に拡散するための干渉機構だ。ネットで公開して記憶保持者を増やし、世界の忘却を遅らせるわけだね。"
en: If you can imprint your memories on the observers of the other world while there's still time, you can greatly inhibit the Goddess' powers. What I've just given you is an interference mechanism to diffuse the imagery of Gaius Vis that you've seen onto the Akashic Records using astral light. You're going to publish it to the Network to increase the number of people who retain the memory, thereby delaying the world's oblivion.
en_grezzo: "If you can imprint your memories on the observers of the other world while there's still time, you can greatly inhibit the Goddess' powers. What I've just given you is an interference mechanism to diffuse the imagery of Gaius Vis that you've seen onto the Akashic Records using astral light. You're going to publish it to the Network to increase the number of people who retain the memory, thereby delaying the world's oblivion."
it: Se nel tempo che resta riusciamo a incidere i ricordi negli osservatori di un altro mondo, la forza dell'avversario ne esce molto ridotta. Quello che ti ho appena dato è un meccanismo d'interferenza: serve a diffondere sui registri akashici, attraverso la luce astrale, la Gaius Vis che hai visto con i tuoi occhi. La pubblichi in rete, cresce il numero di chi ne conserva il ricordo, e l'oblio del mondo rallenta.

jp: しかしそれが使えるのは神ではなく使う世界に籍を置く定命だ。さらに効果はレコードの所在が近い者…つまり関わりの深い者たちにしか及ばない。だからのような存在が必要だったんだ。ガイアス・ヴィス出身ではなく、各地を渡り歩いていて、廃忘獣の群れを物理的に突破する力を持つ定命が。
jp_grezzo: "しかしそれが使えるのは神ではなく使う世界に籍を置く定命だ。さらに効果はレコードの所在が近い者…つまり関わりの深い者たちにしか及ばない。だから" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "のような存在が必要だったんだ。ガイアス・ヴィス出身ではなく、各地を渡り歩いていて、廃忘獣の群れを物理的に突破する力を持つ定命が。"
en: However, it can only be used by those who are intertwined with fate in the world they use it, not by gods. Furthermore, it only affects those who are close to the location of the record - in other words, those who are deeply connected to it. That's why we needed someone like you,  - someone who is not from Gaius Vis, but has traveled all across the land, and who is destined to hold the power needed to physically break through the hordes of oblivion beasts.
en_grezzo: "However, it can only be used by those who are intertwined with fate in the world they use it, not by gods. Furthermore, it only affects those who are close to the location of the record - in other words, those who are deeply connected to it. Ecco perché serviva qualcuno come " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ": un mortale che non sia nato a Gaius Vis, che abbia girato in lungo e in largo, e che abbia la forza di aprirsi la strada in mezzo ai branchi di bestie dell'oblio."

jp: そうか。ああ、ボクはガイアス・ヴィスからイルヴァに渡ってきている立場だから使えないのか…。
jp_grezzo: "そうか。ああ、ボクはガイアス・ヴィスからイルヴァに渡ってきている立場だから使えないのか…。"
en: I see. Ahh, so I can't use it because I crossed over from Gaius Vis to Irva a long time ago...
en_grezzo: "I see. Ahh, so I can't use it because I crossed over from Gaius Vis to Irva a long time ago..."
it: Capisco. Ah, e io non posso usarla, perché sono uno che è passato da Gaius Vis a Irva...

jp: ノルンにもやってもらうことはあるよ。地道に、一人でも多く、あちら側の世界の人々に伝えるんだ。何度忘れ去られても伝え続けなさい、このガイアス・ヴィスの物語を。人々の記憶こそが世界を保つ力となるからね。
jp_grezzo: "ノルンにもやってもらうことはあるよ。地道に、一人でも多く、あちら側の世界の人々に伝えるんだ。何度忘れ去られても伝え続けなさい、このガイアス・ヴィスの物語を。人々の記憶こそが世界を保つ力となるからね。"
en: There are still plenty of things I'll be having you do, Norn. You'll need to work hard at getting the word out to as many people in the other world as you can. Keep telling the story of Gaius Vis, no matter how many times it is forgotten. It is the memory of the people that will become the power to save the world.
en_grezzo: "There are still plenty of things I'll be having you do, Norn. You'll need to work hard at getting the word out to as many people in the other world as you can. Keep telling the story of Gaius Vis, no matter how many times it is forgotten. It is the memory of the people that will become the power to save the world."
it: Anche a te, Norne, resta da fare. Con pazienza, a più gente che puoi, parla alle persone del mondo di là. Per quante volte la dimentichino, continua a raccontarla, questa storia di Gaius Vis: perché è il ricordo della gente la forza che tiene in piedi un mondo.

jp: でもボクは、今までもイルヴァの人々に何度か話しています。それでも獣は侵攻を止めなかった…。
jp_grezzo: "でもボクは、今までもイルヴァの人々に何度か話しています。それでも獣は侵攻を止めなかった…。"
en: But I've already told the people of Irva several times before. Even then, the beasts didn't stop their invasion...
en_grezzo: "But I've already told the people of Irva several times before. Even then, the beasts didn't stop their invasion..."
it: Ma io alla gente di Irva l'ho già raccontata più volte. Eppure le bestie non hanno smesso di avanzare...

jp: 効果が薄かったのは、今までアカシックネットワークの媒体がいなかったからね。大丈夫。君の頑張りは無駄にならないよ。
jp_grezzo: "効果が薄かったのは、今までアカシックネットワークの媒体がいなかったからね。大丈夫。君の頑張りは無駄にならないよ。"
en: The reason it wasn't as effective as it could have been is because we've never had a proper medium for the Akashic Network before. Do not worry. Your hard work will not be in vain.
en_grezzo: "The reason it wasn't as effective as it could have been is because we've never had a proper medium for the Akashic Network before. Do not worry. Your hard work will not be in vain."
it: Se ha reso poco, è perché finora mancava un tramite per la rete akashica. Sta' tranquillo: la tua fatica non andrà sprecata.

jp: …さて、長話ですまなかったね。君には少し難解だったかな？それでも、もう一つだけ。別件だよ。

en: ...Anyway, I apologize for the long-winded explanation, . Perhaps it was a little too difficult for you to understand. But besides that, I have one more thing to tell you. It concerns a different matter entirely.
en_grezzo: "...Anyway, I apologize for the long-winded explanation, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ". Perhaps it was a little too difficult for you to understand. But besides that, I have one more thing to tell you. It concerns a different matter entirely."
contesto: chatMore lang("…さて、長話ですまなかったね" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "。君には少し難解だったかな？それでも、もう一つだけ。別件だよ。", "...Anyway, I apologize for the long-winded explanation, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ". Perhaps it was a little too difficult for you to understand. But besides that, I have one more thing to tell you. It concerns a different matter entirely."), strmore, findchara(CREATURE_ID_MIKRAANESIS)
it: "...Bene, scusa la chiacchierata lunga, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + ". Forse per te è stata un po' ostica. E però ancora una cosa, un'ultima: è un altro discorso."

jp: 混沌の真の目覚めが近づいているね。神の間に再び赴き、決着をつけるのが君の宿命だ。
jp_grezzo: "混沌の真の目覚めが近づいているね。神の間に再び赴き、決着をつけるのが君の宿命だ。"
en: The true awakening of Chaos is upon us. It is your destiny to return to the Eternal Seal and put an end to it, once and for all.
en_grezzo: "The true awakening of Chaos is upon us. It is your destiny to return to the Eternal Seal and put an end to it, once and for all."
it: Il vero risveglio del Caos si avvicina. Tornare al Sigillo Eterno e chiudere la partita: questo è il tuo destino.

jp: 口ほどにもない！神の間を破壊するのに時間を取られ、混沌の超児から神力を吸収できなかったようだな！
jp_grezzo: "口ほどにもない！神の間を破壊するのに時間を取られ、混沌の超児から神力を吸収できなかったようだな！"
en: So you're nothing but talk! It seems that you took so long to destroy the Eternal Seal that you couldn't absorb the divine power from the Chaos Child!
en_grezzo: "So you're nothing but talk! It seems that you took so long to destroy the Eternal Seal that you couldn't absorb the divine power from the Chaos Child!"
it: Sei tutto parole! Distruggere il Sigillo Eterno ti ha portato via tanto tempo che non sei riuscito ad assorbire il potere divino del Figlio del Caos!

jp: 何か勘違いをしているようだな、テスカトリポカ。まったく、こんなに痛めつけられて可哀想に。
jp_grezzo: "何か勘違いをしているようだな、テスカトリポカ。まったく、こんなに痛めつけられて可哀想に。"
en: I belive you're mistaken, Tezcatlipoca. What a pity it is to see you in this much pain.
en_grezzo: "I belive you're mistaken, Tezcatlipoca. What a pity it is to see you in this much pain."
it: Ti sbagli su qualcosa, Tezcatlipoca. E guarda come ti hanno ridotto: che pena.

jp: がはっ…クソっ…逃げろテスカトリポカ…！
jp_grezzo: "がはっ…クソっ…逃げろテスカトリポカ…！"

jp: 「光あれ」
jp_grezzo: "「光あれ」"

jp: わが名はヤルダバオート。私は妬む神である。私の他に神は不要だ。そして…そこの矮小な器も用済みだ。
jp_grezzo: "わが名はヤルダバオート。私は妬む神である。私の他に神は不要だ。そして…そこの矮小な器も用済みだ。"
en: My name is Jaldabaoth. I am the god of envy. There is no need for any other god beside me. And I no longer have a use for that diminutive vessel.
en_grezzo: "My name is Jaldabaoth. I am the god of envy. There is no need for any other god beside me. And I no longer have a use for that diminutive vessel."
it: Il mio nome è Jaldabaoth. Io sono un dio geloso. Non serve nessun altro dio oltre a me. E anche quel misero involucro, ormai, ha finito il suo compito.

jp: ヤルダバオート…？器…？
jp_grezzo: "ヤルダバオート…？器…？"

jp: こいつは…私に憑依し、ずっと思考をコントロールしてきたんだ。神々の目を誤魔化すため…様々な細工まで施して、な。
jp_grezzo: "こいつは…私に憑依し、ずっと思考をコントロールしてきたんだ。神々の目を誤魔化すため…様々な細工まで施して、な。"
en: This... thing has been possessing me, controlling my thoughts. He's been manipulating me in various ways... in order to deceive the eyes of the gods.
en_grezzo: "This... thing has been possessing me, controlling my thoughts. He's been manipulating me in various ways... in order to deceive the eyes of the gods."
it: Questa... cosa mi possedeva, e da sempre controllava i miei pensieri. E per ingannare l'occhio degli dei ha ordito ogni sorta di trama.

jp: まさか…今日この時、定命の肉体で神の間を破壊するために、オルフェを隠れ蓑として利用していたのか！？
jp_grezzo: "まさか…今日この時、定命の肉体で神の間を破壊するために、オルフェを隠れ蓑として利用していたのか！？"
en: It can't be... Right at this moment, he was using Orphe as a facade to destroy the Eternal Seal, by using his physical body that was intertwined with fate!
en_grezzo: "It can't be... Right at this moment, he was using Orphe as a facade to destroy the Eternal Seal, by using his physical body that was intertwined with fate!"
it: Non è possibile... Proprio oggi, proprio adesso: si è servito di Orphe come copertura, per distruggere il Sigillo Eterno con un corpo mortale!

jp: 本来の肉体は駄母エンテュメイシスの子宮に還り神力を奪っていたが、奪い尽くすには膨大な時間が必要だったのでな。その間に世界を弄び、混沌の下地を創ろうとしたのだが。
jp_grezzo: "本来の肉体は駄母エンテュメイシスの子宮に還り神力を奪っていたが、奪い尽くすには膨大な時間が必要だったのでな。その間に世界を弄び、混沌の下地を創ろうとしたのだが。"
en: His original body was returned to the womb of Enthumesis, the wicked mother, to steal their divine power. Yet, it would take an enormous amount of time to drain it all away. Nevertheless, I toyed with the world and attempted to lay down the foundation of Chaos in the intervening period.
en_grezzo: "His original body was returned to the womb of Enthumesis, the wicked mother, to steal their divine power. Yet, it would take an enormous amount of time to drain it all away. Nevertheless, I toyed with the world and attempted to lay down the foundation of Chaos in the intervening period."
it: Il mio vero corpo era tornato nel ventre di Enthumesis, la madre indegna, per sottrarle il potere divino; ma prosciugarla fino in fondo richiedeva un tempo immenso. E nell'attesa mi sono preso gioco del mondo, e ho cercato di gettare le fondamenta del Caos.

jp: イレギュラー、お前の行動が邪魔で完遂できなかったよ。だが、この圧倒的な力を手に入れた今では些細な事だ…。
jp_grezzo: "イレギュラー、お前の行動が邪魔で完遂できなかったよ。だが、この圧倒的な力を手に入れた今では些細な事だ…。"
en: Because of your interference, Irregular, I was unable to fully accomplish my plan. But since that I have obtained this tremendous power, that is now a trifling matter...
en_grezzo: "Because of your interference, Irregular, I was unable to fully accomplish my plan. But since that I have obtained this tremendous power, that is now a trifling matter..."
it: Irregolare, le tue mosse mi hanno intralciato e non ho potuto portarlo a termine. Ma ora che ho in mano questa potenza schiacciante, è un dettaglio da nulla...

jp: もういい…オルフェ！お前は上の階に退避しろ！
jp_grezzo: "もういい…オルフェ！お前は上の階に退避しろ！"
en: Enough... Orphe! You'll have to retreat to the upper level!
en_grezzo: "Enough... Orphe! You'll have to retreat to the upper level!"
it: Basta così... Orphe! Tu ritirati al piano di sopra!

jp: くっ…すまない…！
jp_grezzo: "くっ…すまない…！"

jp: どこへでも逃げるがいい。消滅する順番が少し変わるだけだ。
jp_grezzo: "どこへでも逃げるがいい。消滅する順番が少し変わるだけだ。"
en: Flee as much as you want. All it will change is the order in which you will perish.
en_grezzo: "Flee as much as you want. All it will change is the order in which you will perish."
it: Fuggite pure dove volete. Cambierà soltanto l'ordine in cui sparirete.

jp: さて…。頭では覚えていても肉体が動きを忘れている…これが忘却の女神の力か。これでは肉弾戦は不可能、厄介だな。
jp_grezzo: "さて…。頭では覚えていても肉体が動きを忘れている…これが忘却の女神の力か。これでは肉弾戦は不可能、厄介だな。"
en: Well, then... Though I remember how to move about with my mind, my body has forgotten... So this is the power of the Goddess of Oblivion. A battle of flesh and blood is impossible in this state. How bothersome.
en_grezzo: "Well, then... Though I remember how to move about with my mind, my body has forgotten... So this is the power of the Goddess of Oblivion. A battle of flesh and blood is impossible in this state. How bothersome."
it: Bene... La mente ricorda, ma il corpo ha dimenticato i movimenti... Ecco dunque il potere della dea dell'oblio. Così il corpo a corpo mi è precluso: che seccatura.

jp: 神力の総量もだいぶ減ってしまったようだが…それでも、それでもだ。脆弱な神々と世界を消し炭にするには充分！光を呑み込み、混沌世界を創造し、私こそが造物主…唯一の神として君臨してくれよう！
jp_grezzo: "神力の総量もだいぶ減ってしまったようだが…それでも、それでもだ。脆弱な神々と世界を消し炭にするには充分！光を呑み込み、混沌世界を創造し、私こそが造物主…唯一の神として君臨してくれよう！"
en: It seems that my reserves of divine power have dwindled considerably... but even so, it is still enough to obliterate the world and all of its feeble gods! I shall swallow the light, bring forth the world of Chaos, and reign as its creator... the one and only true God!
en_grezzo: "It seems that my reserves of divine power have dwindled considerably... but even so, it is still enough to obliterate the world and all of its feeble gods! I shall swallow the light, bring forth the world of Chaos, and reign as its creator... the one and only true God!"
it: E anche la mia riserva di potere divino si è ridotta parecchio... eppure, eppure. Basta e avanza per incenerire il mondo e i suoi dei fragili! Inghiottirò la luce, creerò il mondo del Caos, e sarò io il Creatore... regnerò come dio unico!

jp: 愚劣で傲慢な偽りの神め…その力の源が何かわかっているのか？
jp_grezzo: "愚劣で傲慢な偽りの神め…その力の源が何かわかっているのか？"
en: You foolish, arrogant, false deity...! Do you have any idea what the source of your power is?
en_grezzo: "You foolish, arrogant, false deity...! Do you have any idea what the source of your power is?"
it: Dio falso, stolto e arrogante... lo sai da dove viene quella forza?

jp: 神のもつ神力とは元をただせば定命たちの願い。魂にしてアーカーシャの回廊より現出するアストラル光。それを踏みにじる貴様に、真の光を手にすることはできない！
jp_grezzo: "神のもつ神力とは元をただせば定命たちの願い。魂にしてアーカーシャの回廊より現出するアストラル光。それを踏みにじる貴様に、真の光を手にすることはできない！"
en: The divine power of the gods ultimately originates from the wish of the predestined. Its soul emerges as astral light from the corridors of Arkasha. You, who trample on it, will never possess the true light!
en_grezzo: "The divine power of the gods ultimately originates from the wish of the predestined. Its soul emerges as astral light from the corridors of Arkasha. You, who trample on it, will never possess the true light!"
it: Il potere divino degli dei, in origine, è il desiderio dei mortali. È anima, ed è luce astrale che affiora dai corridoi di Arkasha. Tu che la calpesti non potrai mai avere in mano la luce vera!

jp: それで？
jp_grezzo: "それで？"

jp: 我は他の神々から力を託された軍神テスカトリポカ。この肉体が滅びようとも、貴様の好きにはさせん！いくぞ、！ここが正念場だっ！
jp_grezzo: "我は他の神々から力を託された軍神テスカトリポカ。この肉体が滅びようとも、貴様の好きにはさせん！いくぞ、" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "！ここが正念場だっ！"
en: Entrusted with the power of all other gods combined, I am Tezcatlipoca, God of War. Even if this body is destroyed, I shall not let you have your way! Here we go, ! It's do or die!
en_grezzo: "Entrusted with the power of all other gods combined, I am Tezcatlipoca, God of War. Even if this body is destroyed, I shall not let you have your way! Here we go, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "! It's do or die!"
contesto: chatMore lang("我は他の神々から力を託された軍神テスカトリポカ。この肉体が滅びようとも、貴様の好きにはさせん！いくぞ、" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "！ここが正念場だっ！", "Entrusted with the power of all other gods combined, I am Tezcatlipoca, God of War. Even if this body is destroyed, I shall not let you have your way! Here we go, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "! It's do or die!"), strmore, findchara(CREATURE_ID_YAYAUHQUI_TEZCATLIPOCA)
it: "Io sono Tezcatlipoca, il dio della guerra, e gli altri dei mi hanno affidato la loro forza. Anche se questo corpo perisce, non ti lascerò fare a modo tuo! Andiamo, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, CHARA_PLAYER) + "! Qui si decide tutto!"

jp: ほざいているがいい。少しの間だが遊んでやろう。お前たちがどこまで耐えられるか楽しみだな。
jp_grezzo: "ほざいているがいい。少しの間だが遊んでやろう。お前たちがどこまで耐えられるか楽しみだな。"
en: Prattle along while you still can. I'll indulge you for a short while. It will be amusing to see how much suffering you're able to endure.
en_grezzo: "Prattle along while you still can. I'll indulge you for a short while. It will be amusing to see how much suffering you're able to endure."
it: Continua pure a blaterare. Per un poco starò al gioco. Sono curioso di vedere fin dove reggete.

jp: ヤルダバオート中心に世界が回り始める…。
jp_grezzo: "ヤルダバオート中心に世界が回り始める…。"
en: The world begins to distort, centering around Jaldabaoth...
en_grezzo: "The world begins to distort, centering around Jaldabaoth..."
it: Il mondo comincia a ruotare attorno a Jaldabaoth...

jp: 遅かったな。ちょうど神の間をシステムごと破壊し尽したところだ。少々骨が折れたが。
jp_grezzo: "遅かったな。ちょうど神の間をシステムごと破壊し尽したところだ。少々骨が折れたが。"
en: You're late. I've just managed to destroy the the Eternal Seal, system and all. Though, it was a bit of a hassle.
en_grezzo: "You're late. I've just managed to destroy the the Eternal Seal, system and all. Though, it was a bit of a hassle."
it: Arrivi tardi. Ho appena finito di distruggere il Sigillo Eterno, sistema compreso. Anche se mi è costato un po' di fatica.

jp: オルフェ…ここで神力を全解放して暴れる気か！
jp_grezzo: "オルフェ…ここで神力を全解放して暴れる気か！"
en: Orphe... So you're going to unleash all your divine power here?!
en_grezzo: "Orphe... So you're going to unleash all your divine power here?!"
it: Orphe... hai intenzione di scatenare qui tutto il tuo potere divino?!

jp: 他の神々も呼んだらどうだ？一柱ずつ、目の前でくびり殺してやろう。
jp_grezzo: "他の神々も呼んだらどうだ？一柱ずつ、目の前でくびり殺してやろう。"
en: Why not call the other gods for help? One by one, I'll snuff them out before your very eyes.
en_grezzo: "Why not call the other gods for help? One by one, I'll snuff them out before your very eyes."
it: Perché non chiami anche gli altri dei? Li strangolerò uno a uno, davanti ai tuoi occhi.

jp: それには及ばん。神の間が破壊されていた場合も想定して、こちらも用意をしてきた。…今こそ輝け、来光の牙よ！かつての戦友を止める力を！大戦の罪をあがなうための力をこの身に！
jp_grezzo: "それには及ばん。神の間が破壊されていた場合も想定して、こちらも用意をしてきた。…今こそ輝け、来光の牙よ！かつての戦友を止める力を！大戦の罪をあがなうための力をこの身に！"
en: There will be no need for that. We planned ahead in case the Eternal Seal had already been destroyed. ...Now is the time to shine, Origin of Light! Give us the power to stop our friend turned foe! Give us the power to atone for the sins of the Great War!
en_grezzo: "There will be no need for that. We planned ahead in case the Eternal Seal had already been destroyed. ...Now is the time to shine, Origin of Light! Give us the power to stop our friend turned foe! Give us the power to atone for the sins of the Great War!"
it: Non ce n'è bisogno. Avevamo previsto anche che il Sigillo Eterno fosse già distrutto, e ci siamo preparati. ...Splendi ora, zanna della luce nascente! Dammi la forza di fermare chi combatteva al mio fianco! Dammi la forza di espiare le colpe della Grande Guerra!

jp: オルフェ！我らが、お前に引導を渡す！
jp_grezzo: "オルフェ！我らが、お前に引導を渡す！"
en: Orphe! This is your final judgement!
it: Orphe! Siamo noi a pronunciare la tua fine!

jp: なるほど、全ての神々の力を一柱に集中してきたか。手間が省けるが、楽しみも減ってしまったな。
jp_grezzo: "なるほど、全ての神々の力を一柱に集中してきたか。手間が省けるが、楽しみも減ってしまったな。"
en: I see. So you've concentrated the power of all the gods into one pillar. Well, that saves me a lot of trouble, but it certainly dampens my anticipation.
en_grezzo: "I see. So you've concentrated the power of all the gods into one pillar. Well, that saves me a lot of trouble, but it certainly dampens my anticipation."
it: Ah, ecco: avete concentrato la forza di tutti gli dei in una divinità sola. Mi risparmia fatica, ma mi toglie anche il divertimento.

jp: イレギュラー、お前もこんな消化試合につき合わされるとは哀れだな。本来こんなところまで来るはずがなかったのに、だ。
jp_grezzo: "イレギュラー、お前もこんな消化試合につき合わされるとは哀れだな。本来こんなところまで来るはずがなかったのに、だ。"
en: Irregular, what a pity it is that you'll have to slog through this thrown match of ours. You were never supposed to have come this far.
en_grezzo: "Irregular, what a pity it is that you'll have to slog through this thrown match of ours. You were never supposed to have come this far."
it: Irregolare, che pena che tocchi anche a te una partita che non conta più niente. Non era previsto che arrivassi fin qui.

jp: 終わらせてやろう。この世界も、お前の冒険も。
jp_grezzo: "終わらせてやろう。この世界も、お前の冒険も。"
en: I shall end all of this right here - this world, and your adventure.
en_grezzo: "I shall end all of this right here - this world, and your adventure."
it: Metterò fine a tutto: a questo mondo e alla tua avventura.

jp: この洞窟…雨をしのぐにはちょうどいいわ。ロミアス、危険がないか奥を調べて来て。
jp_grezzo: "この洞窟…雨をしのぐにはちょうどいいわ。ロミアス、危険がないか奥を調べて来て。"
en: This cave... it's a good place to keep out of the rain. Lomias, check the inner chamber to be sure there is no danger lurking here.
en_grezzo: "This cave... it's a good place to keep out of the rain. Lomias, check the inner chamber to be sure there is no danger lurking here."
it: Questa grotta... ci ripara bene dalla pioggia. Lomias, va' in fondo a controllare che non ci siano pericoli.

jp: わかった。ここで待っていろ
jp_grezzo: "わかった。ここで待っていろ"

jp: 何かは殺された。
jp_grezzo: "何かは殺された。"

jp: 「ぐわぁ」
jp_grezzo: "「ぐわぁ」"

jp: …今の音は？ …ロミアス、大丈夫？
jp_grezzo: "…今の音は？ …ロミアス、大丈夫？"
en: ...what was that sound? ...Lomias, are you alright?
en_grezzo: "...what was that sound? ...Lomias, are you alright?"

jp: ああ、問題ない。どうやらこの洞窟は昔、誰かが住んでいたようだな。奥を見て来たが、今はもう使われていないようだ。
jp_grezzo: "ああ、問題ない。どうやらこの洞窟は昔、誰かが住んでいたようだな。奥を見て来たが、今はもう使われていないようだ。"
en: It's nothing. Looks like this cave is long abandoned. It's a good place to stay.
en_grezzo: "It's nothing. Looks like this cave is long abandoned. It's a good place to stay."
it: Niente di grave. Sembra che questa grotta sia abbandonata da tempo. Ci si può fermare.

jp: そう、ならば都合がいいわ。…あら、あなた何を持っているの？ …キャーッ、プチじゃない！
jp_grezzo: "そう、ならば都合がいいわ。…あら、あなた何を持っているの？ …キャーッ、プチじゃない！"
en: I see, that's convenient for us... wait Lomias, what are you carrying?... Argh! Putits!
en_grezzo: "I see, that's convenient for us... wait Lomias, what are you carrying?... Argh! Putits!"
it: Bene, allora ci fa comodo... aspetta, Lomias, che cosa ti porti dietro?... Aaah, dei putit!

jp: こいつらか？心配する必要はない。以前、人間にペットとして飼われていたのだろう、ふふ…私によくなついているようだ。
jp_grezzo: "こいつらか？心配する必要はない。以前、人間にペットとして飼われていたのだろう、ふふ…私によくなついているようだ。"
en: Don't worry. It appears these putits had been kept as pets by someone. They are kind of... cute.
en_grezzo: "Don't worry. It appears these putits had been kept as pets by someone. They are kind of... cute."
it: Non c'è da preoccuparsi. A quanto pare qualcuno li teneva come animali da compagnia. Sono perfino... carini.

jp: うふ！あなたにも優しいところがあるのね。…来て。どうやら怪我人が意識を取り戻したみたいよ。
jp_grezzo: "うふ！あなたにも優しいところがあるのね。…来て。どうやら怪我人が意識を取り戻したみたいよ。"
en: Huh, sounds like even you have a soft spot... Come here, the injured is about to wake up.
en_grezzo: "Huh, sounds like even you have a soft spot... Come here, the injured is about to wake up."
it: Ma guarda, hai un lato tenero anche tu... Vieni, chi abbiamo curato sta riprendendo i sensi.

jp: 夢…か…
あなたは意識をとりもどした。
jp_grezzo: "あなたは意識をとりもどした。"

jp: …意識が…もう戻ったのか？ 驚いたな。君の回復を待つために、我々の急を要する旅がいつまで中断されるのか、気を揉んでいたのだが。

en: ...you...you're awake already? Remarkable. I was beginning to worry that nursing a lowly adventurer would bring our urgent travel to a halt.

it: ...hai... hai già ripreso conoscenza? Notevole. Cominciavo a temere che l'attesa di una guarigione qualunque mandasse all'aria un viaggio che non ammette ritardi.

jp: 君は重傷を負い川辺に倒れていた。宵闇が辺りを覆う前に、癒し手の力を持つ我々に発見されたのは、全くよくできた偶然だ。
jp_grezzo: "君は重傷を負い川辺に倒れていた。宵闇が辺りを覆う前に、癒し手の力を持つ我々に発見されたのは、全くよくできた偶然だ。"
en: You were badly wounded, passed out on the bank of a river. It was fortunate that we found you before the dark mantle of night enveloped this whole valley, almost as if Ehekatl, the goddess of luck herself had her eyes upon you.
en_grezzo: "You were badly wounded, passed out on the bank of a river. It was fortunate that we found you before the dark mantle of night enveloped this whole valley, almost as if Ehekatl, the goddess of luck herself had her eyes upon you."
it: Avevi ferite gravi e giacevi senza sensi sulla riva di un fiume. È stata una fortuna che ti trovassimo prima che il manto scuro della notte coprisse tutta la valle: quasi che Ehekatl in persona, la dea della sorte, ti tenesse d'occhio.

jp: …そんな物珍しげな顔をするな。君の察する通り、我々は異形の森の民だ。エレアは…シエラ・テールの高潔なる異端者は、他種族の詮索に付き合う無駄な時間をあいにく持ち合わせていないが、君は、我々に拾われた幸運をもっと素直に喜ぶべきだな。瀕死の君を回復させることは、ここにいるラーネイレ以外の何者にも不可能だっただろう。なにせ彼女はエレアの…
jp_grezzo: " …そんな物珍しげな顔をするな。君の察する通り、我々は異形の森の民だ。エレアは…シエラ・テールの高潔なる異端者は、他種族の詮索に付き合う無駄な時間をあいにく持ち合わせていないが、君は、我々に拾われた幸運をもっと素直に喜ぶべきだな。瀕死の君を回復させることは、ここにいるラーネイレ以外の何者にも不可能だっただろう。なにせ彼女はエレアの…"
en: ...stop your curious eyes. Yes, we are children of Vindale, which they call the Heretical Forest. Though we Eleas, noble but blameless \"heretics\", aren't keen to spend idle time responding to every senseless question about our race, you should be more thankful for your fate. If it weren't for the lady Larnneire who cured your mortal wound, you wouldn't even be hearing my tirade. For the lady is no ordinary Elea and only she can...
en_grezzo: "...stop your curious eyes. Yes, we are children of Vindale, which they call the Heretical Forest. Though we Eleas, noble but blameless \"heretics\", aren't keen to spend idle time responding to every senseless question about our race, you should be more thankful for your fate. If it weren't for the lady Larnneire who cured your mortal wound, you wouldn't even be hearing my tirade. For the lady is no ordinary Elea and only she can..."
it: ...e smettila di guardarci a quel modo. Sì, siamo figli di Vindale, quella che chiamano la Foresta Eretica. Noi Elea, \"eretici\" nobili e senza colpa, non abbiamo tempo da perdere con ogni domanda sciocca sulla nostra razza; ma tu dovresti ringraziare più volentieri la sorte che ti è toccata. Se non fosse per la nobile Larnneire, che ti ha guarito una ferita mortale, non saresti nemmeno qui ad ascoltare la mia tirata. Perché lei non è un'Elea qualunque, ed è la sola che possa...

jp_grezzo: "お前は艦長の推薦を受けてここに来てんの。今更何言ってんだ？恥ずかしくないのか？ちょっとはプライド持って仕事しようや、なぁ！！！"
en: You're here on the captain's recommendation. What the hell are you talking about? Aren't you ashamed of yourself? Get out there and bust your ass with a sense of pride, kid!
en_grezzo: "You're here on the captain's recommendation. What the hell are you talking about? Aren't you ashamed of yourself? Get out there and bust your ass with a sense of pride, kid!"
it: Tu sei qui su raccomandazione del capitano. Ma che diavolo stai dicendo? Non ti vergogni? Torna là fuori e spaccati la schiena con un po' d'orgoglio, matricola!

jp: 上に掛け合ってここの仕事を減らしてもらいます！
jp_grezzo: "上に掛け合ってここの仕事を減らしてもらいます！"
en: I'll get my superiors to reduce our working hours!
en_grezzo: "I'll get my superiors to reduce our working hours!"
it: Parlerò coi superiori per farci ridurre l'orario!

jp: 全員の仕事のノウハウを共有しましょう？
jp_grezzo: "全員の仕事のノウハウを共有しましょう？"
en: Why don't we share our work expertise with one another?
en_grezzo: "Why don't we share our work expertise with one another?"
it: Perché non ci scambiamo le competenze di lavoro?

jp: みんなの意見も聞いてみるべきです！
jp_grezzo: "みんなの意見も聞いてみるべきです！"
en: We should get everyone's input on workplace matters!
en_grezzo: "We should get everyone's input on workplace matters!"
it: Bisognerebbe sentire il parere di tutti!

jp: 一度全員メンテナンスを受けませんか？
jp_grezzo: "一度全員メンテナンスを受けませんか？"
en: Why don't we all take maintenance leave?
en_grezzo: "Why don't we all take maintenance leave?"
it: Perché non andiamo tutti in manutenzione?

jp: なんかもう色々アウトですよ…
jp_grezzo: "なんかもう色々アウトですよ…"
en: I can't even begin to describe what's wrong...
en_grezzo: "I can't even begin to describe what's wrong..."
it: Qui è tutto fuori norma, non so da dove cominciare...

jp: お前を倒してニューリーダーになる！！！
jp_grezzo: "お前を倒してニューリーダーになる！！！"
en: I'll take you down and become the new boss myself!
en_grezzo: "I'll take you down and become the new boss myself!"
it: Ti faccio fuori e divento io il nuovo capo!

jp: 必要かぁ？今でも力を合わせて何とかやっていけてるだろうが！
jp_grezzo: "必要かぁ？今でも力を合わせて何とかやっていけてるだろうが！"
en: Whaddya mean \"NEED\"? We're all doing our part, and we're all pulling through! What more could you POSSIBLY need?!
en_grezzo: "Whaddya mean \"NEED\"? We're all doing our part, and we're all pulling through! What more could you POSSIBLY need?!"
it: Come sarebbe a dire \"serve\"? Ci diamo tutti da fare e tiriamo avanti lo stesso! Che altro ti SERVIREBBE, di grazia?!

jp: ああ？しょうがねえな、聞けば納得するんだな？
jp_grezzo: "ああ？しょうがねえな、聞けば納得するんだな？"
en: Heh? So if I tell you what you want you'll buzz off, right?
en_grezzo: "Heh? So if I tell you what you want you'll buzz off, right?"
it: Eh? Quindi se ti dico quello che vuoi sentire te ne vai, giusto?

jp: 改善必要！
jp_grezzo: "改善必要！"

jp: 現状問題なし
jp_grezzo: "現状問題なし"

jp: 業務連絡。これより投票プログラムを起動する。速やかに投票を行うこと。
jp_grezzo: "業務連絡。これより投票プログラムを起動する。速やかに投票を行うこと。"
en: Attention all employees: We will now execute a voting routine. Please cast your vote as soon as possible.
en_grezzo: "Attention all employees: We will now execute a voting routine. Please cast your vote as soon as possible."
it: Comunicazione di servizio. Avvio della procedura di voto. Si prega di votare al più presto.

jp: 集計開始。改善必要：1票。問題なし：1票。投票率：10％。
jp_grezzo: "集計開始。改善必要：1票。問題なし：1票。投票率：10％。"
en: Commencing final tally. Needs improvement: 1 vote. No issues: 1 vote. Percentage voted: 10%.
en_grezzo: "Commencing final tally. Needs improvement: 1 vote. No issues: 1 vote. Percentage voted: 10%."
it: Inizio dello spoglio. Serve migliorare: 1 voto. Nessun problema: 1 voto. Affluenza: 10%.

jp: 改善必要：3票。問題なし：2票。投票率：25％。
jp_grezzo: "改善必要：3票。問題なし：2票。投票率：25％。"
en: Needs improvement: 3 votes. No issues: 2 votes. Percentage voted: 25%.
en_grezzo: "Needs improvement: 3 votes. No issues: 2 votes. Percentage voted: 25%."
it: Serve migliorare: 3 voti. Nessun problema: 2 voti. Affluenza: 25%.

jp: 改善必要：7票。問題なし：3票。投票率：50％。
jp_grezzo: "改善必要：7票。問題なし：3票。投票率：50％。"
en: Needs improvement: 7 votes. No issues: 3 votes. Percentage voted: 50%.
en_grezzo: "Needs improvement: 7 votes. No issues: 3 votes. Percentage voted: 50%."
it: Serve migliorare: 7 voti. Nessun problema: 3 voti. Affluenza: 50%.

jp: 改善必要：9票。問題なし：5票。投票率：70％。
jp_grezzo: "改善必要：9票。問題なし：5票。投票率：70％。"
en: Needs improvement: 9 votes. No issues: 5 votes. Percentage voted: 70%.
en_grezzo: "Needs improvement: 9 votes. No issues: 5 votes. Percentage voted: 70%."
it: Serve migliorare: 9 voti. Nessun problema: 5 voti. Affluenza: 70%.

jp: 集計完了。結果は…。
jp_grezzo: "集計完了。結果は…。"
en: Final tally complete. The results are as follows:
en_grezzo: "Final tally complete. The results are as follows:"
it: Spoglio completato. Il risultato è il seguente:

jp: 不正だー！？
jp_grezzo: "不正だー！？"

jp: 投票率100％超えは集計ミスでは？
jp_grezzo: "投票率100％超えは集計ミスでは？"
en: Could 600% vote be a counting error?
it: Un'affluenza del 600% non è un errore di conteggio?

jp: 改善必要：15票。問題なし：105票。投票率：600％。よって現状の職場環境には問題がないと判断する。ほら、これで気が済んだろ。
jp_grezzo: "改善必要：15票。問題なし：105票。投票率：600％。よって現状の職場環境には問題がないと判断する。ほら、これで気が済んだろ。"
en: Needs improvement: 15 votes. No issues: 105 votes. Percentage voted: 600%. Therefore, we conclude that there are no issues with the current work environment. See, nothing to worry about.
en_grezzo: "Needs improvement: 15 votes. No issues: 105 votes. Percentage voted: 600%. Therefore, we conclude that there are no issues with the current work environment. See, nothing to worry about."
it: Serve migliorare: 15 voti. Nessun problema: 105 voti. Affluenza: 600%. Se ne conclude che l'ambiente di lavoro attuale non presenta problemi. Visto? Non c'era niente di cui preoccuparsi.

jp: なんだお前。おい。なら証拠でもあんのか？ないんだったらよ、投票で決まったことに文句垂れてんじゃねえ！！！お前、ホントに往生際が悪いよなぁ。恥ずかしく思えよ？
jp_grezzo: "なんだお前。おい。なら証拠でもあんのか？ないんだったらよ、投票で決まったことに文句垂れてんじゃねえ！！！お前、ホントに往生際が悪いよなぁ。恥ずかしく思えよ？"
en: ...Did you just tell me that to my face? DID YOU?! So where's your proof? ...Nothing? Then SHUT UP! Quit complaining about something that's been voted on already! Holy SHIT! What is WRONG with you?! Going off and throwing a tantrum every single time you're wrong about something... You ought to be ashamed of yourself.
en_grezzo: "...Did you just tell me that to my face? DID YOU?! So where's your proof? ...Nothing? Then SHUT UP! Quit complaining about something that's been voted on already! Holy SHIT! What is WRONG with you?! Going off and throwing a tantrum every single time you're wrong about something... You ought to be ashamed of yourself."
it: ...Me l'hai appena detto in faccia? DAVVERO?! E le prove dove sono? ...Niente? E allora STAI ZITTO! Non si contesta una cosa che è già stata messa ai voti! Ma PORCA MISERIA! Che cos'hai che non va?! Ogni volta che hai torto ti metti a fare i capricci... Dovresti vergognarti.

jp: ああ？そりゃな、俺だって完璧じゃねえからもしかするとミスがあって、既にスクラップになった連中の投票権が使われていたり、同じ奴の票が何度も重複して入っていることはあるかもしれない。
jp_grezzo: "ああ？そりゃな、俺だって完璧じゃねえからもしかするとミスがあって、既にスクラップになった連中の投票権が使われていたり、同じ奴の票が何度も重複して入っていることはあるかもしれない。"
en: What's that? I'm not perfect, so maybe I made a mistake and counted the votes of some guys who've been scrapped, or maybe I counted one guy's vote multiple times.
en_grezzo: "What's that? I'm not perfect, so maybe I made a mistake and counted the votes of some guys who've been scrapped, or maybe I counted one guy's vote multiple times."
it: Come sarebbe? Nemmeno io sono infallibile, quindi può darsi che abbia sbagliato e contato i voti di qualcuno che è già stato rottamato, o contato più volte il voto della stessa persona.

jp: でもミスがあったとしても結果に影響する程ではねえから、お前の仕事と違って！言っとくけど再集計しても結果は変わんねぇからな。
jp_grezzo: "でもミスがあったとしても結果に影響する程ではねえから、お前の仕事と違って！言っとくけど再集計しても結果は変わんねぇからな。"
en: But even if I made those mistakes, it wouldn't be enough make any difference, unlike all the mistakes YOU'VE made! And for your information, I'm not going to bother with a recount, since it wouldn't change a thing.
en_grezzo: "But even if I made those mistakes, it wouldn't be enough make any difference, unlike all the mistakes YOU'VE made! And for your information, I'm not going to bother with a recount, since it wouldn't change a thing."
it: Ma anche se avessi sbagliato, non basterebbe a cambiare il risultato, mica come gli errori che fai TU! E tanto per essere chiari, non ho nessuna intenzione di rifare lo spoglio: non cambierebbe niente.

jp: やめろ馬鹿！まるで俺らまで仕事ができねえみたいじゃねえか！お前と一緒にしないでくれるか？
jp_grezzo: "やめろ馬鹿！まるで俺らまで仕事ができねえみたいじゃねえか！お前と一緒にしないでくれるか？"
en: Knock it off, dumbass! What, you're telling ME and all those other guys out there that they're incapable of doing their jobs? Don't lump us in with you and your lazy ass!
en_grezzo: "Knock it off, dumbass! What, you're telling ME and all those other guys out there that they're incapable of doing their jobs? Don't lump us in with you and your lazy ass!"
it: Piantala, testa di rapa! Cosa, staresti dicendo a ME e a tutti quelli là fuori che non siamo capaci di fare il nostro lavoro? Non metterci nello stesso sacco con te e la tua pigrizia!

jp: 確かに年々この部署の仕事は増えてきている。でも一機あたりの負担が増えようが、ぶっ壊れる奴が出ようが、それって今までやれてた仕事量から減らす理由にはならねえから。
jp_grezzo: "確かに年々この部署の仕事は増えてきている。でも一機あたりの負担が増えようが、ぶっ壊れる奴が出ようが、それって今までやれてた仕事量から減らす理由にはならねえから。"
en: Yeah, it's true that the workload in this division is increasing every year. But even if the workload per machine increases, or if some of those machines break down, all that work's still gotta get done somehow.
en_grezzo: "Yeah, it's true that the workload in this division is increasing every year. But even if the workload per machine increases, or if some of those machines break down, all that work's still gotta get done somehow."
it: Sì, è vero che il carico di lavoro di questo reparto cresce ogni anno. Ma anche se aumenta il carico per macchina, e anche se qualche macchina va in pezzi, quel lavoro qualcuno lo deve fare lo stesso.

jp: だいたい、来て日の浅いお前にここの仕事のことが説明できるわけねえだろ。自分の仕事もちゃんと理解してないくせによ！上に掛け合うとかやめてくんない？お前みたいなのがいることが恥ずかしいんだけど。
jp_grezzo: "だいたい、来て日の浅いお前にここの仕事のことが説明できるわけねえだろ。自分の仕事もちゃんと理解してないくせによ！上に掛け合うとかやめてくんない？お前みたいなのがいることが恥ずかしいんだけど。"
en: And if anyone's going to be the one who tells us how this joint gets run, why the hell does it have to be YOU of all people? You've barely even worked here for a few days and don't even know left from right! Cut the bullshit and quit trying to talk down to us! I'm ashamed of myself for even bothering to stand in the same room as a dipshit like you.
en_grezzo: "And if anyone's going to be the one who tells us how this joint gets run, why the hell does it have to be YOU of all people? You've barely even worked here for a few days and don't even know left from right! Cut the bullshit and quit trying to talk down to us! I'm ashamed of myself for even bothering to stand in the same room as a dipshit like you."
it: E se qualcuno deve venire a dirci come si manda avanti questo posto, perché diavolo dovresti essere proprio TU? Sei qui da quattro giorni e non distingui la destra dalla sinistra! Piantala con le stronzate e smettila di farci la lezione! Mi vergogno solo a stare nella stessa stanza di un pezzo di merda come te.

jp: おい、ちょっと座れよ。
jp_grezzo: "おい、ちょっと座れよ。"

jp: 床でいいから。よく話聞けよ。
jp_grezzo: "床でいいから。よく話聞けよ。"
en: I don't give a shit if you plant your ass on the floor. Listen to me reeeeal carefully.
en_grezzo: "I don't give a shit if you plant your ass on the floor. Listen to me reeeeal carefully."
it: Non me ne frega niente se ti piazzi per terra. Adesso ascoltami beeeene.

jp: お前さ、膨大なノウハウを口頭で言いあって覚えきれると思ってんのか？違うだろ。共有するにはそれぞれが資料を用意しなきゃいけないだろ。
jp_grezzo: "お前さ、膨大なノウハウを口頭で言いあって覚えきれると思ってんのか？違うだろ。共有するにはそれぞれが資料を用意しなきゃいけないだろ。"
en: Do you think you can cram all of that workplace-related knowledge into that pathetic brain of yours just by running your mouth for a while? Nope, you can't. In order to do that proper, you'd have to bring your own notes and materials to the meeting.
en_grezzo: "Do you think you can cram all of that workplace-related knowledge into that pathetic brain of yours just by running your mouth for a while? Nope, you can't. In order to do that proper, you'd have to bring your own notes and materials to the meeting."
it: Credi davvero di poterti ficcare tutto il mestiere in quel cervello da quattro soldi solo stando a chiacchierare? No che non ci riesci. Per farlo come si deve, ognuno dovrebbe portarsi appunti e materiale alla riunione.

jp: そりゃ何もわかってなくて比較的暇な新入りにはメリットが大きいかもしれないよ？でもそんなことする暇が他のみんなにあるように見えるか？…見えるんだろうなぁ！
jp_grezzo: "そりゃ何もわかってなくて比較的暇な新入りにはメリットが大きいかもしれないよ？でもそんなことする暇が他のみんなにあるように見えるか？…見えるんだろうなぁ！"
en: Of course, that would be a pretty sweet deal for a new kid like you with barely any work assignments and a lot of free time. But what about everyone else around here? ...Are you blind? Do those eyes of yours even WORK?
en_grezzo: "Of course, that would be a pretty sweet deal for a new kid like you with barely any work assignments and a lot of free time. But what about everyone else around here? ...Are you blind? Do those eyes of yours even WORK?"
it: Certo, per una matricola come te, che ha pochi incarichi e un sacco di tempo libero, sarebbe un affarone. Ma tutti gli altri qui dentro? ...Ma non ci vedi? Ce li hai due occhi che FUNZIONANO?

jp: 時間的に余裕がある状況ならまだわかる。でも知ってるか？お前以外がやってる仕事は全部期限があるの。お前だけだよ自分のペースで仕事できるのは。
jp_grezzo: "時間的に余裕がある状況ならまだわかる。でも知ってるか？お前以外がやってる仕事は全部期限があるの。お前だけだよ自分のペースで仕事できるのは。"
en: I can see where you're coming from if you have a lot of extra time on your hands. But you know what? Every single work assignment that everyone else in this place is busting their asses over has this thing called a \"deadline\". Might of heard of it, yeah? You're the only one in this joint who can work at their own pace.
en_grezzo: "I can see where you're coming from if you have a lot of extra time on your hands. But you know what? Every single work assignment that everyone else in this place is busting their asses over has this thing called a \"deadline\". Might of heard of it, yeah? You're the only one in this joint who can work at their own pace."
it: Capirei il discorso se uno avesse tempo da buttare. Ma sai che c'è? Ogni singolo incarico su cui tutti gli altri si stanno spaccando la schiena ha una cosa che si chiama \"scadenza\". Ne avrai sentito parlare, no? Qui dentro sei l'unica persona che può lavorare col proprio comodo.

jp: ノウハウを残すのは大事だよ。でも今の状況では超余計な作業だと思うんだけど？全体でどんくらい時間のロスが出ると思ってる？ちょっとお前考えが甘いよね。
jp_grezzo: "ノウハウを残すのは大事だよ。でも今の状況では超余計な作業だと思うんだけど？全体でどんくらい時間のロスが出ると思ってる？ちょっとお前考えが甘いよね。"
en: Yeah, I get that it's important to preserve your precious knowhow about the ins and outs of the job. But with things the way they are, isn't it just even more work that nobody actually needs to do? All you'll be doing is forcing everyone to adapt to YOUR schedule and constantly make up for lost time. Real genius plan you've got there. Quit overthinking things and get back to work.
en_grezzo: "Yeah, I get that it's important to preserve your precious knowhow about the ins and outs of the job. But with things the way they are, isn't it just even more work that nobody actually needs to do? All you'll be doing is forcing everyone to adapt to YOUR schedule and constantly make up for lost time. Real genius plan you've got there. Quit overthinking things and get back to work."
it: Sì, ho capito che è importante mettere per iscritto il prezioso mestiere. Ma messe così le cose, non è solo altro lavoro che nessuno ha bisogno di fare? L'unico risultato è costringere tutti ad adattarsi ai TUOI tempi e a rincorrere le ore perse. Un piano geniale, non c'è che dire. Smettila di farti tanti pensieri e torna a lavorare.

jp: お前そんなこと言って休みたいだけだろ。メンテナンスって簡単に言うけど結構時間かかるからね？目の前の仕事と将来的な健康、どっちが優先されるべきかわかる？優先順位くらい、考えて話せって言ってんだよ！！
jp_grezzo: "お前そんなこと言って休みたいだけだろ。メンテナンスって簡単に言うけど結構時間かかるからね？目の前の仕事と将来的な健康、どっちが優先されるべきかわかる？優先順位くらい、考えて話せって言ってんだよ！！"
en: You're just saying that so you can slack off, aren't you? You can blabble on about \"maintenance leave, maintenance leave\" all you want, but it's a pretty lengthy process, you know? What do you think should be more important: The job that needs to get done right now, or your health at some undefined point in the future? What I'm trying to drill into your dumbass brain is: figure out what YOUR priorities are and speak up for them!
en_grezzo: "You're just saying that so you can slack off, aren't you? You can blabble on about \"maintenance leave, maintenance leave\" all you want, but it's a pretty lengthy process, you know? What do you think should be more important: The job that needs to get done right now, or your health at some undefined point in the future? What I'm trying to drill into your dumbass brain is: figure out what YOUR priorities are and speak up for them!"
it: Lo dici solo per battere la fiacca, vero? Puoi ripetere \"manutenzione, manutenzione\" quanto ti pare, ma è una faccenda lunga, lo sai? Secondo te che cosa conta di più: il lavoro da consegnare adesso, o la tua salute in un domani che non si sa quando? Quello che sto cercando di ficcarti in quella zucca vuota è: decidi quali sono le TUE priorità e difendile!

jp: みんなも調子悪いみたいですよ
jp_grezzo: "みんなも調子悪いみたいですよ"
en: Everyone else seems to be in bad shape, too.
en_grezzo: "Everyone else seems to be in bad shape, too."
it: Anche gli altri non sembrano stare bene

jp: やばい病気かもしれないし念のため！
jp_grezzo: "やばい病気かもしれないし念のため！"
en: It could be a serious illness! Just in case!
en_grezzo: "It could be a serious illness! Just in case!"
it: Potrebbe essere una brutta malattia, per sicurezza!

jp: …お前にだけ言うけど、俺最近ちょっと調子悪いんだよね。部署全体の仕事の進みが遅くって遅くってまじ頭いてえの。だからこそ、のんびりメンテナンスなんて受けてる暇ないと思ってるから。
jp_grezzo: "…お前にだけ言うけど、俺最近ちょっと調子悪いんだよね。部署全体の仕事の進みが遅くって遅くってまじ頭いてえの。だからこそ、のんびりメンテナンスなんて受けてる暇ないと思ってるから。"
en: ...Between you and me, I've been feeling pretty under the weather myself lately. The whole division's been working so slowly that it's really starting to piss me off. But that's exactly the reason why I don't think we can afford to take a maintenance leave.
en_grezzo: "...Between you and me, I've been feeling pretty under the weather myself lately. The whole division's been working so slowly that it's really starting to piss me off. But that's exactly the reason why I don't think we can afford to take a maintenance leave."
it: ...Lo dico solo a te: da un po' non mi sento tanto bene neanch'io. Tutto il reparto va avanti così a rilento che mi fa girare le scatole. Ed è proprio per questo che non credo possiamo permetterci di andare in manutenzione.

jp: ハッ、たったこんだけの仕事しかしてない奴らが、調子悪くなるわけねえだろ！昔はもっと仕事量が多かったんだぞ。この程度で壊れるような奴はどっちにしろ使いもんにならねえからな！
jp_grezzo: "ハッ、たったこんだけの仕事しかしてない奴らが、調子悪くなるわけねえだろ！昔はもっと仕事量が多かったんだぞ。この程度で壊れるような奴はどっちにしろ使いもんにならねえからな！"
en: Pfft! How can they be in bad shape when they've barely got any work to do? We had to work a lot harder back in the day. If all they're going to do is piss off when given THIS amount of work, then they were all worthless dipshits from the start!
en_grezzo: "Pfft! How can they be in bad shape when they've barely got any work to do? We had to work a lot harder back in the day. If all they're going to do is piss off when given THIS amount of work, then they were all worthless dipshits from the start!"

jp: 灼熱の塔は1組の夫妻が支配している。前に挑戦した奴の話だと、妻である赤き義眼の『クルイツゥア』はレベル24。夫の鋼鉄竜『コルゴン』はレベル16らしい。
jp_grezzo: "灼熱の塔は1組の夫妻が支配している。前に挑戦した奴の話だと、妻である赤き義眼の『クルイツゥア』はレベル24。夫の鋼鉄竜『コルゴン』はレベル16らしい。"
en: The Tower of Fire is ruled by a team of husband and wife. According to the last person who challenged them to battle, the wife, Quruiza, is level 24, and the husband, Corgon, is level 16.
en_grezzo: "The Tower of Fire is ruled by a team of husband and wife. According to the last person who challenged them to battle, the wife, Quruiza, is level 24, and the husband, Corgon, is level 16."
it: La Torre Rovente è nelle mani di una coppia di sposi. Stando a chi li ha sfidati prima di te, la moglie, Quruiza dall'occhio finto, è di livello 24, e il marito, Corgon il drago d'acciaio, di livello 16.

jp: クルイツゥアは逃げ回りながら冷気や暗黒の魔法を撃ってくるって話。そう、灼熱の塔を攻略するには、火炎だけじゃなくて冷気と暗黒にもある程度耐性が必要ってこと。
jp_grezzo: "クルイツゥアは逃げ回りながら冷気や暗黒の魔法を撃ってくるって話" + _da(3) + "。そう、灼熱の塔を攻略するには、火炎だけじゃなくて冷気と暗黒にもある程度耐性が必要ってこと" + _dana(3) + "。"
en: I've heard that Quruiza casts cold and darkness magic while darting around. So in order to conquer the Tower of Fire, you need to have some resistance to cold and darkness as well as fire.
en_grezzo: "I've heard that Quruiza casts cold and darkness magic while darting around. So in order to conquer the Tower of Fire, you need to have some resistance to cold and darkness as well as fire."
it: Pare che Quruiza scappi in giro tirando magie di gelo e oscurità. Ecco: per venire a capo della Torre Rovente non basta la resistenza al fuoco, ci vuole anche un po' di resistenza al gelo e all'oscurità.

jp: コルゴンは竜なので妻よりずっとタフだけど、近づいて殴ってくるだけで動きも遅いらしい。テレポートでコルゴンを翻弄しつつ、先にクルイツゥアを集中攻撃したほうがいいんじゃない？
jp_grezzo: "コルゴンは竜なので妻よりずっとタフだけど、近づいて殴ってくるだけで動きも遅いらしい。テレポートでコルゴンを翻弄しつつ、先にクルイツゥアを集中攻撃したほうがいいんじゃない" + _kana(3) + "？"
en: Corgon is a dragon, so he's much tougher than his wife, but I've heard that he just moves in to hit you, and his movements are pretty slow. I think it's better to focus your attacks on Corgon first while using teleportation to keep Quruiza at bay.
en_grezzo: "Corgon is a dragon, so he's much tougher than his wife, but I've heard that he just moves in to hit you, and his movements are pretty slow. I think it's better to focus your attacks on Corgon first while using teleportation to keep Quruiza at bay."
it: Corgon è un drago, quindi è molto più duro della moglie, ma a quanto pare si limita ad avvicinarsi e a menare, e si muove piano. Meglio tenere Corgon a bada col teletrasporto e concentrare prima gli attacchi su Quruiza, no?

jp: 接近戦がやりづらいだろうから、強力な遠距離攻撃があるとスムーズかもしれない。あの灼熱の塔に住めるだけあって、どちらも火炎には滅法強いらしいけど、コルゴンのほうは電撃と魔法にも強いそう。
jp_grezzo: "接近戦がやりづらいだろうから、強力な遠距離攻撃があるとスムーズかもしれない" + _na(3) + "。あの灼熱の塔に住めるだけあって、どちらも火炎には滅法強いらしいけど、コルゴンのほうは電撃と魔法にも強いそう" + _da(3) + "。"
en: Close-quarters combat with those two would prove difficult, so a powerful long-distance attack might help you smooth things out. I've heard that the couple is extremely resistant to fire, given that they live in, you know, the Tower of Fire, but I've also heard that Corgon is resistant to electric and magic attacks as well.
en_grezzo: "Close-quarters combat with those two would prove difficult, so a powerful long-distance attack might help you smooth things out. I've heard that the couple is extremely resistant to fire, given that they live in, you know, the Tower of Fire, but I've also heard that Corgon is resistant to electric and magic attacks as well."
it: Il corpo a corpo sarà difficile, quindi con un attacco a distanza potente le cose filano più lisce. Vivono nella Torre Rovente, quindi al fuoco resistono tutti e due in modo esagerato; ma Corgon regge bene anche il fulmine e la magia.

jp: 情報によると古城の主『ワイナン』はレベル25。強力な地獄武器を持っているけど、基本は逃げ回りながら冷気や暗黒の魔法を撃ってくる。挑むなら地獄、冷気、暗黒の耐性が少しはあったほうがいい。
jp_grezzo: "情報によると古城の主『ワイナン』はレベル25。強力な地獄武器を持っているけど、基本は逃げ回りながら冷気や暗黒の魔法を撃ってくる。挑むなら地獄、冷気、暗黒の耐性が少しはあったほうがいい" + _na(3) + "。"
en: According to my information, <Wynan> the lord of the Ancient Castle is level 25, and although he has a powerful hell element weapon, he mainly flies around and casts cold and dark magic. If you want to challenge him, you'd better have some resistance to hell, cold, and dark magic.
en_grezzo: "According to my information, <Wynan> the lord of the Ancient Castle is level 25, and although he has a powerful hell element weapon, he mainly flies around and casts cold and dark magic. If you want to challenge him, you'd better have some resistance to hell, cold, and dark magic."
it: Stando alle mie informazioni, Wynan, il signore del Castello Antico, è di livello 25. Ha un'arma potente d'oltretomba, ma per lo più scappa in giro tirando magie di gelo e oscurità. Se vuoi sfidarlo, meglio avere un po' di resistenza a oltretomba, gelo e oscurità.

jp: 本人の守りは弱く、地獄にしか耐性がないらしいけど、取り巻きのチェスの駒が邪魔をしてくる。<キング>を処理しないと、次々に敵を呼ばれてジリ貧になるって話。
jp_grezzo: "本人の守りは弱く、地獄にしか耐性がないらしいけど、取り巻きのチェスの駒が邪魔をしてくる。<キング>を処理しないと、次々に敵を呼ばれてジリ貧になるって話" + _da(3) + "。"
en: It seems that his own defense is weak and he only carries resistance to hell magic, but his chess piece cronies will block your path. If you don't deal with the <King> quickly enough, he'll summon more and more backup, and you'll eventually run out of luck.
en_grezzo: "It seems that his own defense is weak and he only carries resistance to hell magic, but his chess piece cronies will block your path. If you don't deal with the <King> quickly enough, he'll summon more and more backup, and you'll eventually run out of luck."
it: Lui in sé si difende male, e pare che resista solo all'oltretomba; ma i pezzi degli scacchi che si porta dietro ti tagliano la strada. Se non fai fuori il <Re>, continua a chiamare nemici e finisci per consumarti.

jp: 変化の杖や突然変異のポーションで別のモンスターに変えれば、1ターンで済む。通らない場合は集中攻撃で急いで<キング>を倒すこと。
jp_grezzo: "変化の杖や突然変異のポーションで別のモンスターに変えれば、1ターンで済む。通らない場合は集中攻撃で急いで<キング>を倒すこと" + _dana(3) + "。"
en: If you can use a rod of change creature or a potion of mutation to change him into another monster, you can finish him off in a single turn. If that won't work, make sure that you waste no time in focusing your attacks on the <King>.
en_grezzo: "If you can use a rod of change creature or a potion of mutation to change him into another monster, you can finish him off in a single turn. If that won't work, make sure that you waste no time in focusing your attacks on the <King>."
it: Se lo trasformi in un altro mostro con una bacchetta di mutamento di creatura o una pozione di mutazione, basta un turno. Se non passa, allora fuori il <Re> in fretta, concentrando gli attacchi.

jp: 死者の洞窟に行くの？命知らず。逃げ帰ってきた奴の話では、闇の奇形『イスシズル』はレベル28。
jp_grezzo: "死者の洞窟に行くの" + _ka(3) + "？命知らず" + _dana(3) + "。逃げ帰ってきた奴の話では、闇の奇形『イスシズル』はレベル28。"
