en: You're pretty daring to think of taking on the Crypt of the Dead. According to the last adventurer that went in and escaped with his life, <Issizzle> the dark abomination is level 28.
en_grezzo: "You're pretty daring to think of taking on the Crypt of the Dead. According to the last adventurer that went in and escaped with his life, <Issizzle> the dark abomination is level 28."
it: Vai alla grotta dei morti? Che sprezzo del pericolo. Stando a uno che è tornato scappando, Issizzle l'aberrazione oscura è di livello 28.

jp: テレポートしつつ冷気や暗黒の魔法を放ってきたらしい。装備の力で魔法が増幅されているらしく、とんでもない威力だと言っていた。冷気と暗黒の耐性をそれなりに高めていかないと瞬殺されるかもしれない。耐性が足りない場合は属性耐性のポーションも試してみて。
jp_grezzo: "テレポートしつつ冷気や暗黒の魔法を放ってきたらしい。装備の力で魔法が増幅されているらしく、とんでもない威力だと言っていた" + _na(3) + "。冷気と暗黒の耐性をそれなりに高めていかないと瞬殺されるかもしれない。耐性が足りない場合は属性耐性のポーションも試してみて" + _kure(3) + "。"
en: It seemed that he teleported around while casting cold and dark magic. Apparently, the magic he casts is amplified by the power of his equipment, and the guy said it's incredibly powerful. If you don't have enough resistance to cold and darkness, you might be instantly killed. If you don't have enough resistance, try drinking some potions of resistance.
en_grezzo: "It seemed that he teleported around while casting cold and dark magic. Apparently, the magic he casts is amplified by the power of his equipment, and the guy said it's incredibly powerful. If you don't have enough resistance to cold and darkness, you might be instantly killed. If you don't have enough resistance, try drinking some potions of resistance."
it: Pare che si teletrasporti in continuazione tirando magie di gelo e oscurità. La magia gli viene amplificata dall'equipaggiamento, e diceva che la potenza è fuori misura. Se non alzi bene la resistenza al gelo e all'oscurità rischi di morire sul colpo. Se non basta, prova anche con le pozioni di resistenza.

jp: 挑戦者は暗黒、地獄、神経属性で反撃したがほとんど効いてなかったとも言っていた。もし、神や不死者に威力を発揮する武器があれば活躍するんだろうけど、無い物ねだりをしても仕方がない。
jp_grezzo: "挑戦者は暗黒、地獄、神経属性で反撃したがほとんど効いてなかったとも言っていた" + _yo(3) + "。もし、神や不死者に威力を発揮する武器があれば活躍するんだろうけど、無い物ねだりをしても仕方がない" + _na(3) + "。"
en: The brave soul also said he fought back with the darkness, hell, and nerve attributes, but they hardly made a scratch. If you have a weapon that's powerful against gods and immortals that would certainly come in handy, but I guess there's no point in begging for what you don't have.
en_grezzo: "The brave soul also said he fought back with the darkness, hell, and nerve attributes, but they hardly made a scratch. If you have a weapon that's powerful against gods and immortals that would certainly come in handy, but I guess there's no point in begging for what you don't have."
it: Lo sfidante diceva anche di aver risposto con oscurità, oltretomba e nervi, e che non gli facevano quasi niente. Se avessi un'arma che picchia forte sugli dei e sui non morti sarebbe un'altra storia, ma inutile chiedere quel che non c'è.

jp: 噂だとザナンの暗殺部隊がレシマスを侵攻しているらしい。奴らはレベル25だけど、気配消しと光学迷彩で姿が見えない、不可視の部隊。
jp_grezzo: "噂だとザナンの暗殺部隊がレシマスを侵攻しているらしい。奴らはレベル25だけど、気配消しと光学迷彩で姿が見えない、不可視の部隊" + _da(3) + "。"
en: Rumor has it that a Xanan assassination squad is invading Lesimas. They're level 25, but they also use stealth and optical camouflage to hide themselves, so they'll be invisible to the naked eye.
en_grezzo: "Rumor has it that a Xanan assassination squad is invading Lesimas. They're level 25, but they also use stealth and optical camouflage to hide themselves, so they'll be invisible to the naked eye."
it: Gira voce che una squadra di assassini di Zanan stia invadendo Lesimas. Sono di livello 25, ma cancellano la propria presenza e si mimetizzano otticamente: una squadra invisibile.

jp: レシマスを進めば確実に襲われる。特殊な歩法で一瞬で接近してくるから、距離をとって戦うのも難しいはず。
jp_grezzo: "レシマスを進めば確実に襲われる" + _daro(3) + "。特殊な歩法で一瞬で接近してくるから、距離をとって戦うのも難しいはず。"
en: If you delve further into Lesimas, you're bound to run into them eventually. Since they're specially trained not to give away their presence as they approach, it's going to be tough to fight them from a distance.
en_grezzo: "If you delve further into Lesimas, you're bound to run into them eventually. Since they're specially trained not to give away their presence as they approach, it's going to be tough to fight them from a distance."
it: Se scendi in Lesimas ti assaltano di sicuro. Si avvicinano in un attimo con un passo speciale, quindi tenerli a distanza sarà difficile.

jp: 恐ろしい連中だけど、物質感知の魔法や巻物で位置はわかるし、水魔法やポーションをぶつけて濡らせば透明状態を解除できる。もし透明なものを視られるようになる装備があれば最高。
jp_grezzo: "恐ろしい連中だけど、物質感知の魔法や巻物で位置はわかるし、水魔法やポーションをぶつけて濡らせば透明状態を解除できる" + _yo(3) + "。もし透明なものを視られるようになる装備があれば最高" + _dana(3) + "。"
en: They're a fearsome bunch, but you can figure out where they are by casting Sense Object, and you can counter their invisibility by hitting them with water magic and potions to get them wet. If you could get your hands on some equipment that lets you see invisible objects, that would be the best option.
en_grezzo: "They're a fearsome bunch, but you can figure out where they are by casting Sense Object, and you can counter their invisibility by hitting them with water magic and potions to get them wet. If you could get your hands on some equipment that lets you see invisible objects, that would be the best option."
it: Sono gente da paura, ma con la magia o la pergamena di Percezione oggetti si capisce dove sono, e se li bagni con la magia dell'acqua o con una pozione l'invisibilità salta. Se hai un equipaggiamento che fa vedere le cose invisibili, meglio di così non si può.

jp: 暗殺部隊は複数のチームに分かれて行動しているらしいから、ひとつ撃破しても気を抜いてはいけない。…それと、部隊の中に白い面をつけた女がいたら用心。ここだけの話、ザナン皇家に拾われたイカれた殺人鬼が混ざっているらしい。
jp_grezzo: "暗殺部隊は複数のチームに分かれて行動しているらしいから、ひとつ撃破しても気を抜いてはいけない" + _yo(3) + "。…それと、部隊の中に白い面をつけた女がいたら用心" + _siro(3) + "。ここだけの話、ザナン皇家に拾われたイカれた殺人鬼が混ざっているらしい。"
en: I heard that the assassination squad is divided into several different teams, so don't let your guard down even after you manage to wipe one of them out. ...Also, if you see a woman wearing a white mask among the troops, be careful. Between you and me, it seems that there's some kind of homicidal maniac in the group who was scouted by the Zanan imperial family.
en_grezzo: "I heard that the assassination squad is divided into several different teams, so don't let your guard down even after you manage to wipe one of them out. ...Also, if you see a woman wearing a white mask among the troops, be careful. Between you and me, it seems that there's some kind of homicidal maniac in the group who was scouted by the Zanan imperial family."
it: Pare che la squadra si divida in più gruppi, quindi anche dopo averne battuto uno non abbassare la guardia. ...E poi: se fra loro c'è una donna con una maschera bianca, sta' in guardia. Qui fra noi: pare che ci sia in mezzo un'assassina fuori di testa, raccolta dalla casa imperiale di Zanan.

jp: 白面の『アルサピア』はレベル35。透明能力はないけど、踊るように通常攻撃を回避し、強烈なカウンターで標的を仕留めると言われている。ウワサ通りなら、矢や弾丸にすらカウンターしてくるとんでもない女。
jp_grezzo: "白面の『アルサピア』はレベル35。透明能力はないけど、踊るように通常攻撃を回避し、強烈なカウンターで標的を仕留めると言われている。ウワサ通りなら、矢や弾丸にすらカウンターしてくるとんでもない女" + _da(3) + "。"
en: <Alsapia> the murderer mask is level 35. She doesn't have invisibility, but she is said to evade normal attacks as if she were dancing, and to finish off her targets with powerful counters. If the rumors are true, she's one hell of a femme fatale, who's so strong that she can counter arrows and bullets.
en_grezzo: "<Alsapia> the murderer mask is level 35. She doesn't have invisibility, but she is said to evade normal attacks as if she were dancing, and to finish off her targets with powerful counters. If the rumors are true, she's one hell of a femme fatale, who's so strong that she can counter arrows and bullets."
it: Alsapia la maschera bianca è di livello 35. Non è invisibile, ma dicono che schivi gli attacchi normali come se ballasse, e che chiuda la partita con contraccolpi tremendi. Se le voci sono vere contrattacca perfino alle frecce e ai proiettili: una donna spaventosa.

jp: もし戦うことになったら魔法や技能などの回避不能攻撃で攻めるといい。状態異常の「束縛」で通常攻撃を回避できないようにするのも手ではある。
jp_grezzo: "もし戦うことになったら魔法や技能などの回避不能攻撃で攻めるといい。状態異常の「束縛」で通常攻撃を回避できないようにするのも手ではある。"
en: If you have to fight her, you should attack her with unavoidable techniques such as magic and skills. You could also apply the \"binding\" status effect on her so she can't dodge your normal attacks.
en_grezzo: "If you have to fight her, you should attack her with unavoidable techniques such as magic and skills. You could also apply the \"binding\" status effect on her so she can't dodge your normal attacks."
it: Se ti tocca combatterla, attaccala con quel che non si può schivare: magie e abilità. Un'altra via è metterle addosso lo stato di \"costrizione\", così gli attacchi normali non li schiva più.

jp: 束縛できないなら、通常攻撃する仲間には防御を指示しておくべき。防御の指示？コマンドフラッグで一括でやるか、技能の戦術指示で個別にやればいい？ああ、そうそう。暗殺部隊はアルサピア含め特に属性耐性は持っていないみたい。
jp_grezzo: "束縛できないなら、通常攻撃する仲間には防御を指示しておくべき" + _da(3) + "。防御の指示？コマンドフラッグで一括でやるか、技能の戦術指示で個別にやればいい" + _daro(3) + "？ああ、そうそう。暗殺部隊はアルサピア含め特に属性耐性は持っていないみたい" + _da(3) + "。"
en: If you're unable to bind her somehow, you should instruct your melee attacking companions to defend themselves. How to instruct them to defend? Why not use a command flag to give orders to everyone at once, or send orders to your companions individually by using the Directive skill? Ah, one more thing. Apparently, the entire assassination squad - including Alsapia - doesn't have resistance to any elemental damage in particular.
en_grezzo: "If you're unable to bind her somehow, you should instruct your melee attacking companions to defend themselves. How to instruct them to defend? Why not use a command flag to give orders to everyone at once, or send orders to your companions individually by using the Directive skill? Ah, one more thing. Apparently, the entire assassination squad - including Alsapia - doesn't have resistance to any elemental damage in particular."
it: Se non riesci a costringerla, ai compagni che attaccano di forza conviene ordinare la difesa. Come si ordina? Con la bandiera di comando tutti insieme, oppure uno per uno con l'abilità Ordini tattici. Ah, giusto: la squadra di assassini, Alsapia compresa, non pare avere resistenze di elemento particolari.

jp: 少し怖い話をしてあげ。
jp_grezzo: "少し怖い話をしてあげ" + _ru(3) + "。"
en: I'm going to tell you a story that's a little scary.
en_grezzo: "I'm going to tell you a story that's a little scary."
it: Ti racconto una storia un po' spaventosa.

jp: レシマスには、古代より多くの調査隊が向かっては命を散らしている。そう、出るん。調査兵のアンデッドが。
jp_grezzo: "レシマスには、古代より多くの調査隊が向かっては命を散らしている。そう、出るん" + _da(3) + "。調査兵のアンデッドが。"
en: Since ancient times, Lesimas has seen its fair share of expedition groups, and has claimed the lives of many. And what do you think happens to their dead bodies? Right - they rise from the grave.
en_grezzo: "Since ancient times, Lesimas has seen its fair share of expedition groups, and has claimed the lives of many. And what do you think happens to their dead bodies? Right - they rise from the grave."
it: A Lesimas, fin dall'antichità, sono andate molte spedizioni, e ci hanno lasciato la vita. Ecco: escono. I non morti delle squadre di esplorazione.

jp: 奴らは死んだことに気づかず今も調査を続けている。邪魔をした者は、身体を麻痺させられ地獄の吐息で嬲り殺しにされるん。抵抗しようともがいても、霧の中の幻には攻撃が届かない…。
jp_grezzo: "奴らは死んだことに気づかず今も調査を続けている。邪魔をした者は、身体を麻痺させられ地獄の吐息で嬲り殺しにされるん" + _da(3) + "。抵抗しようともがいても、霧の中の幻には攻撃が届かない…。"
en: The poor lads aren't even aware that they've passed on, and continue their investigations like everything's just dandy. Anyone who gets in their way will face a horrific end as they're paralyzed and tortured to death by the breath of hell. No matter how much you struggle or resist, your attacks won't reach the phantoms in the mist...
en_grezzo: "The poor lads aren't even aware that they've passed on, and continue their investigations like everything's just dandy. Anyone who gets in their way will face a horrific end as they're paralyzed and tortured to death by the breath of hell. No matter how much you struggle or resist, your attacks won't reach the phantoms in the mist..."
it: Non si sono accorti di essere morti e continuano a esplorare ancora oggi. Chi li ostacola si ritrova il corpo paralizzato, e muore torturato dal soffio d'oltretomba. E per quanto ti dibatta, agli spettri dentro la nebbia gli attacchi non arrivano...

jp: …麻痺を無効化する装備か守護石の魔法、宝石絢爛のポーションがあれば予防できるんじゃない？もちろん、神経や地獄の耐性が低いとダメージに耐えきれない可能性は。
jp_grezzo: "…麻痺を無効化する装備か守護石の魔法、宝石絢爛のポーションがあれば予防できるんじゃない" + _ka(3) + "？もちろん、神経や地獄の耐性が低いとダメージに耐えきれない可能性は" + _aru(3) + "。"
en: ...If you have equipment that nullifies paralysis, or know the Gem Power spell, or perhaps have a potion of gem on hand, you should be able to prevent yourself from meeting such a fateful end. Of course, if your resistance to nerve and hell damage is low, there's a chance you won't be able to withstand the damage.
en_grezzo: "...If you have equipment that nullifies paralysis, or know the Gem Power spell, or perhaps have a potion of gem on hand, you should be able to prevent yourself from meeting such a fateful end. Of course, if your resistance to nerve and hell damage is low, there's a chance you won't be able to withstand the damage."
it: ...Con un equipaggiamento che annulla la paralisi, o con la magia Pietra protettrice, o con una pozione di gemma, si può prevenire, no? Certo, se hai basse le resistenze ai nervi e all'oltretomba, il danno potresti non reggerlo.

jp: アンデッドということは火に弱いから、強力な火炎属性攻撃があるなら楽勝だと思う。逆に暗黒、地獄、神経属性は効かない。物理攻撃が当たりにくくなる霧を出すらしいけど、火炎瓶や蜘蛛の巣で霧は散らせる。
jp_grezzo: "アンデッドということは火に弱いから、強力な火炎属性攻撃があるなら楽勝だと思う" + _yo(3) + "。逆に暗黒、地獄、神経属性は効かない" + _daro(3) + "。物理攻撃が当たりにくくなる霧を出すらしいけど、火炎瓶や蜘蛛の巣で霧は散らせる" + _yo(3) + "。"
en: Being a plodding mass of rotting limbs means that you're vulnerable to fire, so if you have a powerful flame attribute attack, you'll win easily. On the other hand, the dark, hell, and nerve attributes won't do much. I've heard that those undead produce some kind of mist that makes it harder for physical attacks to hit them, but you can disperse the fog with molotov cocktails or spider webs.
en_grezzo: "Being a plodding mass of rotting limbs means that you're vulnerable to fire, so if you have a powerful flame attribute attack, you'll win easily. On the other hand, the dark, hell, and nerve attributes won't do much. I've heard that those undead produce some kind of mist that makes it harder for physical attacks to hit them, but you can disperse the fog with molotov cocktails or spider webs."
it: Essendo non morti, il fuoco li fa soffrire: con un attacco potente d'elemento fuoco secondo me è vinta facile. Al contrario oscurità, oltretomba e nervi non fanno niente. Pare che tirino fuori una nebbia che fa mancare i colpi fisici, ma la nebbia si disperde con le molotov o con le ragnatele.

jp: ゼームはパルミアでも高名な魔術士だった。彼の研究のひとつに、心を持った魔力仕掛けのガーディアンがあった。名前は確か…魔鋼の番兵『ギルフェム』。
jp_grezzo: "ゼームはパルミアでも高名な魔術士だった。彼の研究のひとつに、心を持った魔力仕掛けのガーディアンがあった。名前は確か…魔鋼の番兵『ギルフェム』。"
en: Zeome was a highly respected sorcerer in Palmia. One of his studies was related to a magical device guardian with a mind of its own. I believe its name was... <Gilphem> the magic steel.
en_grezzo: "Zeome was a highly respected sorcerer in Palmia. One of his studies was related to a magical device guardian with a mind of its own. I believe its name was... <Gilphem> the magic steel."
it: Zeome era un mago famoso perfino a Palmia. Una delle sue ricerche era un guardiano a congegno magico dotato di mente. Il nome, se non sbaglio, era... Gilphem, la sentinella d'acciaio magico.

jp: 王家にいた頃はどうしても完成させることができず悩んでいたそう。そんな彼が《常闇の眼》の膨大な情報を得たら？当然ギルフェムを完成させているはず。
jp_grezzo: "王家にいた頃はどうしても完成させることができず悩んでいたそう" + _da(3) + "。そんな彼が《常闇の眼》の膨大な情報を得たら？当然ギルフェムを完成させているはず。"
en: Back when Zeome was still a part of the royal family, he was troubled by the fact that he just couldn't seem to finish his research. So what would happen if such a troubled soul got hold of the vast amount of information held within the <Origin of Vice>? Naturally, he would have been able to bring Gilphem into the world.
en_grezzo: "Back when Zeome was still a part of the royal family, he was troubled by the fact that he just couldn't seem to finish his research. So what would happen if such a troubled soul got hold of the vast amount of information held within the <Origin of Vice>? Naturally, he would have been able to bring Gilphem into the world."
it: Ai tempi in cui stava con la casa reale non riusciva a portarlo a termine, e ci si tormentava. E se uno così mettesse le mani sulla massa di informazioni dell'<occhio delle tenebre eterne>? Ovvio: Gilphem l'ha finito.

jp: 研究段階でも魔法対策を施されていて、魔法属性の魔法…特に魔法の矢なんか全然効かなかったらしい。他の属性魔法なら多少は効くかもしれない。
jp_grezzo: "研究段階でも魔法対策を施されていて、魔法属性の魔法…特に魔法の矢なんか全然効かなかったらしい" + _na(3) + "。他の属性魔法なら多少は効くかもしれない。"
en: I've heard that, even though it's basically a research prototype, it was given special countermeasures against magic, and anything with a magic attribute... especially Magic Dart... it didn't do a thing. Perhaps if it's magic of another attribute, it might have a little effect.
en_grezzo: "I've heard that, even though it's basically a research prototype, it was given special countermeasures against magic, and anything with a magic attribute... especially Magic Dart... it didn't do a thing. Perhaps if it's magic of another attribute, it might have a little effect."
it: Già in fase di ricerca gli avevano messo le contromisure contro la magia, e le magie d'elemento magia... il Dardo magico soprattutto... non facevano proprio niente. Con magie di altro elemento forse qualcosa si ottiene.

jp: 文献では鎧をベースにした設計だったから、通常攻撃もあまり効かない。技能ならそのまま通ると思いたい。
jp_grezzo: "文献では鎧をベースにした設計だったから、通常攻撃もあまり効かない" + _daro(3) + "。技能ならそのまま通ると思いたい" + _na(3) + "。"
en: As far as what I can understand from reading the literature, its design used armor as a base, so normal attacks wouldn't work that well. My guess would be that using skills would allow you to pierce its shell.
en_grezzo: "As far as what I can understand from reading the literature, its design used armor as a base, so normal attacks wouldn't work that well. My guess would be that using skills would allow you to pierce its shell."
it: Nei documenti il progetto partiva da un'armatura, quindi anche gli attacchi normali servono a poco. Con le abilità c'è da sperare che passino.

jp: 防御重視のようだけど、弱った際に自分で安全装置を外して暴れ出したという記録もあった。もし暴れ出しても驚いて逃げたりせず、一気に押し切って破壊してしまうべき。
jp_grezzo: "防御重視のようだけど、弱った際に自分で安全装置を外して暴れ出したという記録もあった" + _yo(3) + "。もし暴れ出しても驚いて逃げたりせず、一気に押し切って破壊してしまうべき" + _da(3) + "。"
en: It seems to be defense-oriented, but I've also read reports of it detaching its own safeguards and going berserk out when it gets weak. If it does, don't be surprised and run away, just push it through and destroy it.
en_grezzo: "It seems to be defense-oriented, but I've also read reports of it detaching its own safeguards and going berserk out when it gets weak. If it does, don't be surprised and run away, just push it through and destroy it."
it: Sembra fatto per difendersi, ma c'è anche un rapporto che dice che, quando si è indebolito, si è tolto da solo i dispositivi di sicurezza e si è scatenato. Se si scatena non scappare per lo spavento: spingi fino in fondo e distruggilo.

jp: 偽りの預言者『ゼーム』はもはや怪物だと思った方がいい。レシマスに魅入られる前から、モンスターを召喚し混沌の渦を操り、深手も一瞬で治す魔術士だった。それが間違いなくレシマスの魔力で強化されている。
jp_grezzo: "偽りの預言者『ゼーム』はもはや怪物だと思った方がいい。レシマスに魅入られる前から、モンスターを召喚し混沌の渦を操り、深手も一瞬で治す魔術士だった。それが間違いなくレシマスの魔力で強化されている。"
en: You should consider <Zeome> the false prophet to have already lost all traces of humanity. Even before he became mesmerized by the power of Lesimas, he was a sorcerer who could summon monsters, manipulate the vortex of Chaos, and heal even the deepest wounds in the blink of an eye. It's no question that all of his abilities only been further enhanced by Lesimas' latent magical power.
en_grezzo: "You should consider <Zeome> the false prophet to have already lost all traces of humanity. Even before he became mesmerized by the power of Lesimas, he was a sorcerer who could summon monsters, manipulate the vortex of Chaos, and heal even the deepest wounds in the blink of an eye. It's no question that all of his abilities only been further enhanced by Lesimas' latent magical power."
it: Zeome il falso profeta conviene ormai considerarlo un mostro. Già prima di farsi ammaliare da Lesimas era un mago capace di evocare mostri, di governare il vortice caotico e di rimarginarsi in un attimo anche le ferite profonde. E adesso il potere magico di Lesimas l'ha senz'altro rinforzato.

jp: ゼームの前の守護者はレベル55だったらしいから、今のゼームもそのくらいあるんじゃない。さらにレシマスの宝物庫で、空を飛び魔法を増幅する大鎌を手に入れたという記録もある。混沌耐性がないと、どんなに人数を揃えても一瞬で壊滅してしまう。
jp_grezzo: "ゼームの前の守護者はレベル55だったらしいから、今のゼームもそのくらいあるんじゃない" + _kana(3) + "。さらにレシマスの宝物庫で、空を飛び魔法を増幅する大鎌を手に入れたという記録もある。混沌耐性がないと、どんなに人数を揃えても一瞬で壊滅してしまう" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: I've heard that Zeome's previous guardian was about level 55, so my guess is that Zeome is also around that level. There's also been reports of him wielding a scythe that allows him to fly and amplifies his magic in the treasury of Lesimas. Without chaos resistance, you'd be instantly obliterated, no matter how allies you bring with you.
en_grezzo: "I've heard that Zeome's previous guardian was about level 55, so my guess is that Zeome is also around that level. There's also been reports of him wielding a scythe that allows him to fly and amplifies his magic in the treasury of Lesimas. Without chaos resistance, you'd be instantly obliterated, no matter how allies you bring with you."
it: Il guardiano che c'era prima di Zeome pare fosse di livello 55, quindi Zeome oggi starà lì intorno. E c'è anche un rapporto che dice che nella camera del tesoro di Lesimas ha preso una falce che fa volare e amplifica la magia. Senza resistenza al caos, per quanta gente ti porti dietro, in un attimo siete spazzati via.

jp: 壁生成の魔法や杖で周囲を囲んでしまえば、モンスターは召喚しづらくなる。だけど悠長に囲むにしたってその間攻撃を耐えなきゃいけない。
jp_grezzo: "壁生成の魔法や杖で周囲を囲んでしまえば、モンスターは召喚しづらくなる。だけど悠長に囲むにしたってその間攻撃を耐えなきゃいけない" + _nda(3) + "。"
en: If you can surround yourself by using spells or rods of Wall Creation, it will be difficult for him summon monsters. But even if you take the time to put up some walls, you'll have to steel yourself against his attacks the entire time.
en_grezzo: "If you can surround yourself by using spells or rods of Wall Creation, it will be difficult for him summon monsters. But even if you take the time to put up some walls, you'll have to steel yourself against his attacks the entire time."
it: Se ti chiudi intorno un muro con la magia o con la bacchetta di creazione di muri, evocare mostri gli diventa difficile. Però anche a chiudersi con calma, intanto gli attacchi bisogna reggerli.

jp: 一応、当時のゼームは相手に真っ向から近付いて接近戦を挑む傾向があったらしい。もしそのままなら、うまく誘導したり加速して振り切ったりできるかもしれない。
jp_grezzo: "一応、当時のゼームは相手に真っ向から近付いて接近戦を挑む傾向があったらしい。もしそのままなら、うまく誘導したり加速して振り切ったりできるかもしれない。"
en: In case it helps, it seems that back in the day, Zeome tended to approach his opponents head-on and challenge them to hand-to-hand combat. If his strategy since then has not changed, you might be able to lead him to a place where you have the upper hand, or outdistance him by casting Speed on yourself.
en_grezzo: "In case it helps, it seems that back in the day, Zeome tended to approach his opponents head-on and challenge them to hand-to-hand combat. If his strategy since then has not changed, you might be able to lead him to a place where you have the upper hand, or outdistance him by casting Speed on yourself."
it: Se può servire: Zeome di allora tendeva ad avvicinarsi in linea retta e a cercare il corpo a corpo. Se è rimasto così, forse lo puoi guidare dove vuoi tu, o seminarlo accelerando.

jp: 回復魔法の突破も問題。MPが切れるように仕向けるなら、MPを減らす武器や技能を用意して持久戦に持ち込む。
jp_grezzo: "回復魔法の突破も問題" + _ka(3) + "。MPが切れるように仕向けるなら、MPを減らす武器や技能を用意して持久戦に持ち込む。"
en: Then there's the problem of his recovery magic. If you're planning to exhaust his reserves of MP, get ahold of some weapons and skills that reduce MP and go in prepared for a battle of attrition.
en_grezzo: "Then there's the problem of his recovery magic. If you're planning to exhaust his reserves of MP, get ahold of some weapons and skills that reduce MP and go in prepared for a battle of attrition."
it: C'è anche il problema di superare la sua magia di cura. Se vuoi fargli finire gli MP, procurati armi e abilità che li consumano e mettiti in guerra di logoramento.

jp: 回復量を上回るダメージを与えるなら、パワーゲージを100％以上にして技能の【力の解放】や【合体攻撃発動】で仲間と一斉に叩き込むのが堅実。仲間は突撃態勢以外だとパワーゲージを温存するからタイミングを調整して。
jp_grezzo: "回復量を上回るダメージを与えるなら、パワーゲージを100％以上にして技能の【力の解放】や【合体攻撃発動】で仲間と一斉に叩き込むのが堅実" + _daro(3) + "。仲間は突撃態勢以外だとパワーゲージを温存するからタイミングを調整して。"
en: If you want to deal damage faster than he can recover it all, it's a good idea to get your power gauge to 100% or higher and use your <Gauge Release> or <Unison Impact> skills to beat on him with your allies all at once. Your allies will conserve their power gauge if they aren't obeying the Onslaught directive, so take advantage of that and time your big attacks accordingly.
en_grezzo: "If you want to deal damage faster than he can recover it all, it's a good idea to get your power gauge to 100% or higher and use your <Gauge Release> or <Unison Impact> skills to beat on him with your allies all at once. Your allies will conserve their power gauge if they aren't obeying the Onslaught directive, so take advantage of that and time your big attacks accordingly."
it: Se invece vuoi fare più danno di quanto lui ne recuperi, la via solida è portare la barra di potenza oltre il 100% e scaricargliela addosso tutti insieme coi compagni, con <Forza liberata> o con <Attacco combinato>. I compagni fuori dall'ordine di Assalto tengono da parte la barra, quindi regola i tempi.

jp: 腐ったトマトや納豆、ヨーグルトをぶつけたりして激怒させればダメージが倍になるけど、受けるダメージも倍になるから、自軍の耐久力と相談。あとは…沈黙の霧の魔法を無理矢理通すか、。充分な魔法LVがないと望みはない。
jp_grezzo: "腐ったトマトや納豆、ヨーグルトをぶつけたりして激怒させればダメージが倍になるけど、受けるダメージも倍になるから、自軍の耐久力と相談" + _dana(3) + "。あとは…沈黙の霧の魔法を無理矢理通すか、" + _dana(3) + "。充分な魔法LVがないと望みはない" + _yo(3) + "。"
en: If you enrage your friends by hurling rotten tomatoes, fermented soybeans, or yogurt at them, they'll deal twice as much damage, but they'll also receive twice as much damage, so you'll have to discuss the optimal strategy with your squad. One more option is to cast Mist of Silence to prevent Zeome from casting magic at all. If you're betting on that strategy, then you'd better have a high enough magic level, or there's no hope for you.
en_grezzo: "If you enrage your friends by hurling rotten tomatoes, fermented soybeans, or yogurt at them, they'll deal twice as much damage, but they'll also receive twice as much damage, so you'll have to discuss the optimal strategy with your squad. One more option is to cast Mist of Silence to prevent Zeome from casting magic at all. If you're betting on that strategy, then you'd better have a high enough magic level, or there's no hope for you."
it: Se li fai infuriare tirandogli addosso pomodori marci, natto o yogurt, il danno raddoppia; ma raddoppia anche quello che prendono, quindi va visto quanto regge la tua squadra. Poi... o gli fai passare per forza la magia Nebbia di silenzio. Senza un livello di magia sufficiente non c'è speranza.

jp: もし上手くいって《常闇の眼》を手に入れたら、にもちょっと情報を分けて。。
jp_grezzo: "もし上手くいって《常闇の眼》を手に入れたら、" + _ore(3) + "にもちょっと情報を分けて" + _kure(3) + "。" + _yoro(3) + "。"
en: If you actually pull this off and manage to get your hands on the <Origin of Vice>, I'd be thrilled if you gave me some information about it. Good luck.
en_grezzo: "If you actually pull this off and manage to get your hands on the <Origin of Vice>, I'd be thrilled if you gave me some information about it. Good luck."
it: Se ti va bene e metti le mani sull'<occhio delle tenebre eterne>, dividi un po' di informazioni anche con me. In bocca al lupo.

jp: 異形の神殿を支配している、混沌の翼『エグゾシズル』はレベル60。逃げ回りながら装備で増幅された混沌と暗黒の魔法を使うらしい。
jp_grezzo: "異形の神殿を支配している、混沌の翼『エグゾシズル』はレベル60" + _da(3) + "。逃げ回りながら装備で増幅された混沌と暗黒の魔法を使うらしい" + _yo(3) + "。"
en: <Exossil> the chaos wing, the ruler of the Chaos Shrine, is level 60. It is said that he casts chaos and darkness magic amplified by his equipment while flying around.
en_grezzo: "<Exossil> the chaos wing, the ruler of the Chaos Shrine, is level 60. It is said that he casts chaos and darkness magic amplified by his equipment while flying around."
it: Exossil l'ala del caos, che domina il Tempio Caos, è di livello 60. Pare che scappi in volo tirando magie di caos e oscurità amplificate dall'equipaggiamento.

jp: そうそう。前に挑戦した魔法使いは、沈黙の霧をくらって魔法が使えなくなり手も足も出なかったそう。耐性を下げる呪いもかけてくるらしいから、魔法を使う気がなくても浄化の杖や巻物は持っていくといい。高レベルのホーリーヴェイルなら予防もできる。
jp_grezzo: "そうそう。前に挑戦した魔法使いは、沈黙の霧をくらって魔法が使えなくなり手も足も出なかったそう" + _da(3) + "。耐性を下げる呪いもかけてくるらしいから、魔法を使う気がなくても浄化の杖や巻物は持っていくといい" + _daro(3) + "。高レベルのホーリーヴェイルなら予防もできる" + _kana(3) + "。"
en: Another thing I remember. I heard that a wizard who challenged him before was struck by Mist of Silence and couldn't use his magic, so he was completely helpless. I've heard that he also casts a curse that lowers your resistance, so even if you don't intend to use magic, you should bring rods or scrolls of Holy Light. I wonder if casting Holy Veil at a high enough level could also prevent that.
en_grezzo: "Another thing I remember. I heard that a wizard who challenged him before was struck by Mist of Silence and couldn't use his magic, so he was completely helpless. I've heard that he also casts a curse that lowers your resistance, so even if you don't intend to use magic, you should bring rods or scrolls of Holy Light. I wonder if casting Holy Veil at a high enough level could also prevent that."
it: Ah, giusto. Un mago che l'ha sfidato prima si è preso una Nebbia di silenzio, non ha più potuto usare la magia e non ha combinato niente. E pare che tiri anche una maledizione che abbassa le resistenze, quindi anche se non pensi di usare la magia portati dietro bacchette o pergamene di luce sacra. Con un Velo sacro di livello alto si può anche prevenire.

jp: アンデッドで、神で、浮遊しているから、対応したエンチャントの武器があれば役立つはず。特に強い耐性も弱い耐性もないよう。
jp_grezzo: "アンデッドで、神で、浮遊しているから、対応したエンチャントの武器があれば役立つはず" + _dana(3) + "。特に強い耐性も弱い耐性もないよう" + _da(3) + "。"
en: Since he's an undead god who floats, having some weapons with the corresponding enchantments for those three qualities should help. He don't appear to have any particularly strong or weak resistances.
en_grezzo: "Since he's an undead god who floats, having some weapons with the corresponding enchantments for those three qualities should help. He don't appear to have any particularly strong or weak resistances."
it: È un non morto, è un dio e sta sospeso in aria, quindi con armi che portino gli incantamenti giusti per queste tre cose dovresti cavartela. Non pare avere resistenze particolarmente forti né particolarmente deboli.

jp: データによると…おっと、どうやってデータを手に入れたかは訊かないで。機械要塞に配備されている火炎機竜『メタルヴェスダ』はレベル70。
jp_grezzo: "データによると…おっと、どうやってデータを手に入れたかは訊かないで" + _kure(3) + "。機械要塞に配備されている火炎機竜『メタルヴェスダ』はレベル70。"
en: According to this data... whoops. Don't ask where I got it from, okay? <Metal Vesda> the fire machine, who's stationed at the Machine Fortress, is level 70.
en_grezzo: "According to this data... whoops. Don't ask where I got it from, okay? <Metal Vesda> the fire machine, who's stationed at the Machine Fortress, is level 70."
it: Stando ai dati... ehi, non chiedermi come li ho avuti. Metal Vesda, il drago di fuoco meccanico schierato nella Fortezza Meccanica, è di livello 70.

jp: メイン武装が散弾だから、遠距離から戦えば被害は減るはず。エネルギー放射攻撃も行うようだけど、これも魔法耐性がある程度あれば怖くない。
jp_grezzo: "メイン武装が散弾だから、遠距離から戦えば被害は減るはず" + _da(3) + "。エネルギー放射攻撃も行うようだけど、これも魔法耐性がある程度あれば怖くない" + _na(3) + "。"
en: Its primary armament is a shotgun, so it should be able to do less damage if you fight it from a distance. It also seems to launch an energy radiation attack, but that should be no trouble as long as you're packing some magic resistance.
en_grezzo: "Its primary armament is a shotgun, so it should be able to do less damage if you fight it from a distance. It also seems to launch an energy radiation attack, but that should be no trouble as long as you're packing some magic resistance."
it: L'arma principale è a pallettoni, quindi combattendo da lontano i danni calano. Pare che faccia anche attacchi a irradiazione di energia, ma anche quelli, con un po' di resistenza alla magia, non fanno paura.

jp: ただし自爆装置を積んでいるみたい。追い詰めたら一度、自爆できないように相手を濡らしておくといい。
jp_grezzo: "ただし自爆装置を積んでいるみたい" + _da(3) + "。追い詰めたら一度、自爆できないように相手を濡らしておくといい" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: However, it appears to have a self-destruct mechanism built in as a last resort. Once you've cornered it, you'll want to get it wet somehow so it can't self-destruct.
en_grezzo: "However, it appears to have a self-destruct mechanism built in as a last resort. Once you've cornered it, you'll want to get it wet somehow so it can't self-destruct."
it: Però sembra che monti un congegno di autodistruzione. Quando lo metti alle strette, prima bagnalo: così non può autodistruggersi.

jp: かなりタフだから、周りに邪魔な敵がいればそっちから片づけたほうがいいかもしれない。火炎に異常に強いようだから、他の属性で攻撃したほうがいい。
jp_grezzo: "かなりタフだから、周りに邪魔な敵がいればそっちから片づけたほうがいいかもしれない" + _yo(3) + "。火炎に異常に強いようだから、他の属性で攻撃したほうがいい" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: It's a pretty tough hunk of metal, so if there are any enemies around that are in your way, you might as well take them out first. They seem to be unusually resistant to fire, so you'd be better off attacking them with some other attribute.
en_grezzo: "It's a pretty tough hunk of metal, so if there are any enemies around that are in your way, you might as well take them out first. They seem to be unusually resistant to fire, so you'd be better off attacking them with some other attribute."
it: È parecchio duro, quindi se intorno hai nemici d'intralcio conviene forse togliere prima quelli. Al fuoco pare che resista in modo anomalo, quindi meglio attaccarlo con altri elementi.

jp: 黄泉の谷か？あそこにいる葬祭の『アヌビス』はレベル80。最近も、盗掘しようとした連中が痛い目に遭ったらしい。
jp_grezzo: "黄泉の谷か？あそこにいる葬祭の『アヌビス』はレベル80" + _da(3) + "。最近も、盗掘しようとした連中が痛い目に遭ったらしい" + _yo(3) + "。"
en: The Valley of Hades? <Anubis> the master of death resides there, and is level 80. Recently I've been hearing reports that some looters prowling the area have been getting taught a painful lesson.
en_grezzo: "The Valley of Hades? <Anubis> the master of death resides there, and is level 80. Recently I've been hearing reports that some looters prowling the area have been getting taught a painful lesson."
it: La Valle degli Inferi? L'Anubis che sta lì, il signore della morte, è di livello 80. E anche di recente pare che dei tombaroli ci abbiano rimesso le penne.

jp: 頑丈な鎧で武装して挑んだが貫通率の高い武器で殴られてほぼ全滅。防御力があまり意味をなさないみたい。瞬間移動で距離を詰めてくるから逃げるのも難しいって話。
jp_grezzo: "頑丈な鎧で武装して挑んだが貫通率の高い武器で殴られてほぼ全滅。防御力があまり意味をなさないみたい" + _dana(3) + "。瞬間移動で距離を詰めてくるから逃げるのも難しいって話" + _da(3) + "。"
en: They tried to take him on while armed with sturdy armor, but were struck by a weapon with a high pierce rate and were almost completely wiped out. It seems that focusing on your defensive power isn't an effective strategy with this guy. What I mean is that he can quickly close the gap between his opponents with teleportation, making it a lot harder to keep your distance when need be.
en_grezzo: "They tried to take him on while armed with sturdy armor, but were struck by a weapon with a high pierce rate and were almost completely wiped out. It seems that focusing on your defensive power isn't an effective strategy with this guy. What I mean is that he can quickly close the gap between his opponents with teleportation, making it a lot harder to keep your distance when need be."
it: Ci sono andati corazzati d'armatura pesante, e sono stati quasi sterminati da un'arma molto perforante. La difesa non sembra servire granché. E chiude la distanza col teletrasporto, quindi dicono che sia difficile anche scappare.

jp: やり合うならフェザーの魔法や翼鳥のポーションで回避力を上げて、集中攻撃でさっさと倒さないと厳しいんじゃない。こちらが物理攻撃を使わないなら闇の霧を撒くという手もある。
jp_grezzo: "やり合うならフェザーの魔法や翼鳥のポーションで回避力を上げて、集中攻撃でさっさと倒さないと厳しいんじゃない" + _kana(3) + "。こちらが物理攻撃を使わないなら闇の霧を撒くという手もある" + _na(3) + "。"
en: If you're going to face him, you'll have to cast Feather or drink potions of feather to increase your evasion,  and then hit him with everything you've got immediately afterwards. Another strategy is to hold off on attacking him physically in order to dispel the Mist of Darkness he creates.
en_grezzo: "If you're going to face him, you'll have to cast Feather or drink potions of feather to increase your evasion,  and then hit him with everything you've got immediately afterwards. Another strategy is to hold off on attacking him physically in order to dispel the Mist of Darkness he creates."
it: Se vuoi affrontarlo, alza la schivata con la magia Piuma o con le pozioni di piuma, e abbattilo in fretta concentrando gli attacchi, se no è dura. Se non usi attacchi fisici, un'altra via è spargere una Nebbia d'oscurità.

jp: 話を聞く限りだと、暗黒と魔法に耐性を持っているみたい。一応神だから神に威力を発揮する武器があれば効くんじゃない。
jp_grezzo: "話を聞く限りだと、暗黒と魔法に耐性を持っているみたい" + _da(3) + "。一応神だから神に威力を発揮する武器があれば効くんじゃない" + _kana(3) + "。"
en: From what I've heard, he's resistant to the attributes of darkness and magic. He's also a god, in case you were wondering, so if you have a weapon that's powerful against gods, use it by all means.
en_grezzo: "From what I've heard, he's resistant to the attributes of darkness and magic. He's also a god, in case you were wondering, so if you have a weapon that's powerful against gods, use it by all means."
it: Da quel che ho sentito, resiste all'oscurità e alla magia. È pur sempre un dio, quindi se hai un'arma che picchia forte sugli dei dovrebbe funzionare.

jp: 障害になりそうなのは…そう。
jp_grezzo: "障害になりそうなのは…そう" + _dana(3) + "。"
en: As far as any potential roadblocks go... Yeah, there's one.
en_grezzo: "As far as any potential roadblocks go... Yeah, there's one."
it: Quel che può fare da ostacolo è... sì, questo.

jp: 『イェルス自律戦闘通信機』はレベル100。レミード遺跡には2台投入されているって話。敵と認識されなければ戦うことはないはずだけど、一応。
jp_grezzo: "『イェルス自律戦闘通信機』はレベル100。レミード遺跡には2台投入されているって話" + _da(3) + "。敵と認識されなければ戦うことはないはずだけど、一応。"
en: The Yerles <Mobile Communication Equipment> is level 100, and I've heard that two of them were sent into the ruins of Remido. If they don't recognize you as an adversary then you shouldn't have to fight them, but I'll break it down for you just in case.
en_grezzo: "The Yerles <Mobile Communication Equipment> is level 100, and I've heard that two of them were sent into the ruins of Remido. If they don't recognize you as an adversary then you shouldn't have to fight them, but I'll break it down for you just in case."
it: L'<Apparato di comunicazione mobile> di Yerles è di livello 100. Dicono che nelle Rovine di Remido ne abbiano messi in campo due. Se non ti riconosce come nemico non dovrebbe combattere, ma tanto per sapere.

jp: 鋭利な遠隔マニピュレーターで出血させたり、電撃や多彩な射撃兵装で身を守るとされている。魔法対策も随所に施されているから魔法属性の魔法なんかほとんど効かない。
jp_grezzo: "鋭利な遠隔マニピュレーターで出血させたり、電撃や多彩な射撃兵装で身を守るとされている" + _yo(3) + "。魔法対策も随所に施されているから魔法属性の魔法なんかほとんど効かない" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: It's been said that they use acute long-distance manipulators to cause bleeding, fire off electric shocks, and employ a variety of ranged weapons for self-defense purposes. They're also fitted with anti-magic reinforcements, so they're practically immune to magic element spells.
en_grezzo: "It's been said that they use acute long-distance manipulators to cause bleeding, fire off electric shocks, and employ a variety of ranged weapons for self-defense purposes. They're also fitted with anti-magic reinforcements, so they're practically immune to magic element spells."
it: Si dice che ferisca con manipolatori a distanza affilati, e che si difenda con scariche elettriche e armamenti di tiro di ogni sorta. Ha contromisure contro la magia dappertutto, quindi le magie d'elemento magia non fanno quasi niente.

jp: 戦闘時にはあまり相手に近づかないらしい。まぁそりゃそう、本来は通信機なんだから。もし戦うなら、コイツからテレポートで距離を取って、他の敵を先に片づけたほうがマシ。
jp_grezzo: "戦闘時にはあまり相手に近づかないらしい" + _ga(3) + "。まぁそりゃそう" + _da(3) + "、本来は通信機なんだから。もし戦うなら、コイツからテレポートで距離を取って、他の敵を先に片づけたほうがマシ" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: I've heard that they're programmed to keep their distance from their targets when engaged in combat. Makes sense, since they're specifically designed for reconnaissance purposes. If you're going to fight one, it'd be best to teleport away and clear out the other monsters in the vicinity first.
en_grezzo: "I've heard that they're programmed to keep their distance from their targets when engaged in combat. Makes sense, since they're specifically designed for reconnaissance purposes. If you're going to fight one, it'd be best to teleport away and clear out the other monsters in the vicinity first."
it: In combattimento pare che non si avvicini troppo. Be', è ovvio: in origine è un apparato di comunicazione. Se ti tocca combatterlo, meglio prendere le distanze col teletrasporto e fare fuori prima gli altri nemici.

jp: 遺跡内でレベル110くらいの馬と青年に絡まれたって情報があった。どうやらイレギュラーって奴と間違えられて襲われたらしい。
jp_grezzo: "遺跡内でレベル110くらいの馬と青年に絡まれたって情報があった" + _na(3) + "。どうやらイレギュラーって奴と間違えられて襲われたらしい。"
en: I've received a report that someone got into a scuffle with young man and a horse around level 110 somewhere in the ruins. Apparently, the pair mistook him for someone named \"Irregular\" and attacked.
en_grezzo: "I've received a report that someone got into a scuffle with young man and a horse around level 110 somewhere in the ruins. Apparently, the pair mistook him for someone named \"Irregular\" and attacked."
it: Mi è arrivata voce che dentro le rovine un cavallo e un giovane sul livello 110 hanno aggredito qualcuno. Pare sia stato uno scambio di persona: cercavano un tale che chiamano l'Irregolare.

jp: そいつらも、そいつらが探している相手も名前は不明。も襲われるかもしれないから気をつけたほうがいい。
jp_grezzo: "そいつらも、そいつらが探している相手も名前は不明" + _da(3) + "。" + _kimi(3) + "も襲われるかもしれないから気をつけたほうがいい" + _yo(3) + "。"
en: Both of their names as well as the name of the person they're after are unknown. You'd better be careful, because you might their next target.
en_grezzo: "Both of their names as well as the name of the person they're after are unknown. You'd better be careful, because you might their next target."
it: Di quei due, e di chi stanno cercando, non si sa il nome. Potrebbe toccare anche a te, quindi sta' in guardia.

jp: 見える範囲にいると青年は精霊を召喚することがあるそう。煙幕を張ったり壁生成で視線を切ったりテレポートの杖で吹っ飛ばしたりするといいかもしれない。
jp_grezzo: "見える範囲にいると青年は精霊を召喚することがあるそう" + _da(3) + "。煙幕を張ったり壁生成で視線を切ったりテレポートの杖で吹っ飛ばしたりするといいかもしれない" + _na(3) + "。"
en: I've heard that the young man may summon spirits when he's within sight. You might want to put up a smoke screen, use Wall Creation to cut off their line of sight, or send them away with rods of teleportation.
en_grezzo: "I've heard that the young man may summon spirits when he's within sight. You might want to put up a smoke screen, use Wall Creation to cut off their line of sight, or send them away with rods of teleportation."
it: Pare che il giovane, se ti ha a tiro, evochi degli spiriti. Può servire una cortina di fumo, oppure tagliare la linea di vista con la creazione di muri, o spazzarli via con una bacchetta di teletrasporto.

jp: 精霊どもはMPを減らす眼差しを向けてくるらしいから…やはり相手からなるべく見えないようにすると集中攻撃を防げる。
jp_grezzo: "精霊どもはMPを減らす眼差しを向けてくるらしいから…やはり相手からなるべく見えないようにすると集中攻撃を防げる" + _na(3) + "。"
en: I've heard that the spirits he summons will gaze at you to reduce your MP... so from the opponent's point of view, trying to avoid their gaze means that you won't be able to concentrate your attacks.
en_grezzo: "I've heard that the spirits he summons will gaze at you to reduce your MP... so from the opponent's point of view, trying to avoid their gaze means that you won't be able to concentrate your attacks."
it: Gli spiriti lanciano uno sguardo che consuma MP... quindi, di nuovo: stare il meno possibile nel loro campo visivo evita di prendersi tutti i colpi insieme.

jp: MPがどんどん減る魔漏状態にされると厳しいから、MPを回復できる魔力の巻物か杖を多めに用意しておくといい。
jp_grezzo: "MPがどんどん減る魔漏状態にされると厳しいから、MPを回復できる魔力の巻物か杖を多めに用意しておくといい" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: It's going to get tough being in a situation where your MP is constantly leaking away, so it's a good idea to prepare some scrolls or rods with magic that can restore MP.
en_grezzo: "It's going to get tough being in a situation where your MP is constantly leaking away, so it's a good idea to prepare some scrolls or rods with magic that can restore MP."
it: Se ti mettono nello stato in cui gli MP colano via di continuo sono guai, quindi conviene portarsi dietro parecchie pergamene o bacchette di mana per rimetterli a posto.

jp: ちなみに一番強いのは馬らしい。角に刺されると強烈な混沌の渦が発生することがあるらしい。襲われた奴はたまたま混沌耐性を高めていたから助かったものの、そうでなけりゃ余裕でお陀仏だったって話。
jp_grezzo: "ちなみに一番強いのは馬らしい" + _yo(3) + "。角に刺されると強烈な混沌の渦が発生することがあるらしい" + _na(3) + "。襲われた奴はたまたま混沌耐性を高めていたから助かったものの、そうでなけりゃ余裕でお陀仏だったって話" + _da(3) + "。"
en: By the way, the stronger one out of the two is apparently the horse. I heard that getting stabbed by its horn causes Chaos Ball to break out. The guy who was attacked just so happened to have a high level of resistance to chaos, so he managed to survive, but if he wasn't so lucky he would have perished in the end.
en_grezzo: "By the way, the stronger one out of the two is apparently the horse. I heard that getting stabbed by its horn causes Chaos Ball to break out. The guy who was attacked just so happened to have a high level of resistance to chaos, so he managed to survive, but if he wasn't so lucky he would have perished in the end."
it: A proposito: il più forte dei due pare sia il cavallo. Se ti infilza col corno può scatenarsi un vortice caotico coi fiocchi. Chi ha subito l'attacco se l'è cavata solo perché aveva alzato la resistenza al caos: senza quella, sarebbe finita lì.

jp: ちなみにどいつもこいつも混沌にはかなりの耐性があるみたい。
jp_grezzo: "ちなみにどいつもこいつも混沌にはかなりの耐性があるみたい" + _da(3) + "。"
en: I should also mention that all these guys have a fairly high resistance to chaos-attribute attacks.
en_grezzo: "I should also mention that all these guys have a fairly high resistance to chaos-attribute attacks."
it: E comunque, tutti quanti hanno una bella resistenza al caos.

jp: 風の山道にはボスはいない。だけどその山道の先に何があるか知ってる？驚くなかれ、生化学文明紀の人類が集落を作っているって話。
jp_grezzo: "風の山道にはボスはいない。だけどその山道の先に何があるか知ってる" + _kana(3) + "？驚くなかれ、生化学文明紀の人類が集落を作っているって話" + _da(3) + "。"
en: There is no boss in the Mountain Pass. But do you know what's at the end of that winding mountain road? I know this will be hard to believe, but hear me out. I'm talking about an isolated settlement inhabited by a group of humans whose lineage can be traced back to the age of biochemistry.
en_grezzo: "There is no boss in the Mountain Pass. But do you know what's at the end of that winding mountain road? I know this will be hard to believe, but hear me out. I'm talking about an isolated settlement inhabited by a group of humans whose lineage can be traced back to the age of biochemistry."
it: Nel Passo di Montagna non c'è nessun boss. Ma lo sai che cosa c'è in fondo a quella strada di montagna? Non ti stupire: pare che ci sia un insediamento di uomini dell'era della civiltà biochimica.

jp: 大昔からエーテルの風が局所的に発生し続けている山だから、メシェーラに適合できなかった旧人類が生き残っていても実際おかしくないと思。
jp_grezzo: "大昔からエーテルの風が局所的に発生し続けている山だから、メシェーラに適合できなかった旧人類が生き残っていても実際おかしくないと思" + _u(3) + "。"
en: Since the mountain has been the local source of the Etherwind for many ages, I'm actually not surprised that a lineage of humans from times past who couldn't adapt to the outbreak of Meshera have managed to survive.
en_grezzo: "Since the mountain has been the local source of the Etherwind for many ages, I'm actually not surprised that a lineage of humans from times past who couldn't adapt to the outbreak of Meshera have managed to survive."
it: È una montagna dove da tempo immemorabile il vento d'etere si leva a chiazze, quindi non mi pare poi strano che siano sopravvissuti degli uomini antichi, quelli che alla Meshera non si sono adattati.

jp: エーテル風を発生させる人工生命体が当時研究されてたって文献も見つかっている。…それでも最近までは、あくまで知る人ぞ知るロマンある一つの説に過ぎなかった。
jp_grezzo: "エーテル風を発生させる人工生命体が当時研究されてたって文献も見つかっている" + _na(3) + "。…それでも最近までは、あくまで知る人ぞ知るロマンある一つの説に過ぎなかった" + _ga(3) + "。"
en: At the time, there was ongoing research concerning an artificial life form with the ability to cause the Etherwind. ...Still, until recently, it was nothing more than an exciting theory discussed only by those in the know.
en_grezzo: "At the time, there was ongoing research concerning an artificial life form with the ability to cause the Etherwind. ...Still, until recently, it was nothing more than an exciting theory discussed only by those in the know."
it: Si sono trovati anche documenti che dicono che all'epoca si studiava una forma di vita artificiale capace di generare il vento d'etere. ...Eppure, fino a poco fa, restava una bella teoria che conoscevano in pochi.

jp: 実はここだけの話…確かめに行った、好奇心溢れる命知らずが。そいつは説を裏付ける証言をした後にエーテル病の合併症で死んだ。
jp_grezzo: "実はここだけの話…確かめに行った" + _nda(3) + "、好奇心溢れる命知らずが。そいつは説を裏付ける証言をした後にエーテル病の合併症で死んだ" + _yo(3) + "。"
en: In fact, just between you and me... one foolish guy wanting to test the theory went there looking for answers. That guy would put his own life on the line if it meant he got his answer. After presenting his findings in support of the artificial life form theory, he would later drop dead from complications related to ether disease.
en_grezzo: "In fact, just between you and me... one foolish guy wanting to test the theory went there looking for answers. That guy would put his own life on the line if it meant he got his answer. After presenting his findings in support of the artificial life form theory, he would later drop dead from complications related to ether disease."
it: In verità, qui fra noi... c'è andato a controllare uno pieno di curiosità e senza paura di morire. Dopo aver portato le testimonianze che confermavano la teoria, è morto per le complicazioni della malattia dell'etere.

jp: 集落奥の広場にはレベル120くらいの人工生命体もいたそう。魔法属性の攻撃を受けたほか、睨まれたらエーテル病が進行したらしい。聞いた感じだと特に耐性の得手不得手はないみたい。
jp_grezzo: "集落奥の広場にはレベル120くらいの人工生命体もいたそう" + _da(3) + "。魔法属性の攻撃を受けたほか、睨まれたらエーテル病が進行したらしい" + _yo(3) + "。聞いた感じだと特に耐性の得手不得手はないみたい" + _da(3) + "。"
en: Apparently, there was also an artificial life form around level 120 in a plaza of sorts at the rear of the settlement. As well as attacking with magic attribute damage, I heard that when it gazes at you, it worsens the progression of ether disease. From what I've been told, it doesn't have any strengths or weaknesses when it comes to elemental resistance.
en_grezzo: "Apparently, there was also an artificial life form around level 120 in a plaza of sorts at the rear of the settlement. As well as attacking with magic attribute damage, I heard that when it gazes at you, it worsens the progression of ether disease. From what I've been told, it doesn't have any strengths or weaknesses when it comes to elemental resistance."
it: Nella piazza in fondo all'insediamento pare ci fosse anche una forma di vita artificiale di livello 120. Oltre agli attacchi d'elemento magia, pare che se ti fissa la malattia dell'etere avanzi. Da come me l'hanno raccontata, non ha resistenze forti né deboli.

jp: 旧人類にも現代の魔術は通るはずだからインコグニートの魔法や変装セットを使えば事を荒立てずに済む。
jp_grezzo: "旧人類にも現代の魔術は通るはずだからインコグニートの魔法や変装セットを使えば事を荒立てずに済む" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: Humans from that ancient era are likely to be outclassed by modern advancements in magic, so you can cast Incognito or use a disguise set to keep things from getting out of hand.
en_grezzo: "Humans from that ancient era are likely to be outclassed by modern advancements in magic, so you can cast Incognito or use a disguise set to keep things from getting out of hand."
it: Anche sugli uomini antichi la magia moderna dovrebbe funzionare, quindi con la magia Incognito o con un set da travestimento si evita di far chiasso.

jp: 旧人類も人工生命体も貴重な情報源だから、としてはできれば殺さないで欲しい。
jp_grezzo: "旧人類も人工生命体も貴重な情報源だから、" + _ore(3) + "としてはできれば殺さないで欲しい" + _na(3) + "。"
en: Being an informer, I'm highly interested in the workings of ancient humans and artificial lifeforms, so I would much prefer that you try not to kill or destroy any of them if you can help it.
en_grezzo: "Being an informer, I'm highly interested in the workings of ancient humans and artificial lifeforms, so I would much prefer that you try not to kill or destroy any of them if you can help it."
it: Sia gli uomini antichi sia la forma di vita artificiale sono fonti d'informazione preziose, quindi, per quel che mi riguarda, se puoi evitare di ammazzarli mi faresti un piacere.

jp: レミードの最下層は古代の研究施設。そこにはメシェーラの親玉が眠っている。レベルは120。いや130？
jp_grezzo: "レミードの最下層は古代の研究施設。そこにはメシェーラの親玉が眠っている" + _nda(3) + "。レベルは120。いや130？"
en: The deepest level of Remido contains an ancient research facility. That's where the master of Meshera lies. I believe it's level 120... 130, maybe?
en_grezzo: "The deepest level of Remido contains an ancient research facility. That's where the master of Meshera lies. I believe it's level 120... 130, maybe?"
it: Il piano più profondo di Remido è un impianto di ricerca antico. Lì dorme il capo delle Meshera. Livello 120. O 130?

jp: その場から移動せず、吸収した細胞から様々な魔物を複製するらしい。周囲を壁で囲って、魔物を出すスペースを無くしてしまえば封じることができる。
jp_grezzo: "その場から移動せず、吸収した細胞から様々な魔物を複製するらしい" + _yo(3) + "。周囲を壁で囲って、魔物を出すスペースを無くしてしまえば封じることができる" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: I've been told that it doesn't move from where it's rooted to the ground, but instead uses the cellular materials it's absorbed to produce recreations of the monsters that they originated from. If you can seal it off with walls, you can prevent it from having the space needed to create more monsters.
en_grezzo: "I've been told that it doesn't move from where it's rooted to the ground, but instead uses the cellular materials it's absorbed to produce recreations of the monsters that they originated from. If you can seal it off with walls, you can prevent it from having the space needed to create more monsters."
it: Pare che non si sposti da dove sta, e che dalle cellule che ha assorbito replichi mostri di ogni sorta. Se lo chiudi in un muro e gli togli lo spazio per tirarli fuori, lo puoi bloccare.

jp: 再生能力が高いって話もあるけどスペックではそこまで高いようには見えない。…2つの情報源で齟齬があるけど、2種類いたりするの？
jp_grezzo: "再生能力が高いって話もあるけどスペックではそこまで高いようには見えない" + _na(3) + "。…2つの情報源で齟齬があるけど、2種類いたりするの" + _kana(3) + "？"
en: Some reports have said that it carries a strong regenerative ability, but I'm not seeing how its specs could be that high. ...There's some discrepancies between my two sources, but maybe this means that there are actually *two* variants of this thing?
en_grezzo: "Some reports have said that it carries a strong regenerative ability, but I'm not seeing how its specs could be that high. ...There's some discrepancies between my two sources, but maybe this means that there are actually *two* variants of this thing?"
it: C'è anche chi dice che si rigeneri molto, ma dalle caratteristiche non mi pare così alta. ...Le due fonti non concordano: che ce ne siano di due tipi?

jp: まぁ回復し始めたら回復量を上回るダメージを与えればいいだけ。パワーゲージを100％以上にして技能の【力の解放】や【合体攻撃発動】で仲間と一斉に叩き込むのが堅実。仲間は突撃態勢以外だとパワーゲージを温存するからタイミングを調整して。
jp_grezzo: "まぁ回復し始めたら回復量を上回るダメージを与えればいいだけ" + _da(3) + "。パワーゲージを100％以上にして技能の【力の解放】や【合体攻撃発動】で仲間と一斉に叩き込むのが堅実" + _daro(3) + "。仲間は突撃態勢以外だとパワーゲージを温存するからタイミングを調整して。"
en: Anyway, when it starts to recover, all you have to do is deal more damage than it can heal back. It'd be a good idea to get your power gauge above 100% and use the skills <Gauge Release> and <Unison Impact> to smack down on it with all your allies at once. Your allies will conserve their power gauge if they aren't obeying the Onslaught directive, so take advantage of that and time your big attacks accordingly.
en_grezzo: "Anyway, when it starts to recover, all you have to do is deal more damage than it can heal back. It'd be a good idea to get your power gauge above 100% and use the skills <Gauge Release> and <Unison Impact> to smack down on it with all your allies at once. Your allies will conserve their power gauge if they aren't obeying the Onslaught directive, so take advantage of that and time your big attacks accordingly."
it: Be', se comincia a curarsi basta fargli più danno di quanto ne recupera. La via solida è portare la barra di potenza oltre il 100% e scaricargliela addosso tutti insieme coi compagni, con <Forza liberata> o con <Attacco combinato>. I compagni fuori dall'ordine di Assalto tengono da parte la barra, quindi regola i tempi.

jp: 腐ったトマトや納豆、ヨーグルトをぶつけたりして激怒させればダメージが倍になるけど、受けるダメージも倍になるから、自軍の耐久力と相談。
jp_grezzo: "腐ったトマトや納豆、ヨーグルトをぶつけたりして激怒させればダメージが倍になるけど、受けるダメージも倍になるから、自軍の耐久力と相談" + _dana(3) + "。"
en: If you enrage your friends by hurling rotten tomatoes, fermented soybeans, or yogurt at them, they'll deal twice as much damage, but they'll also receive twice as much damage, so you'll have to make sure your squad has the endurance to make it through.
en_grezzo: "If you enrage your friends by hurling rotten tomatoes, fermented soybeans, or yogurt at them, they'll deal twice as much damage, but they'll also receive twice as much damage, so you'll have to make sure your squad has the endurance to make it through."
it: Se li fai infuriare tirandogli addosso pomodori marci, natto o yogurt, il danno raddoppia; ma raddoppia anche quello che prendono, quindi va visto quanto regge la tua squadra.

jp: 再生ということは魔法によるものではないと思。そうだとしたらMP切れや沈黙の霧では対処できない。
jp_grezzo: "再生ということは魔法によるものではないと思" + _u(3) + "。そうだとしたらMP切れや沈黙の霧では対処できない" + _na(3) + "。"
en: Although it regenerates, I don't believe it uses magic to do so. If that's the case, then trying to exhaust its MP or casting Mist of Silence on it won't work.
en_grezzo: "Although it regenerates, I don't believe it uses magic to do so. If that's the case, then trying to exhaust its MP or casting Mist of Silence on it won't work."
it: Rigenerarsi non credo che lo faccia con la magia. Se è così, non ci si può fare niente né finendogli gli MP né con la Nebbia di silenzio.

jp: あとは地獄耐性を高めておくといいらしい。…こっちのメモには物理攻撃と音攻撃が強力と書いてある？まぁPVとDVと音耐性も高いほうがいい。相手は特に耐性の得手不得手はないみたい。
jp_grezzo: "あとは地獄耐性を高めておくといいらしい" + _yo(3) + "。…こっちのメモには物理攻撃と音攻撃が強力と書いてある" + _na(3) + "？まぁPVとDVと音耐性も高いほうがいい" + _daro(3) + "。相手は特に耐性の得手不得手はないみたい" + _da(3) + "。"
en: I've also heard that it's a good idea to increase your resistance to hell element damage. ...And this note here claims that it has some powerful physical and sound element attacks. So, you might as well build up a high PV, DV and level of sound resistance also. This thing doesn't seem to have any particular elemental strengths or weaknesses.
en_grezzo: "I've also heard that it's a good idea to increase your resistance to hell element damage. ...And this note here claims that it has some powerful physical and sound element attacks. So, you might as well build up a high PV, DV and level of sound resistance also. This thing doesn't seem to have any particular elemental strengths or weaknesses."
it: Poi pare che convenga alzare la resistenza all'oltretomba. ...Su quest'altro appunto c'è scritto che ha attacchi fisici e di suono potenti? Be', meglio avere alti anche PV, DV e resistenza al suono. Lui non pare avere resistenze forti né deboli.

jp: え？こんな情報どこから入ってきたのかって？
jp_grezzo: "え？こんな情報どこから入ってきたのかって？"
en: Huh? You want to know how I got my hands on all this info?
en_grezzo: "Huh? You want to know how I got my hands on all this info?"
it: Eh? Vuoi sapere da dove mi arrivano queste informazioni?

jp: …情報魔っていう、まぁ凄腕の情報屋？みたいなのがいるん。今回はそいつから仕入れたから間違いない。にもプライドがあるから、できるだけあの女には頼りたくない。
jp_grezzo: "…情報魔っていう、まぁ凄腕の情報屋？みたいなのがいるん" + _da(3) + "。今回はそいつから仕入れたから間違いない" + _yo(3) + "。" + _ore(3) + "にもプライドがあるから、できるだけあの女には頼りたくない" + _ga(3) + "。"
en: ...There's this wickedly smart informer of sorts who's making the rounds... we call her the \"All Seeing Eye\". I'm fairly certain that she was the source of everything I've just told you. But I've got to stand out in this business myself, so I don't want to rely on her too much.
en_grezzo: "...There's this wickedly smart informer of sorts who's making the rounds... we call her the \"All Seeing Eye\". I'm fairly certain that she was the source of everything I've just told you. But I've got to stand out in this business myself, so I don't want to rely on her too much."
it: ...C'è una tale che chiamano il demonio delle informazioni, una specie di informatrice coi fiocchi. Stavolta ho comprato da lei, quindi è roba sicura. Ma anch'io ho il mio orgoglio, e a quella donna preferisco ricorrere il meno possibile.

jp: 混沌の精霊の大軍と一緒に、鬼面の忍者が陣取っている階層があるらしい。もしそれが鬼面の忍者『藍影』だとしたらレベル155。
jp_grezzo: "混沌の精霊の大軍と一緒に、鬼面の忍者が陣取っている階層があるらしい" + _yo(3) + "。もしそれが鬼面の忍者『藍影』だとしたらレベル155" + _da(3) + "。"
en: I've heard that there's a troop of demon-faced ninjas camped out along with a large army of chaotic spirits. If that's <Aikage> the shinobi mask, he's level 155.
en_grezzo: "I've heard that there's a troop of demon-faced ninjas camped out along with a large army of chaotic spirits. If that's <Aikage> the shinobi mask, he's level 155."
it: Pare che ci sia un piano dove un ninja dal volto di demone si è accampato insieme a un grosso esercito di spiriti del caos. Se è Aikage, il ninja dalla maschera demoniaca, allora è di livello 155.

jp: 一撃離脱の近接攻撃とデバフが得意とされている。ホーリーヴェイルや浄化の杖などで予防対策しておけば安心。
jp_grezzo: "一撃離脱の近接攻撃とデバフが得意とされている" + _na(3) + "。ホーリーヴェイルや浄化の杖などで予防対策しておけば安心" + _dana(3) + "。"
en: He's said to be well-trained in the art of hit-and-run and debuffs. You'd be safest if you took preventative measures with Holy Veil or rods of holy light.
en_grezzo: "He's said to be well-trained in the art of hit-and-run and debuffs. You'd be safest if you took preventative measures with Holy Veil or rods of holy light."
it: Dicono che sia bravo negli attacchi ravvicinati mordi-e-fuggi e negli indebolimenti. Con un Velo sacro o con le bacchette di luce sacra a scopo preventivo si sta tranquilli.

jp: 中途半端に殴ると分身もするがそのまま殴り倒してしまったほうがいい。あと、音属性の耐性が高いよう。
jp_grezzo: "中途半端に殴ると分身もするがそのまま殴り倒してしまったほうがいい" + _daro(3) + "。あと、音属性の耐性が高いよう" + _da(3) + "。"
en: If you only finish him half off he'll separate into two different selves, but all you'd have to do at that point is take both of them down. Also, he seems to be highly resistant to sound element damage.
en_grezzo: "If you only finish him half off he'll separate into two different selves, but all you'd have to do at that point is take both of them down. Also, he seems to be highly resistant to sound element damage."
it: Se lo colpisci a metà si sdoppia, ma tanto vale continuare a picchiare e stenderlo. E poi, pare che abbia alta la resistenza al suono.

jp: 混沌の精霊どもは数が多いから一度に相手しないほうがいい。部屋の隅にテレポートして籠城するか、煙幕を撒きつつどこか一方を突破するか。MP回復手段を用意して混沌属性を高めて行けば問題ないと思。
jp_grezzo: "混沌の精霊どもは数が多いから一度に相手しないほうがいい" + _daro(3) + "。部屋の隅にテレポートして籠城するか、煙幕を撒きつつどこか一方を突破するか。MP回復手段を用意して混沌属性を高めて行けば問題ないと思" + _u(3) + "。"
en: There's going to be a lot of chaotic spirits, so you probably shouldn't try to take them all on at once. You can either teleport to a corner of the room and launch your assault from there, or you can scatter a smoke screen and break through to the other side. As long as you have a way to recover your MP and increase your resistance to chaos, you should be fine.
en_grezzo: "There's going to be a lot of chaotic spirits, so you probably shouldn't try to take them all on at once. You can either teleport to a corner of the room and launch your assault from there, or you can scatter a smoke screen and break through to the other side. As long as you have a way to recover your MP and increase your resistance to chaos, you should be fine."
it: Gli spiriti del caos sono tanti, quindi meglio non affrontarli tutti insieme. O ti teletrasporti in un angolo della stanza e resisti lì, o spargi una cortina di fumo e sfondi da una parte. Con un modo per recuperare gli MP e la resistenza al caos alzata, secondo me non ci sono problemi.

jp: ヴァルムの沖には小さな島々があるけど、そこから何人か島民が逃げ出してきたという。島民の証言から察するとどうも「九頭竜神話」めいた状況になっているよう。
jp_grezzo: "ヴァルムの沖には小さな島々がある" + _nda(3) + "けど、そこから何人か島民が逃げ出してきたという。島民の証言から察するとどうも「九頭竜神話」めいた状況になっているよう" + _da(3) + "。"
en: There are some small islands off the coast of Valm, but several of the islanders who live there are reportedly fleeing the area. From the testimonies they've given, it seems that the situation has become something like the one described in the \"Nine Dragons Myth.\"
en_grezzo: "There are some small islands off the coast of Valm, but several of the islanders who live there are reportedly fleeing the area. From the testimonies they've given, it seems that the situation has become something like the one described in the \"Nine Dragons Myth.\""
it: Al largo di Valm ci sono delle isolette, e da lì pare che alcuni isolani siano scappati. A sentire le loro testimonianze, la situazione somiglia parecchio al \"mito del drago a nove teste\".

jp: 九頭竜はおそらくレベル160程度。不定期に精神波で放ち狂気度を上げてくるという報告がある。ユニコーンの角を何本か持って行かないと、行動不能にされる。
jp_grezzo: "九頭竜はおそらくレベル160程度。不定期に精神波で放ち狂気度を上げてくるという報告がある" + _yo(3) + "。ユニコーンの角を何本か持って行かないと、行動不能にされる" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: <Nine Head Dragon> the abyss is probably around level 160. There's been reports that it releases psychic waves at irregular intervals that increase your insanity level. If you don't bring at least a couple of unicorn horns with you, you'll be reduced to a helpless pile of limbs.
en_grezzo: "<Nine Head Dragon> the abyss is probably around level 160. There's been reports that it releases psychic waves at irregular intervals that increase your insanity level. If you don't bring at least a couple of unicorn horns with you, you'll be reduced to a helpless pile of limbs."
it: Il drago a nove teste sarà sul livello 160. C'è chi riferisce che a intervalli irregolari emetta onde mentali che alzano il grado di follia. Se non ti porti dietro qualche corno di unicorno resti bloccato.

jp: 急いで倒したほうがいいけど、音と幻惑の耐性が低いと返り討ち。他にも怪物が大量にいるから、無視して九頭竜を倒すかどうかは攻撃力とユニコーンの角の本数次第。魔法属性に耐性を持っているはずだからそれ以外で攻めるべき。
jp_grezzo: "急いで倒したほうがいいけど、音と幻惑の耐性が低いと返り討ち" + _da(3) + "。他にも怪物が大量にいるから、無視して九頭竜を倒すかどうかは攻撃力とユニコーンの角の本数次第" + _dana(3) + "。魔法属性に耐性を持っているはずだからそれ以外で攻めるべき" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: You'd better act fast in taking it out, but if your resistance to sound and mind damage is low, that will come back to bite you. There's going to be swarms of other monsters around, so the feasibility of ignoring them and going after the nine-headed dragon will depend on your attack power and how many unicorn horns you have on hand. They're supposed to be resistant to magic attribute damage, so you should attack them with something other than that.
en_grezzo: "You'd better act fast in taking it out, but if your resistance to sound and mind damage is low, that will come back to bite you. There's going to be swarms of other monsters around, so the feasibility of ignoring them and going after the nine-headed dragon will depend on your attack power and how many unicorn horns you have on hand. They're supposed to be resistant to magic attribute damage, so you should attack them with something other than that."
it: Conviene abbatterlo in fretta, ma con le resistenze al suono e mentale basse la cosa ti si ritorce contro. Ci sono anche mostri a mucchi, quindi se ignorarli e puntare dritto al drago si possa fare dipende dalla tua potenza d'attacco e da quanti corni di unicorno hai. Dovrebbe resistere all'elemento magia, quindi attaccalo con altro.

jp: 狂気に蝕まれたら温泉にゆっくり浸かって療養すること。サウスティリスでは、アーク・ベルクや煙とパイプ亭、ルオザの温泉が有名。
jp_grezzo: "狂気に蝕まれたら温泉にゆっくり浸かって療養すること" + _da(3) + "。サウスティリスでは、アーク・ベルクや煙とパイプ亭、ルオザの温泉が有名" + _dana(3) + "。"
en: If you end up being consumed by madness, you should take your time recuperating in a hot spring. In South Tyris, the places known for their hot springs are Arcbelc, The Smoke and Pipe, and Ruoza.
en_grezzo: "If you end up being consumed by madness, you should take your time recuperating in a hot spring. In South Tyris, the places known for their hot springs are Arcbelc, The Smoke and Pipe, and Ruoza."
it: Se la follia ti divora, mettiti a mollo con calma alle terme e curati. In Tyris del Sud sono famose quelle di Arcbelc, della Locanda del Fumo e della Pipa, e di Ruoza.

jp: 種類が多いから生体兵器だけじゃどのタイプかわからない、と言いたいところだけどあれ？メシェーラ利用しようとして生物災害起こしたところ？
jp_grezzo: "種類が多いから生体兵器だけじゃどのタイプかわからない" + _yo(3) + "、と言いたいところだけどあれ" + _daro(3) + "？メシェーラ利用しようとして生物災害起こしたところ" + _daro(3) + "？"
en: There are so many different types of bioweapons that it's hard to tell which one is which just by looking at them, right? But the point is that the usage of Meshera-based weapons like those have caused a biological catastrophe.
en_grezzo: "There are so many different types of bioweapons that it's hard to tell which one is which just by looking at them, right? But the point is that the usage of Meshera-based weapons like those have caused a biological catastrophe."
it: Ce ne sono di tanti tipi, quindi a dire soltanto \"arma biologica\" non si capisce quale, vorrei dire; ma... ah, no. È quel posto dove hanno provato a usare le Meshera e hanno scatenato un disastro biologico?

jp: あそこは前々から黒い噂しか聞こえてこなかったけど、とうとう破綻したらしい。貴重な適合者に脱走されたのを隠蔽しようとして、最近は輪をかけて無茶苦茶やっていたとも聞く。
jp_grezzo: "あそこは前々から黒い噂しか聞こえてこなかった" + _nda(3) + "けど、とうとう破綻したらしい" + _na(3) + "。貴重な適合者に脱走されたのを隠蔽しようとして、最近は輪をかけて無茶苦茶やっていたとも聞く" + _yo(3) + "。"
en: I've heard nothing but suspicious-sounding rumors about the research company in question for a long time, but it seems that it finally went bankrupt. I've also heard that they've been going around in circles lately, trying to cover up the fact that some of their most precious research assets escaped from their facilities.
en_grezzo: "I've heard nothing but suspicious-sounding rumors about the research company in question for a long time, but it seems that it finally went bankrupt. I've also heard that they've been going around in circles lately, trying to cover up the fact that some of their most precious research assets escaped from their facilities."
it: Su quel posto da sempre si sentivano solo voci nere, e alla fine pare che sia crollato. Dicono anche che ultimamente esagerassero ancora di più, per nascondere la fuga di un soggetto compatibile prezioso.

jp: ああ、実験台の連中はレベル150。移動能力が無いって話だから、1体ずつ処分していけば苦戦はしない。
jp_grezzo: "ああ、実験台の連中はレベル150" + _da(3) + "。移動能力が無いって話だから、1体ずつ処分していけば苦戦はしない" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: The test subjects in question are level 150. I'm told they don't have the ability to move, so if you get rid of them one by one, they shouldn't put up much of a fight.
en_grezzo: "The test subjects in question are level 150. I'm told they don't have the ability to move, so if you get rid of them one by one, they shouldn't put up much of a fight."
it: Ah, i soggetti da esperimento sono di livello 150. Dicono che non abbiano capacità di movimento, quindi eliminandoli uno per uno non si fa fatica.

jp: 再生力も再現が不完全で魔法頼りみたいだから、押し切れないなら沈黙させておけばいいと思。やり合うならある程度の地獄耐性と防御力はあった方がいい。
jp_grezzo: "再生力も再現が不完全で魔法頼りみたいだから、押し切れないなら沈黙させておけばいいと思" + _u(3) + "。やり合うならある程度の地獄耐性と防御力はあった方がいい" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: Their regenerative power is also incomplete and seems to rely on magic, so if you can't seem to push through then you can silence them. If you're going to take these things on, you'd better have some level of hell resistance and a high level of defense.
en_grezzo: "Their regenerative power is also incomplete and seems to rely on magic, so if you can't seem to push through then you can silence them. If you're going to take these things on, you'd better have some level of hell resistance and a high level of defense."
it: Anche la rigenerazione è riprodotta male e pare che dipenda dalla magia, quindi se non riesci a sfondare basta metterli in silenzio. Se ti ci metti, meglio avere un po' di resistenza all'oltretomba e un po' di difesa.

jp: 他に逃げ遅れた所員やらが怪物化しているだろうけど、実験台と違って戦闘用に調整されていたわけでもないし大したことはない。
jp_grezzo: "他に逃げ遅れた所員やらが怪物化しているだろうけど、実験台と違って戦闘用に調整されていたわけでもないし大したことはない" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: Besides them, the staff members who failed to escape would have turned into monsters, but unlike the test subjects they weren't specifically designed for combat, so they should be pretty easy to deal with.
en_grezzo: "Besides them, the staff members who failed to escape would have turned into monsters, but unlike the test subjects they weren't specifically designed for combat, so they should be pretty easy to deal with."
it: Ci saranno anche gli impiegati che non hanno fatto in tempo a scappare, trasformati in mostri; ma a differenza dei soggetti da esperimento non sono stati messi a punto per il combattimento, quindi non sono granché.

jp: ただ、鎮圧用に神経ガスを撒く仕掛けがあったはず。もし作動していれば神経耐性もそこそこ必要だろう。
jp_grezzo: "ただ、鎮圧用に神経ガスを撒く仕掛けがあったはず" + _da(3) + "。もし作動していれば神経耐性もそこそこ必要だろう" + _na(3) + "。"
en: However, the facility is supposed to have a built-in mechanism that dispenses nerve gas for suppressing outbreaks. If it's still working, you'll need a lot of nerve resistance.
en_grezzo: "However, the facility is supposed to have a built-in mechanism that dispenses nerve gas for suppressing outbreaks. If it's still working, you'll need a lot of nerve resistance."
it: Però ci dovrebbe essere un congegno che sparge gas nervino per sedare le rivolte. Se è in funzione, ci vorrà anche una discreta resistenza ai nervi.

jp: 前の討伐隊に参加した冒険者から情報は伝わっている。破壊の悪魔『ラジャシェ』はレベル160。一瞬で飛び込んできて冷気と地獄の範囲攻撃を放ってくるらしい。
jp_grezzo: "前の討伐隊に参加した冒険者から情報は伝わっている" + _yo(3) + "。破壊の悪魔『ラジャシェ』はレベル160" + _da(3) + "。一瞬で飛び込んできて冷気と地獄の範囲攻撃を放ってくるらしい" + _na(3) + "。"
en: I have some first-hand accounts from the last party of adventurers who attempted to conquer the demon. <Lazasye> the destroy is level 160. I heard he'll lash out in an instant, unleashing a barrage of cold and hell attacks over a wide area.
en_grezzo: "I have some first-hand accounts from the last party of adventurers who attempted to conquer the demon. <Lazasye> the destroy is level 160. I heard he'll lash out in an instant, unleashing a barrage of cold and hell attacks over a wide area."
it: Le informazioni arrivano da un avventuriero che era nella spedizione precedente. Lazasye il demone della distruzione è di livello 160. Pare che piombi addosso in un attimo e scateni attacchi ad area di gelo e oltretomba.

jp: それと、MPを大量消費して強力な範囲攻撃も撃つそう。魔法耐性の低い奴らは、地形ごと跡形もなく消し飛んだと言っていた。
jp_grezzo: "それと、MPを大量消費して強力な範囲攻撃も撃つそう" + _da(3) + "。魔法耐性の低い奴らは、地形ごと跡形もなく消し飛んだと言っていた" + _yo(3) + "。"
en: He can also consume a large amount of MP to unleash a powerful area attack. They accounts described that those with low resistance to magic were wiped away without a trace, along with the surrounding terrain.
en_grezzo: "He can also consume a large amount of MP to unleash a powerful area attack. They accounts described that those with low resistance to magic were wiped away without a trace, along with the surrounding terrain."
it: E poi, dicono che consumi una gran quantità di MP per tirare un attacco ad area potentissimo. Raccontava che quelli con la resistenza alla magia bassa sono stati spazzati via senza lasciare traccia, e con loro il terreno.

jp: そんなのを食らいつつも泳いで帰ってきたらしいから、冒険者ってタフ。撃った後はラジャシェも大分消耗した様子だったらしいから、撃てて4発程度じゃない？MPを削り取ってもいいけど、その前に勝負がつくかもしれない。
jp_grezzo: "そんなのを食らいつつも泳いで帰ってきたらしいから、冒険者ってタフ" + _dana(3) + "。撃った後はラジャシェも大分消耗した様子だったらしいから、撃てて4発程度じゃない" + _kana(3) + "？MPを削り取ってもいいけど、その前に勝負がつくかもしれない" + _na(3) + "。"
en: The guy who made it out survived that attack and swam all the way back home. Adventurers sure are some tough nuts to crack, huh? Eyewitnesses claim that Lazasye appeared pretty exhausted after firing off that attack. My guess is that he'll only be able to use it at most four times before he's completely spent. Still, you're going have to deal with him until then.
en_grezzo: "The guy who made it out survived that attack and swam all the way back home. Adventurers sure are some tough nuts to crack, huh? Eyewitnesses claim that Lazasye appeared pretty exhausted after firing off that attack. My guess is that he'll only be able to use it at most four times before he's completely spent. Still, you're going have to deal with him until then."
it: Uno che si è preso una cosa del genere è tornato a nuoto: gli avventurieri sono gente dura. Pare che dopo il colpo anche Lazasye fosse parecchio consumato, quindi non ne tirerà più di quattro, no? Puoi anche svuotargli gli MP, ma forse la partita si chiude prima.

jp: 混沌の精霊を引き連れていて、ラジャシェが追加召喚することもあるらしい。念のためMPの回復手段も用意しておくといい。
jp_grezzo: "混沌の精霊を引き連れていて、ラジャシェが追加召喚することもあるらしい" + _yo(3) + "。念のためMPの回復手段も用意しておくといい" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: I've heard that Lazasye's brought some chaotic spirits along, and that he's capable of summoning even more. It'd be a good idea to have a way to recover MP just in case.
en_grezzo: "I've heard that Lazasye's brought some chaotic spirits along, and that he's capable of summoning even more. It'd be a good idea to have a way to recover MP just in case."
it: Si porta dietro spiriti del caos, e pare che Lazasye ne evochi anche altri. Per sicurezza tieni pronto un modo per recuperare MP.

jp: 王都に侵攻している、復讐の悪魔『インクツァル』はレベル160。物理攻撃で暴れまわるタイプみたい。聖なる盾やフェザーで対抗して。
jp_grezzo: "王都に侵攻している、復讐の悪魔『インクツァル』はレベル160。物理攻撃で暴れまわるタイプみたい" + _dana(3) + "。聖なる盾やフェザーで対抗して" + _kure(3) + "。"
en: The demon that's invading the royal capital, <Inqtual> the revenge, is level 160. He seems to be the type that goes on a rampage with physical attacks. Use Holy Shield and Feather to counter them.
en_grezzo: "The demon that's invading the royal capital, <Inqtual> the revenge, is level 160. He seems to be the type that goes on a rampage with physical attacks. Use Holy Shield and Feather to counter them."
it: Il demone che sta invadendo la capitale, Inqtual il demone della vendetta, è di livello 160. Sembra il tipo che si scatena con gli attacchi fisici. Rispondi con Scudo sacro e Piuma.

jp: 洗脳も得意らしい。集中の魔法やポーションで意志を高めておけば、被害は軽減できる。
jp_grezzo: "洗脳も得意らしい。集中の魔法やポーションで意志を高めておけば、被害は軽減できる" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: He's also skilled at brainwashing. If you can keep your willpower up with potions and spells of Concentration, you can mitigate the damage.
en_grezzo: "He's also skilled at brainwashing. If you can keep your willpower up with potions and spells of Concentration, you can mitigate the damage."
it: Pare che sia bravo anche nel lavaggio del cervello. Se tieni alta la volontà con la magia o con le pozioni di Concentrazione, il danno si attenua.

jp: 王宮魔導士が討伐できていないあたり、魔法には高い耐性を持っているはず。復讐心を煽って反乱軍のパワーゲージを増やすこともあるみたい。
jp_grezzo: "王宮魔導士が討伐できていないあたり、魔法には高い耐性を持っているはず。復讐心を煽って反乱軍のパワーゲージを増やすこともあるみたい" + _da(3) + "。"
en: Since not even the palace magicians have been able to defeat the demon, it must have a high resistance to magic. It also seems that he can bolster his rebel army's power gauges by inflaming their desire for revenge.
en_grezzo: "Since not even the palace magicians have been able to defeat the demon, it must have a high resistance to magic. It also seems that he can bolster his rebel army's power gauges by inflaming their desire for revenge."
it: Visto che i maghi di corte non sono riusciti ad abbatterlo, deve avere un'alta resistenza alla magia. E pare che a volte alzi la barra di potenza dei ribelli soffiando sul loro desiderio di vendetta.

jp: その反乱軍はエウダーナ召喚騎士と魔弓兵が中心のようだけど、悪魔の力でレベル145相当になっていると聞くから油断しないで。特に召喚騎士は、放っておくと厄介な魔物を召喚するかもしれない。
jp_grezzo: "その反乱軍はエウダーナ召喚騎士と魔弓兵が中心のようだけど、悪魔の力でレベル145相当になっていると聞くから油断しないで" + _kure(3) + "。特に召喚騎士は、放っておくと厄介な魔物を召喚するかもしれない" + _na(3) + "。"
en: The rebels themselves seem to be composed mainly of Eulderna summoning knights and magic archers, but I've heard that they've been granted demonic powers and are equivalent to level 145, so don't let your guard down. Watch out for the summoning knights especially, since they might summon some nasty demons if you leave them alone.
en_grezzo: "The rebels themselves seem to be composed mainly of Eulderna summoning knights and magic archers, but I've heard that they've been granted demonic powers and are equivalent to level 145, so don't let your guard down. Watch out for the summoning knights especially, since they might summon some nasty demons if you leave them alone."
it: Quei ribelli sembrano fatti soprattutto di cavalieri evocatori e arcieri magici di Eulderna, ma ho sentito che il potere del demone li porta al livello 145, quindi non abbassare la guardia. Occhio soprattutto ai cavalieri evocatori: se li lasci fare, possono evocare mostri fastidiosi.

jp: その事件は唯一の生き残りがこの前目を覚ましたばかり。免疫を持っていたそいつ以外は全員病死していたから、こっちとしても助かった。
jp_grezzo: "その事件は唯一の生き残りがこの前目を覚ましたばかり" + _da(3) + "。免疫を持っていたそいつ以外は全員病死していたから、こっちとしても助かった" + _yo(3) + "。"
en: The only survivor of that event just woke up the other day. Everyone else had died of the disease, but it turns out that he was immune, which is good news for us.
