en_grezzo: "The only survivor of that event just woke up the other day. Everyone else had died of the disease, but it turns out that he was immune, which is good news for us."
it: Di quel fatto, l'unico sopravvissuto si è svegliato solo l'altro giorno. A parte lui, che era immune, sono morti tutti di malattia: e per noi è stata una fortuna.

jp: 証言によると疫病の悪魔『ロアトニス』がレベル160。エーテル病を進行させる眼差しを向けてくるらしいから、抗体も一応持っていくといいかもしれない。
jp_grezzo: "証言によると疫病の悪魔『ロアトニス』がレベル160。エーテル病を進行させる眼差しを向けてくるらしいから、抗体も一応持っていくといいかもしれない" + _na(3) + "。"
en: By his account, <Roatonis> the infections is level 160. His gaze causes the progression of ether disease, so it would be best to take some antidotes with you.
en_grezzo: "By his account, <Roatonis> the infections is level 160. His gaze causes the progression of ether disease, so it would be best to take some antidotes with you."
it: Stando alla sua testimonianza, Roatonis il demone della pestilenza è di livello 160. Pare che lanci uno sguardo che fa avanzare la malattia dell'etere, quindi forse conviene portarsi dietro anche qualche cristallo curativo.

jp: それと死の宣告も使うらしいから、予防手段のホーリーヴェイルや解除手段の浄化の杖や巻物もあると安心。
jp_grezzo: "それと死の宣告も使うらしいから、予防手段のホーリーヴェイルや解除手段の浄化の杖や巻物もあると安心" + _dana(3) + "。"
en: I was also told that he can use Death Word, so it's a good idea to cast Holy Veil as a preventative measure, and to bring some rods or scrolls of holy light as a recovery measure.
en_grezzo: "I was also told that he can use Death Word, so it's a good idea to cast Holy Veil as a preventative measure, and to bring some rods or scrolls of holy light as a recovery measure."
it: E poi pare che usi anche la Sentenza di morte, quindi si sta più tranquilli con un Velo sacro come prevenzione e con bacchette o pergamene di luce sacra per toglierla.

jp: 町中には様々なアンデッドが徘徊していてどいつもこいつもレベル140相当に強化されているって話。
jp_grezzo: "町中には様々なアンデッドが徘徊していてどいつもこいつもレベル140相当に強化されているって話" + _da(3) + "。"
en: There are all sorts of undead wandering around the town, and every one of them has been strengthened to the equivalent of level 140.
en_grezzo: "There are all sorts of undead wandering around the town, and every one of them has been strengthened to the equivalent of level 140."
it: In giro per la città vagano non morti di ogni tipo, e dicono che siano tutti rinforzati fino al livello 140.

jp: ロアトニスの傍らにはレベル154のサヴァントクイーンもいて、一緒にゾンビを強化したりゾンビから体力を吸収したりするらしい。
jp_grezzo: "ロアトニスの傍らにはレベル154のサヴァントクイーンもいて、一緒にゾンビを強化したりゾンビから体力を吸収したりするらしい" + _na(3) + "。"
en: Apparently, there's also a level 153 zombie queen at Roatonis' side, and together they're able to strengthen the zombies and absorb their energy.
en_grezzo: "Apparently, there's also a level 153 zombie queen at Roatonis' side, and together they're able to strengthen the zombies and absorb their energy."
it: Accanto a Roatonis c'è anche una regina savant di livello 154, e insieme rinforzano gli zombi e ne assorbono le forze.

jp: サヴァントクイーンは魔法耐性が高いけど、火炎にとても弱い。ゾンビを減らしてからサヴァントクイーンを倒し、最後にロアトニスを倒すのがいい。
jp_grezzo: "サヴァントクイーンは魔法耐性が高いけど、火炎にとても弱い" + _yo(3) + "。ゾンビを減らしてからサヴァントクイーンを倒し、最後にロアトニスを倒すのがいい" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: The Savant Queen has high magic resistance, but she's very vulnerable to fire. It would be a good idea to cut down the zombie horde first, then take out the zombie queen, and then finally go after Roatonis.
en_grezzo: "The Savant Queen has high magic resistance, but she's very vulnerable to fire. It would be a good idea to cut down the zombie horde first, then take out the zombie queen, and then finally go after Roatonis."
it: La regina savant ha alta la resistenza alla magia, ma è debolissima al fuoco. Meglio ridurre prima gli zombi, poi abbattere la regina savant, e per ultimo Roatonis.

jp: ロアトニス自体には特に効くわけじゃないけど、強力な火炎属性攻撃があると楽になるはず。
jp_grezzo: "ロアトニス自体には特に効くわけじゃないけど、強力な火炎属性攻撃があると楽になるはず" + _da(3) + "。"
en: It won't be particularly effective against Roatonis himself, but a powerful fire attack should make the fight easier.
en_grezzo: "It won't be particularly effective against Roatonis himself, but a powerful fire attack should make the fight easier."
it: Su Roatonis in sé non è che funzioni granché, ma con un attacco potente d'elemento fuoco le cose si fanno più facili.

jp: 各地に出現した悪魔は一掃されたけど、伝承によるとまだ一体残っている。もしかすると混沌の巨城に眠っているのかもしれない。
jp_grezzo: "各地に出現した悪魔は一掃されたけど、伝承によるとまだ一体残っている" + _nda(3) + "。もしかすると混沌の巨城に眠っているのかもしれない" + _na(3) + "。"
en: The demons that have appeared in various places have been wiped out, but according to legend, there's still one left. Maybe it's still asleep somewhere inside the Cradle of Chaos.
en_grezzo: "The demons that have appeared in various places have been wiped out, but according to legend, there's still one left. Maybe it's still asleep somewhere inside the Cradle of Chaos."
it: I demoni comparsi qua e là sono stati spazzati via, ma secondo la tradizione ne resta ancora uno. Forse dorme nella Culla del Caos.

jp: 束縛の悪魔『エゲルベイル』はレベル180。束縛付与や蜘蛛の巣で動きを封じてくるとされている。
jp_grezzo: "束縛の悪魔『エゲルベイル』はレベル180" + _da(3) + "。束縛付与や蜘蛛の巣で動きを封じてくるとされている" + _yo(3) + "。"
en: <Egelveil> the bind is level 180. She's said to use bondage grants and spider webs to block your movements.
en_grezzo: "<Egelveil> the bind is level 180. She's said to use bondage grants and spider webs to block your movements."
it: Egelveil il demone dei vincoli è di livello 180. Si dice che blocchi i movimenti con la costrizione e con le ragnatele.

jp: 戦うなら蜘蛛の巣を水魔法や煙幕でかき消して肉薄し、さっさと勝負を決めたほうがいい。束縛状態ではDVが高くても通常攻撃を回避できないから、数々の攻撃に耐えなければならない。壁や煙幕で射線が通らないようにすることも考えた方がいい。
jp_grezzo: "戦うなら蜘蛛の巣を水魔法や煙幕でかき消して肉薄し、さっさと勝負を決めたほうがいい" + _daro(3) + "。束縛状態ではDVが高くても通常攻撃を回避できないから、数々の攻撃に耐えなければならない" + _yo(3) + "。壁や煙幕で射線が通らないようにすることも考えた方がいい" + _na(3) + "。"
en: If you're going to fight her, you'd better drown out the spider webs with water magic or a smoke screen, move in as close as you can, and finish the job quickly. You're going to take a lot of punishment because you can't evade normal attacks when you're in bondage, even if your DV is high. Consider creating walls and putting up smoke screens to prevent her projectiles from getting through.
en_grezzo: "If you're going to fight her, you'd better drown out the spider webs with water magic or a smoke screen, move in as close as you can, and finish the job quickly. You're going to take a lot of punishment because you can't evade normal attacks when you're in bondage, even if your DV is high. Consider creating walls and putting up smoke screens to prevent her projectiles from getting through."
it: Se la combatti, meglio cancellare le ragnatele con la magia dell'acqua o con una cortina di fumo, arrivarle addosso e chiudere in fretta. Nello stato di costrizione gli attacchi normali non si schivano nemmeno con un DV alto, quindi ne devi reggere parecchi. Conviene pensare anche a tagliare la linea di tiro con muri o cortine di fumo.

jp: 手下も含めれば様々な属性で攻撃してくるらしいけど、特に音耐性を高めておくといい。なんなら属性耐性のポーションで底上げしてもいいくらい。
jp_grezzo: "手下も含めれば様々な属性で攻撃してくるらしいけど、特に音耐性を高めておくといい" + _daro(3) + "。なんなら属性耐性のポーションで底上げしてもいいくらい" + _da(3) + "。"
en: The demon and her minions will attack with a variety of elements, but it'd be a good idea to focus on sound resistance in particular. If you want, you could boost your resistance even further with a potion of resistance.
en_grezzo: "The demon and her minions will attack with a variety of elements, but it'd be a good idea to focus on sound resistance in particular. If you want, you could boost your resistance even further with a potion of resistance."
it: Fra lei e i suoi sottoposti attaccano con elementi di ogni sorta, ma conviene alzare soprattutto la resistenza al suono. Volendo, si può anche rialzarla con una pozione di resistenza.

jp: ロスリアの特務部隊が神の間を目指しているのは知っている。隊員のレベルは164、それを率いる蒼天の稲妻『ランカータ』はレベル168。
jp_grezzo: "ロスリアの特務部隊が神の間を目指しているのは知っている" + _kana(3) + "。隊員のレベルは164、それを率いる蒼天の稲妻『ランカータ』はレベル168" + _da(3) + "。"
en: Do you know about the special task force from Lothria that's aiming to reach the Eternal Seal? The squad's level is 164, and its leader, <Lankata> the lightning of blue, is level 168.
en_grezzo: "Do you know about the special task force from Lothria that's aiming to reach the Eternal Seal? The squad's level is 164, and its leader, <Lankata> the lightning of blue, is level 168."
it: Sai che la squadra speciale di Lothria punta al Sigillo Eterno? I membri sono di livello 164, e chi li guida, Lankata il fulmine del cielo azzurro, è di livello 168.

jp: ランカータと強化兵は高い魔法耐性を持っているから魔法属性の魔法は悪手。強化兵のほうは再生能力も併せ持っていてタフだから後に回したいところだけど、異次元の手で敵を引き寄せるのが得意。壁生成や煙幕で視線を切ると邪魔されずに済む。
jp_grezzo: "ランカータと強化兵は高い魔法耐性を持っているから魔法属性の魔法は悪手" + _dana(3) + "。強化兵のほうは再生能力も併せ持っていてタフだから後に回したいところだけど、異次元の手で敵を引き寄せるのが得意" + _da(3) + "。壁生成や煙幕で視線を切ると邪魔されずに済む" + _yo(3) + "。"
en: Lankata and her troops have high magic resistance, so using magic attribute spells is a bad idea. The troops themselves will be tough to break though since they also have decent regenerative abilities, so leaving them for later might be an option, but they're skilled at pulling enemies back towards them with Draw Shadow. If you cut off their line of sight with Create Wall or smoke screens, you'll be able to get past them.
en_grezzo: "Lankata and her troops have high magic resistance, so using magic attribute spells is a bad idea. The troops themselves will be tough to break though since they also have decent regenerative abilities, so leaving them for later might be an option, but they're skilled at pulling enemies back towards them with Draw Shadow. If you cut off their line of sight with Create Wall or smoke screens, you'll be able to get past them."
it: Lankata e i soldati potenziati hanno alta la resistenza alla magia, quindi le magie d'elemento magia sono una cattiva idea. I soldati potenziati sono duri, perché si rigenerano anche, e verrebbe voglia di lasciarli per ultimi; ma sono bravi a tirarsi addosso il nemico col Richiamo d'ombra. Se tagli la linea di vista con la creazione di muri o con una cortina di fumo, non ti danno noia.

jp: 特務部隊の正規メンバーは射撃と回復魔法を持っているだけで特に脅威にはならない。まずは、死を恐れず突撃してくる歴戦の老兵から処理するといいと思。いずれも通常物理攻撃がメインのようだから、PVとDVを重視するべき。
jp_grezzo: "特務部隊の正規メンバーは射撃と回復魔法を持っているだけで特に脅威にはならない" + _daro(3) + "。まずは、死を恐れず突撃してくる歴戦の老兵から処理するといいと思" + _u(3) + "。いずれも通常物理攻撃がメインのようだから、PVとDVを重視するべき" + _da(3) + "。"
en: The normal ranks of the special forces will not be a particular threat, as they only have shooting and recovery magic. I think it would be best to deal with the old guard first, who will charge at you without fear of death. It seems that they mostly use physical attacks, so you should focus on increasing your PV and DV.
en_grezzo: "The normal ranks of the special forces will not be a particular threat, as they only have shooting and recovery magic. I think it would be best to deal with the old guard first, who will charge at you without fear of death. It seems that they mostly use physical attacks, so you should focus on increasing your PV and DV."
it: I membri regolari della squadra speciale hanno solo tiro e magia di cura, e non sono una vera minaccia. Secondo me conviene togliere prima i vecchi veterani, che caricano senza paura di morire. Comunque, visto che vanno soprattutto di attacco fisico normale, conviene puntare su PV e DV.

jp: そうそう。情報によると連中は消耗を抑えるために交戦を最小限にしているらしい。無理矢理突破して先に進んでしまえば、わざわざ追撃してこないんじゃない。
jp_grezzo: "そうそう。情報によると連中は消耗を抑えるために交戦を最小限にしているらしい" + _yo(3) + "。無理矢理突破して先に進んでしまえば、わざわざ追撃してこないんじゃない" + _kana(3) + "。"
en: Here's another tip. According to my sources, the squad is trying to minimize hostile engagements in order to conserve their energy. If you can force your way past them and proceed onwards, they probably won't bother to come after you.
en_grezzo: "Here's another tip. According to my sources, the squad is trying to minimize hostile engagements in order to conserve their energy. If you can force your way past them and proceed onwards, they probably won't bother to come after you."
it: Ah, giusto. Stando alle informazioni, quelli riducono al minimo gli scontri per non consumarsi. Se sfondi a forza e tiri dritto, non è che si mettano a inseguirti.

jp: それともう一つ。詳細は不明だけど、ランカータの任務には誰かの捜索も入っているよう。生かしておくと何か起きるかもしれないけど…まぁ、倒してしまっても別に支障はない。
jp_grezzo: "それともう一つ。詳細は不明だけど、ランカータの任務には誰かの捜索も入っているよう" + _dana(3) + "。生かしておくと何か起きるかもしれないけど…まぁ、倒してしまっても別に支障はない" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: And one more thing. I'm not sure of the details, but it looks like Lankata's assigned mission includes a search for someone. If you let him complete his duties unhindered, something bad might happen, but... well, that won't matter if you manage to defeat him.
en_grezzo: "And one more thing. I'm not sure of the details, but it looks like Lankata's assigned mission includes a search for someone. If you let him complete his duties unhindered, something bad might happen, but... well, that won't matter if you manage to defeat him."
it: E ancora una cosa. I dettagli non li so, ma pare che nella missione di Lankata rientri anche la ricerca di qualcuno. Se lo lasci in vita potrebbe succedere qualcosa, ma... be', anche abbatterlo non crea problemi.

jp: エウダーナの人形使いの切り札…それが4体のユナイデッド。鹵獲した古代アンデッド兵器ごと姿を消した人形使いだけど、混沌の巨城での目撃情報がある。ユナイデッドはキング、クイーン、ジャック、ジョーカーの4体で、全てレベル175。
jp_grezzo: "エウダーナの人形使いの切り札…それが4体のユナイデッド" + _da(3) + "。鹵獲した古代アンデッド兵器ごと姿を消した人形使いだけど、混沌の巨城での目撃情報がある" + _yo(3) + "。ユナイデッドはキング、クイーン、ジャック、ジョーカーの4体で、全てレベル175。"
en: The trump card of Eulderna's puppeteers... the four Unitdead. The puppeteers have vanished along with the ancient undead weapons they seized, but there have been sightings of them in the Cradle of Chaos. The four Unitdead are the king, queen, jack, and joker, all level 175.
en_grezzo: "The trump card of Eulderna's puppeteers... the four Unitdead. The puppeteers have vanished along with the ancient undead weapons they seized, but there have been sightings of them in the Cradle of Chaos. The four Unitdead are the king, queen, jack, and joker, all level 175."
it: L'asso nella manica dei burattinai di Eulderna... sono i quattro unimorti. I burattinai sono spariti insieme alle armi non morte antiche che avevano catturato, ma ci sono avvistamenti nella Culla del Caos. Gli unimorti sono quattro: il re, la regina, il fante e il jolly, tutti di livello 175.

jp: キングは物理攻撃力と再生能力特化型。倒すのに時間がかかるけど、暴れさせておくと被害が広がる。逆に言うとこいつを早めに落とせれば余裕ができる。
jp_grezzo: "キングは物理攻撃力と再生能力特化型" + _da(3) + "。倒すのに時間がかかるけど、暴れさせておくと被害が広がる。逆に言うとこいつを早めに落とせれば余裕ができる" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: The king is specialized in physical attack power and regenerative ability. It will take a while to bring him down, but if you let him run rampant the damage he causes will expand. Conversely, take him down sooner and you'll buy yourself some more time.
en_grezzo: "The king is specialized in physical attack power and regenerative ability. It will take a while to bring him down, but if you let him run rampant the damage he causes will expand. Conversely, take him down sooner and you'll buy yourself some more time."
it: Il re è specializzato in potenza d'attacco fisico e rigenerazione. Ci vuole tempo per abbatterlo, ma se lo lasci scatenare i danni si allargano. Detto al contrario: se lo butti giù presto, respiri.

jp: クイーンは後衛型で攻撃力はさほどでもないけど、再生能力が高いから倒すのは最後に回したほうがいい。
jp_grezzo: "クイーンは後衛型で攻撃力はさほどでもないけど、再生能力が高いから倒すのは最後に回したほうがいい" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: The queen is a rear-guard type - not much offensive power, but she has a high regenerative ability, so it would be better try to defeat her last.
en_grezzo: "The queen is a rear-guard type - not much offensive power, but she has a high regenerative ability, so it would be better try to defeat her last."
it: La regina è del tipo di retroguardia e non ha grande potenza d'attacco, ma si rigenera molto: meglio lasciarla per ultima.

jp: ジャックは平凡な地獄属性攻撃がメインだけど、全体バフ消去も行うし追い詰めると強烈な魔法範囲攻撃を連射する。パワーゲージを使ってでも火力を集中して真っ先に始末したいところ。
jp_grezzo: "ジャックは平凡な地獄属性攻撃がメインだけど、全体バフ消去も行うし追い詰めると強烈な魔法範囲攻撃を連射する" + _yo(3) + "。パワーゲージを使ってでも火力を集中して真っ先に始末したいところ" + _dana(3) + "。"
en: The jack's main action is a mediocre hell-element attack, but he also erases all the buffs of his opponent and fires a powerful magic range attack when cornered. You should focus all your firepower in taking him out first, even if you have to expend some of your power gauge in the process.
en_grezzo: "The jack's main action is a mediocre hell-element attack, but he also erases all the buffs of his opponent and fires a powerful magic range attack when cornered. You should focus all your firepower in taking him out first, even if you have to expend some of your power gauge in the process."
it: Il fante va soprattutto di attacchi d'oltretomba ordinari, ma cancella anche tutti i potenziamenti, e quando lo metti alle strette spara a raffica attacchi magici ad area potentissimi. È quello da togliere per primo, concentrando la potenza di fuoco anche a costo di consumare la barra.

jp: ジョーカーはテレポートしながら冷気と電撃、鈍足の魔法を放ち、範囲回復もこなす厄介なやつ。先に始末しようにも粘るし逃げるから、後回しの方がマシ。
jp_grezzo: "ジョーカーはテレポートしながら冷気と電撃、鈍足の魔法を放ち、範囲回復もこなす厄介なやつ" + _da(3) + "。先に始末しようにも粘るし逃げるから、後回しの方がマシ" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: The joker is a nasty little bugger - he can teleport around, unleash cold and electric attacks, cast Slow, and use group healing spells. If you try to go after him first, he'll just keep running around persistently, so it would be best to deal with him later.
en_grezzo: "The joker is a nasty little bugger - he can teleport around, unleash cold and electric attacks, cast Slow, and use group healing spells. If you try to go after him first, he'll just keep running around persistently, so it would be best to deal with him later."
it: Il jolly è un tipo fastidioso: si teletrasporta, tira gelo, fulmine e Rallentamento, e fa anche cure ad area. A volerlo togliere per primo resiste e scappa, quindi tanto vale lasciarlo per dopo.

jp: どいつも耐性面で特に弱点はない。普通のアンデッドが苦手としている火炎にも強い。しかもジョーカーは魔法耐性も高いよう。
jp_grezzo: "どいつも耐性面で特に弱点はない" + _yo(3) + "。普通のアンデッドが苦手としている火炎にも強い。しかもジョーカーは魔法耐性も高いよう" + _da(3) + "。"
en: None of the unitdead have any particular weaknesses in terms of resistance. They're also resistant to fire, which the average undead would normally be weak to. Plus, the Joker seems to have high magic resistance.
en_grezzo: "None of the unitdead have any particular weaknesses in terms of resistance. They're also resistant to fire, which the average undead would normally be weak to. Plus, the Joker seems to have high magic resistance."
it: Nessuno dei quattro ha punti deboli particolari nelle resistenze. Reggono bene anche il fuoco, che di solito è il punto debole dei non morti. E per giunta il jolly pare avere alta anche la resistenza alla magia.

jp: もしまともに戦うことになれば苦戦は必至。一体倒すたびに上の階に逃げ戻るほうがいいかもしれない。
jp_grezzo: "もしまともに戦うことになれば苦戦は必至" + _daro(3) + "。一体倒すたびに上の階に逃げ戻るほうがいいかもしれない" + _na(3) + "。"
en: Trying to fight them all head-on will result in an uphill battle. You might as well retreat upstairs after defeating each one to rest and recuperate.
en_grezzo: "Trying to fight them all head-on will result in an uphill battle. You might as well retreat upstairs after defeating each one to rest and recuperate."
it: Se ti tocca combatterli sul serio, la lotta sarà dura. Forse conviene ritirarsi al piano di sopra ogni volta che ne abbatti uno.

jp: 下の階に逃げて進むこともできるだろうけど、後続者が被害に遭うのも確実。足止めができると考えるのか、禍根は断っておくべきと考えるのか…それは次第。
jp_grezzo: "下の階に逃げて進むこともできるだろうけど、後続者が被害に遭うのも確実。足止めができると考えるのか、禍根は断っておくべきと考えるのか…それは" + _kimi(3) + "次第" + _dana(3) + "。"
en: You might be able to escape past them and continue on downstairs, but if you choose to do so, you can be certain that your followers will suffer some damage. Whether you think that you're capable of stalling them, or that you should cut your losses and move on... that's up to you to decide.
en_grezzo: "You might be able to escape past them and continue on downstairs, but if you choose to do so, you can be certain that your followers will suffer some damage. Whether you think that you're capable of stalling them, or that you should cut your losses and move on... that's up to you to decide."
it: Puoi anche scappare al piano di sotto e tirare dritto, ma allora è certo che ci rimettono quelli che vengono dopo. Se pensi di poterli trattenere, o se pensi che il male vada tagliato alla radice... decidi tu.

jp: やっぱりも、テスカトリポカに神の間に来いって言われた？
jp_grezzo: "やっぱり" + _kimi(3) + "も、テスカトリポカに神の間に来いって言われた" + _noka(3) + "？"
en: So Tezcatlipoca ordered you to come to the Eternal Seal as well?
en_grezzo: "So Tezcatlipoca ordered you to come to the Eternal Seal as well?"
it: Anche a te Tezcatlipoca ha detto di andare al Sigillo Eterno, eh?

jp: 調べによると、テスカトリポカはかつてエヘカトルと双璧をなす神だったらしい。けれど今では力を没収されてレベル200まで落ちぶれていると聞く。
jp_grezzo: "調べによると、テスカトリポカはかつてエヘカトルと双璧をなす神だったらしい" + _yo(3) + "。けれど今では力を没収されてレベル200まで落ちぶれていると聞く" + _na(3) + "。"
en: According to my research, Tezcatlipoca used to be a god who rivaled Ehekatl in power. But now, I've heard that his powers have been stripped and he's down to level 200.
en_grezzo: "According to my research, Tezcatlipoca used to be a god who rivaled Ehekatl in power. But now, I've heard that his powers have been stripped and he's down to level 200."
it: Dalle mie ricerche, Tezcatlipoca un tempo era un dio che stava alla pari con Ehekatl. Ma adesso, dicono, gli hanno confiscato la forza ed è caduto fino al livello 200.

jp: 夜と煙と戦争の神様だから、煙を撒いて翻弄しつつ闇討ち…という戦法を取ってくるかもしれない。広範囲に火柱や蜘蛛の巣、闇の霧などを撒けるものや爆発で煙をかき消さないと、一方的に殴られる。
jp_grezzo: "夜と煙と戦争の神様だから、煙を撒いて翻弄しつつ闇討ち…という戦法を取ってくるかもしれない。広範囲に火柱や蜘蛛の巣、闇の霧などを撒けるものや爆発で煙をかき消さないと、一方的に殴られる" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: Since he's the god of the night, smoke, and war, he might use the strategy of scattering smoke to toss you around and then strike in the dark.... If you don't drown out the smoke with something that can spread fire columns, spider webs, or dark mist over a large area, or use explosions to clear it out, you'll be beaten singlehandedly.
en_grezzo: "Since he's the god of the night, smoke, and war, he might use the strategy of scattering smoke to toss you around and then strike in the dark.... If you don't drown out the smoke with something that can spread fire columns, spider webs, or dark mist over a large area, or use explosions to clear it out, you'll be beaten singlehandedly."
it: È il dio della notte, del fumo e della guerra, quindi potrebbe usare la tattica di spargere fumo, farti girare a vuoto e colpirti al buio. Se non hai qualcosa che spanda su un'area larga colonne di fuoco, ragnatele o Nebbia d'oscurità, o delle esplosioni per spazzare via il fumo, le prendi e basta.

jp: 自信はないけど、おそらく混沌と幻惑に耐性があったほうがいいと思。
jp_grezzo: "自信はないけど、おそらく混沌と幻惑に耐性があったほうがいいと思" + _u(3) + "。"
en: I'm not sure if it will work, but I'd probably want to increase my resistance to chaos and mind damage.
en_grezzo: "I'm not sure if it will work, but I'd probably want to increase my resistance to chaos and mind damage."
it: Non ne sono sicuro, ma probabilmente conviene avere resistenza al caos e resistenza mentale.

jp: 身に着けている鏡は、混沌と魔法に耐性を持ち、それ以外の魔法も一部反射するとされている。魔法攻撃を中心に挑むと苦戦するはずだから、使えそうな攻撃アイテムや攻撃技能もピックアップしておくといい。どうしても魔法で攻めたいなら混沌と魔法属性以外で。自分はその属性への耐性を高めておくこともに忘れずに。
jp_grezzo: "身に着けている鏡は、混沌と魔法に耐性を持ち、それ以外の魔法も一部反射するとされている" + _na(3) + "。魔法攻撃を中心に挑むと苦戦するはずだから、使えそうな攻撃アイテムや攻撃技能もピックアップしておくといい" + _daro(3) + "。どうしても魔法で攻めたいなら混沌と魔法属性以外で。自分はその属性への耐性を高めておくこともに忘れずに" + _na(3) + "。"
en: The mirror he's wearing is said to be resistant to chaos and magic, and also reflects some other types of magic. If you want to attack with magic, you'll have a hard time, so it'd be a good idea to bring along some offensive items and skills that might be useful. If you really want to attack with magic, use something other than chaos and magic attributes. Don't forget to build up your resistance to those attributes as well.
en_grezzo: "The mirror he's wearing is said to be resistant to chaos and magic, and also reflects some other types of magic. If you want to attack with magic, you'll have a hard time, so it'd be a good idea to bring along some offensive items and skills that might be useful. If you really want to attack with magic, use something other than chaos and magic attributes. Don't forget to build up your resistance to those attributes as well."
it: Lo specchio che porta addosso, dicono, resiste al caos e alla magia, e riflette anche una parte delle altre magie. Puntando soprattutto sull'attacco magico farai fatica, quindi tieni pronti anche oggetti e abilità d'attacco che possano servire. Se proprio vuoi attaccare con la magia, usa qualcosa che non sia caos né elemento magia. E non dimenticare di alzare anche la tua resistenza a quegli elementi.

jp: さすがに情報が少なすぎてわからない。でもこっちだって伊逹に長年情報屋をやってるわけじゃない。ちょっと考えてみる。
jp_grezzo: "さすがに情報が少なすぎてわからない" + _yo(3) + "。でもこっちだって伊逹に長年情報屋をやってるわけじゃない" + _nda(3) + "。ちょっと考えてみる" + _ka(3) + "。"
en: Even for someone like me whose job it is to seek out information about everything there is, I'm finding myself at the end of my rope here. But it's not like I've been an informer for that many years, anyway. Let's think this over for a bit.
en_grezzo: "Even for someone like me whose job it is to seek out information about everything there is, I'm finding myself at the end of my rope here. But it's not like I've been an informer for that many years, anyway. Let's think this over for a bit."
it: Qui davvero le informazioni sono troppo poche e non ci arrivo. Ma non faccio l'informatore da tanti anni per finta. Fammici pensare un attimo.

jp: まず拘束されていて動けないだろうけど、魔力で引き寄せてくるかもしれないし油断は禁物。テレポートを防止する装備があればそんな心配もいらないかもしれない。
jp_grezzo: "まず拘束されていて動けないだろうけど、魔力で引き寄せてくるかもしれないし油断は禁物" + _da(3) + "。テレポートを防止する装備があればそんな心配もいらないかもしれない" + _na(3) + "。"
en: First of all, the adversary is bound and won't be able to move, but he might be able to draw you in with his magic, so don't let your guard down. If you have equipment that prevents teleportation, then you might not have to worry about that.
en_grezzo: "First of all, the adversary is bound and won't be able to move, but he might be able to draw you in with his magic, so don't let your guard down. If you have equipment that prevents teleportation, then you might not have to worry about that."
it: Intanto sarà legato e non potrà muoversi, ma potrebbe tirarti a sé col potere magico, quindi niente distrazioni. Con un equipaggiamento che impedisce il teletrasporto forse non c'è nemmeno da preoccuparsi.

jp: 混沌を司っている以上、混沌耐性は高いだろうし、混沌の精霊を召喚することも考えられる。召喚対策やMP回復手段を用意しておくべき。
jp_grezzo: "混沌を司っている以上、混沌耐性は高いだろうし、混沌の精霊を召喚することも考えられる" + _yo(3) + "。召喚対策やMP回復手段を用意しておくべき" + _da(3) + "。"
en: Since he's the master of Chaos itself, his chaos resistance ought to be pretty high, and he'll probably summon chaotic spirits as well. You should have a way of preventing him from summoning things and a method of recovering MP.
en_grezzo: "Since he's the master of Chaos itself, his chaos resistance ought to be pretty high, and he'll probably summon chaotic spirits as well. You should have a way of preventing him from summoning things and a method of recovering MP."
it: Dato che governa il caos, la resistenza al caos ce l'avrà alta, ed è pensabile che evochi spiriti del caos. Meglio prepararsi contro le evocazioni e con un modo per recuperare MP.

jp: 相手の攻撃もやはり混沌属性が中心？いや、それ以外にも何か使うかもしれないし耐性は一通り揃えて損はない。埋まらない穴は属性耐性のポーションでどうにかなると思いたい。
jp_grezzo: "相手の攻撃もやはり混沌属性が中心" + _kana(3) + "？いや、それ以外にも何か使うかもしれないし耐性は一通り揃えて損はない" + _daro(3) + "。埋まらない穴は属性耐性のポーションでどうにかなると思いたい" + _na(3) + "。"
en: Since this is Chaos we're talking about, maybe his attacks will be mostly chaos-based? ...No, he might have something else up his sleeve, and it wouldn't hurt to come packing a full set of strong resistances anyway. I'd like to think that a potion of resistance could help fill in the gaps that might be left over.
en_grezzo: "Since this is Chaos we're talking about, maybe his attacks will be mostly chaos-based? ...No, he might have something else up his sleeve, and it wouldn't hurt to come packing a full set of strong resistances anyway. I'd like to think that a potion of resistance could help fill in the gaps that might be left over."
it: Anche i suoi attacchi saranno soprattutto d'elemento caos? No, potrebbe usare anche altro, e avere tutte le resistenze in ordine non fa male. I buchi che restano spero si tappino con una pozione di resistenza.

jp: もし迂闊に近づいただけで死ぬような相手だった時は、ひたすら逃げ回ってパターンを見極めたり時間を稼ぐのもありじゃない。そのうち後続の冒険者が追いついてきて、状況が変わるかもしれないし。
jp_grezzo: "もし迂闊に近づいただけで死ぬような相手だった時は、ひたすら逃げ回ってパターンを見極めたり時間を稼ぐのもありじゃない" + _kana(3) + "。そのうち後続の冒険者が追いついてきて、状況が変わるかもしれないし。"
en: If you find yourself about to perish from carelessly getting too close, you might as well just keep running around, try to figure out his attack patterns and buy yourself some time. Eventually, the other party of adventurers on their way might catch up to you and help turn the tables.
en_grezzo: "If you find yourself about to perish from carelessly getting too close, you might as well just keep running around, try to figure out his attack patterns and buy yourself some time. Eventually, the other party of adventurers on their way might catch up to you and help turn the tables."
it: Se ti trovi davanti uno che ti ammazza solo ad avvicinarti per sbaglio, ci sta anche scappare in tondo per capire gli schemi e guadagnare tempo. Intanto gli avventurieri che vengono dopo ti raggiungono, e la situazione può cambiare.

jp: 状況から見て、太古の昔より伝わる儀式…「人狼遊儀」で間違いない。
jp_grezzo: "状況から見て、太古の昔より伝わる儀式…「人狼遊儀」で間違いない" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: Judging from the current situation, this is undoubtedly the works of an ancient ritual... \ncalled the <Werewolf-Ritual-Game>.
en_grezzo: "Judging from the current situation, this is undoubtedly the works of an ancient ritual... \ncalled the <Werewolf-Ritual-Game>."
it: A vedere come stanno le cose, non c'è dubbio: è un rito che viene dalla notte dei tempi... \nsi chiama <Il Gioco Rituale del Lupo Mannaro>.

jp: 儀式の内容はこう。狼が人間に化けて人里に潜り込み、深夜に一人ずつ住人を生贄として捧げていく。強い者を捧げるほど儀式はより早く進行し、一定段階に到達すると神狼が降臨。その後は狼たちの支配する餌場となり果てるってわけ。狼が数匹でそのまま暴れてもあっという間に駆除されてしまうから、こういう手段を取っているの。
jp_grezzo: "儀式の内容はこう" + _da(3) + "。狼が人間に化けて人里に潜り込み、深夜に一人ずつ住人を生贄として捧げていく。強い者を捧げるほど儀式はより早く進行し、一定段階に到達すると神狼が降臨。その後は狼たちの支配する餌場となり果てるってわけ" + _da(3) + "。狼が数匹でそのまま暴れてもあっという間に駆除されてしまうから、こういう手段を取っているの" + _daro(3) + "。"
en: The procedure of the ritual are as follows: \nA wolf disguises itself as a human, sneaks into a human village, and sacrifices the residents one by one in the middle of the night. \nThe more powerful the sacrifice is, the faster the ritual progresses, and when a critical mass of sacrifice is offered, the wolf-god will be summoned. After that, the town will become a feeding ground dominated by wolves. If a few wolves assault the town, they would be exterminated in no time, so they probably took this method instead.
en_grezzo: "The procedure of the ritual are as follows: \nA wolf disguises itself as a human, sneaks into a human village, and sacrifices the residents one by one in the middle of the night. \nThe more powerful the sacrifice is, the faster the ritual progresses, and when a critical mass of sacrifice is offered, the wolf-god will be summoned. After that, the town will become a feeding ground dominated by wolves. If a few wolves assault the town, they would be exterminated in no time, so they probably took this method instead."
it: Il rito funziona così: \nun lupo prende sembianze umane, si infila fra la gente e a notte fonda offre in sacrificio gli abitanti, uno per volta. \nPiù forte è chi viene offerto, più il rito corre; e arrivato a un certo punto scende il <Lupo Divino>. Da lì in poi il posto finisce a fare da mangiatoia sotto il dominio dei lupi. Se quattro lupi si mettessero a menare così com'è li sterminerebbero in un attimo: ecco perché prendono questa strada.

jp: この儀式の厄介なところは、普通の方法で人狼を全滅させても終わらないこと。儀式の進行手段の反対…真昼に一匹ずつ人狼を特殊な方法で処刑していき、全滅させることでのみ、儀式が相殺されるらしい。
jp_grezzo: "この儀式の厄介なところは、普通の方法で人狼を全滅させても終わらないこと" + _da(3) + "。儀式の進行手段の反対…真昼に一匹ずつ人狼を特殊な方法で処刑していき、全滅させることでのみ、儀式が相殺されるらしい" + _nda(3) + "。"
en: The troublesome thing about this ritual is that it doesn't end even if you wipe out all the werewolves using normal methods. It is said that we have to go for the opposite of the ritual's method... It is said that the ritual is offset by executing the werewolves one by one in the middle of the day using a special method.
en_grezzo: "The troublesome thing about this ritual is that it doesn't end even if you wipe out all the werewolves using normal methods. It is said that we have to go for the opposite of the ritual's method... It is said that the ritual is offset by executing the werewolves one by one in the middle of the day using a special method."
it: La cosa fastidiosa di questo rito è che non finisce nemmeno sterminando i lupi mannari col metodo normale. Bisogna fare il contrario di come avanza il rito... si dice che il rito si annulli soltanto giustiziando i lupi mannari uno per volta, in pieno giorno, con un metodo speciale.

jp: 怪しい人物を一日中見張っても人狼を見つけようとしている、おそらく日数が足りない。紛らわしいことに、妖狐が人狼遊儀の乗っ取りを目論んで混ざっていることもあるそう。とにかく、の冒険者の勘にも期待している。
jp_grezzo: "怪しい人物を一日中見張って" + _ore(3) + "も人狼を見つけようとしている" + _ga(3) + "、おそらく日数が足りない" + _daro(3) + "。紛らわしいことに、妖狐が人狼遊儀の乗っ取りを目論んで混ざっていることもあるそう" + _da(3) + "。とにかく、" + _kimi(3) + "の冒険者の勘にも期待している" + _yo(3) + "。"
en: I've been watching all day for suspicious people, trying to find the werewolf, but I probably won't have enough time. Confusingly, foxes are sometimes mixed in with the intention of taking over the ritual. Anyway, I have high hopes for your adventurer's intuition.
en_grezzo: "I've been watching all day for suspicious people, trying to find the werewolf, but I probably won't have enough time. Confusingly, foxes are sometimes mixed in with the intention of taking over the ritual. Anyway, I have high hopes for your adventurer's intuition."
it: Anche a sorvegliare tutto il giorno le persone sospette per trovare il lupo mannaro, probabilmente i giorni non bastano. E per complicare le cose, a volte ci si mette in mezzo una volpe ammaliatrice che punta a impadronirsi del rito. Comunque: conto anche sul tuo fiuto di avventuriero.

jp: 身辺調査をしてみた結果、どうもは正真正銘の人間のよう
jp_grezzo: "身辺調査をしてみた結果、どうも" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, cdata(CDATA_ROLE_SHOP_LEVEL, tc)) + "は正真正銘の人間のよう" + _da()
en: From what we've gathered from our investigation,  is most definitely a genuine human.
en_grezzo: "From what we've gathered from our investigation, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, cdata(CDATA_ROLE_SHOP_LEVEL, tc)) + " is most definitely a genuine human."
contesto: chatMore lang("身辺調査をしてみた結果、どうも" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, cdata(CDATA_ROLE_SHOP_LEVEL, tc)) + "は正真正銘の人間のよう" + _da(), "From what we've gathered from our investigation, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, cdata(CDATA_ROLE_SHOP_LEVEL, tc)) + " is most definitely a genuine human.")
it: "Da quel che abbiamo raccolto con le indagini, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, cdata(CDATA_ROLE_SHOP_LEVEL, tc)) + " è un essere umano in tutto e per tutto."

jp: 身辺調査をしてみた結果、どうもは人に化けた魔物のようヤツには気を付けて
jp_grezzo: "身辺調査をしてみた結果、どうも" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, cdata(CDATA_ROLE_SHOP_LEVEL, tc)) + "は人に化けた魔物のよう" + _da() + "ヤツには気を付けて" + _kure()
en: From what we've gathered from our investigation,  is a monster disguising itself as a human.
en_grezzo: "From what we've gathered from our investigation, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, cdata(CDATA_ROLE_SHOP_LEVEL, tc)) + " is a monster disguising itself as a human."
contesto: chatMore lang("身辺調査をしてみた結果、どうも" + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, cdata(CDATA_ROLE_SHOP_LEVEL, tc)) + "は人に化けた魔物のよう" + _da() + "ヤツには気を付けて" + _kure(), "From what we've gathered from our investigation, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, cdata(CDATA_ROLE_SHOP_LEVEL, tc)) + " is a monster disguising itself as a human.")
it: "Da quel che abbiamo raccolto con le indagini, " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, cdata(CDATA_ROLE_SHOP_LEVEL, tc)) + " è un mostro travestito da essere umano."

jp: 現在は特に調査している人物はいない
jp_grezzo: "現在は特に調査している人物はいない" + _na()
it: Al momento non stiamo indagando su nessuno.

jp: 西
東
北
南
奴なら今は死んでいる
jp_grezzo: "奴なら今は死んでいる" + _yo(2)
en: Oh forget it, dead for now.
it: Lascia perdere, non è più di questo mondo.

jp: ならすぐ近くにいるの方を向いてごらん。
jp_grezzo: cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, rc) + "ならすぐ近くにいる" + _yo() + s + "の方を向いてごらん。"
en: Oh look carefully before asking, just turn .
en_grezzo: "Oh look carefully before asking, just turn " + s + "."
contesto: s = lang(cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, rc) + "ならすぐ近くにいる" + _yo() + s + "の方を向いてごらん。", "Oh look carefully before asking, just turn " + s + ".")
it: "Ma guardati intorno prima di chiedere: gira verso " + s + "."

jp: ちょっと前にの方で見かけた
jp_grezzo: "ちょっと前に" + s + "の方で見かけた" + _yo()
en: I saw  just a minute ago. Try .
en_grezzo: "I saw " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, rc) + " just a minute ago. Try " + s + "."
contesto: s = lang("ちょっと前に" + s + "の方で見かけた" + _yo(), "I saw " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, rc) + " just a minute ago. Try " + s + ".")
it: "Ho visto " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, rc) + " poco fa. Prova verso " + s + "."

jp: ならの方角を探してごらん。
jp_grezzo: cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, rc) + "なら" + s + "の方角を探してごらん。"
en: Walk to  for a while, you'll find .
en_grezzo: "Walk to " + s + " for a while, you'll find " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, rc) + "."
contesto: s = lang(cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, rc) + "なら" + s + "の方角を探してごらん。", "Walk to " + s + " for a while, you'll find " + cdatan(CDATAN_NAME, rc) + ".")
